We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The Enterprise Change Manager supports the delivery of RSM’s Enterprise Change Management strategy and federated change management model by providing change management expertise across priority initiatives and helping strengthen visibility, consistency, readiness, and adoption across the firm.


The role partners with initiative sponsors, project and product teams, business leaders, change practitioners, and other stakeholders to assess change impacts, develop and execute change strategies, identify risks and dependencies, and support successful adoption and sustainment.


Working across lines of business and functions, the Enterprise Change Manager brings an enterprise perspective to assigned work by identifying connections between initiatives, stakeholder impacts, competing change demands, and opportunities for coordination. The role also supports the continued development of enterprise change management practices, tools, insights, and capabilities.

Responsibilities

Change Management Delivery

  • Independently lead change management activities for assigned enterprise and priority initiatives.
  • Assess the scope, complexity, stakeholder impact, readiness, and change management needs of assigned initiatives and recommend an appropriate change approach.
  • Develop and execute fit-for-purpose change management strategies and plans aligned with the Enterprise Change Management framework and tiered support model.
  • Create and maintain change deliverables including stakeholder assessments, change impact analyses, readiness assessments, communications plans, learning and enablement plans, sponsor activities, resistance management approaches, and adoption plans.
  • Integrate change management activities with project, product, communications, learning, technology, and implementation plans.
  • Monitor progress against change plans and adjust activities based on business needs, stakeholder feedback, readiness, and emerging risks.

Stakeholder and Leadership Enablement

  • Build effective relationships with sponsors, project leaders, business leaders, change practitioners, and impacted stakeholders.
  • Provide practical change management guidance and recommendations to initiative and business leaders.
  • Support sponsors and people leaders in understanding and carrying out their role in leading change.
  • Facilitate stakeholder discussions, workshops, readiness conversations, impact assessments, and other change-related sessions.
  • Translate complex project, process, technology, and organizational information into clear implications for impacted audiences.
  • Gather stakeholder feedback and help project teams translate findings into appropriate actions.

Enterprise Change Visibility

  • Support visibility into significant change occurring across lines of business and functions.
  • Gather and maintain information related to initiative timing, impacted populations, change magnitude, readiness, dependencies, and other relevant change indicators.
  • Analyze assigned initiatives and portfolio information to identify potential stakeholder overlap, competing changes, sequencing concerns, change saturation, and dependencies.
  • Surface patterns, emerging risks, or cross-enterprise impacts to Enterprise Change Management leadership.
  • Provide analysis and recommendations that support enterprise change planning and decision-making.

Federated Change Management Support

  • Partner with change practitioners embedded within lines of business and functions to promote alignment and connectivity across the federated model.
  • Apply and reinforce enterprise change management standards, tools, methods, and practices.
  • Support business-aligned change practitioners with tools, guidance, coaching, and enterprise context as appropriate.
  • Identify initiatives or issues that may require broader Enterprise Change Management involvement and escalate them to Enterprise Change Management leadership.
  • Share lessons learned, reusable assets, and effective practices across the enterprise change community.

Readiness, Adoption and Sustainment

  • Assess stakeholder and organizational readiness for assigned changes.
  • Identify adoption risks, resistance, capability gaps, and other barriers that could affect implementation success.
  • Develop and implement interventions to address identified readiness and adoption concerns.
  • Establish appropriate measures for readiness, adoption, and sustainment in partnership with initiative teams.
  • Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback to evaluate how change is being experienced and adopted.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on adoption and readiness data.
  • Support the transition of changes from project or product teams into ongoing business operations.

Change Capability Building

  • Support the development and delivery of change management tools, resources, learning experiences, communities of practice, and leader enablement activities.
  • Coach project teams, business partners, and change practitioners on effective change management practices.
  • Help increase change management capability across the firm by making tools and practices practical, accessible, and scalable.
  • Contribute insights and recommendations that improve Enterprise Change Management methods and ways of working.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and improve change management processes, tools, and deliverables.
  • Leverage AI, technology, data, and automation to improve change analysis, communications, stakeholder insights, reporting, and delivery efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging change management practices and apply relevant approaches to assigned work.
  • Participate in continuous improvement of the Enterprise Change Management capability.

People Development

  • Support the development of less-experienced change practitioners through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • May serve as a Performance Advisor, including regular feedback, coaching, goal setting, and development with assigned advisees.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; business, organizational development, human resources, communications, technology, psychology, or related discipline preferred.
  • Minimum five years of experience supporting or leading change management for organizational, technology, process, operating model, or transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop and execute change management plans for moderately to highly complex initiatives.
  • Experience working with business leaders, project teams, managers, and employees across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Working knowledge of change management disciplines including stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, communications, learning and enablement, readiness, resistance management, adoption, and sustainment.
  • Strong consulting, facilitation, communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively across organizational boundaries.
  • Ability to analyze complex information, identify patterns and risks, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Strong judgment, business acumen, curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Experience using data, stakeholder feedback, and other insights to inform change management decisions.
  • Professional services, public accounting, consulting, or other complex matrixed organization experience preferred.
  • Change management certification such as Prosci, CCMP, or equivalent preferred.

jobs.description:
Hello! We are Cashea 👋 and our mission is to give Venezuelans back the opportunity to access credit through a BNPL business model. Since our launch in 2022, we have been dedicated to promoting financial inclusion. Today we have more than 9 million active users, both consumers and merchants, and we have become a trusted brand in Venezuela, winning hearts and minds.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who builds the platform the rest of engineering relies on. You’ll own our Infrastructure-as-Code on Google Cloud Platform: the modules, wrappers, networking, and pipelines that let dozens of teams ship services safely across our domains.

This is hands-on building. We run everything on GCP with OpenTofu and Terragrunt, a layered and versioned IaC platform of reusable modules and opinionated wrappers, consumed by a live repo that defines what runs in dev, staging, and production. You’ll design that platform, extend it as we grow, and answer for how it behaves when teams use it. The engineers who grow fastest here go deep, codify sensible defaults, and leave the platform safer and easier to use than they found it.

Overall you will…

  • Design and build reusable IaC modules and wrappers in OpenTofu (Terraform) and Terragrunt, with sensible, governed defaults.

  • Provision and evolve our GCP estate: Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), Memorystore Redis, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Datastream, Cloud Composer, and GCS.

  • Own our network architecture, including Shared VPC, per-domain subnets, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, firewall policies, private connectivity (PSA/PSC), and internal and external load balancing.

  • Design least-privilege IAM with service accounts, Workload Identity, and keyless auth, so least privilege is the default for every workload.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD for infrastructure with GitHub Actions, Workload Identity Federation, plan-on-PR and apply-on-comment flows, and policy and security checks (TFLint, Trivy).

  • Make architectural and system-design decisions across our multi-environment, multi-region setup (us-east1 with us-west1 for DR), and own the trade-offs behind them.

  • Manage Terraform and Terragrunt state, versioning, and the safe rollout of platform changes across many consuming teams.

  • Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, clear standards, and documentation that makes the platform self-serve.

  • Mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, leaving the team stronger than you found it.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of cloud and infrastructure engineering experience, with strong hands-on depth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Production experience with Terraform or OpenTofu, and ideally Terragrunt, building reusable and versioned infrastructure rather than only consuming it.

  • Solid grasp of GCP networking: VPCs (ideally Shared VPC), subnets, Cloud NAT, DNS, firewall policies, and private connectivity (PSA/PSC).

  • Strong IAM fundamentals: least privilege, service accounts, and Workload Identity or federation.

  • Experience operating managed GCP services such as Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), and Memorystore Redis.

  • Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), and treating infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code.

  • A track record of making architectural calls and owning infrastructure end-to-end in a fast-moving context.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and to mentor others effectively.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking, with genuine curiosity about new technology.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with GKE specifics such as private and regional clusters, Workload Identity, Dataplane V2, and managed Prometheus.

  • Familiarity with data and messaging services: Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, BigQuery, Datastream (CDC), and Cloud Composer (Airflow).

  • Experience with API platforms such as Apigee, plus Artifact Registry and Cloud Build.

  • Secrets management with GCP Secret Manager.

  • Scripting in Bash or Python for operational tooling and automation.

  • Experience building in fintech, payments, or credit.

  • Spanish and English proficiency.

Why you'll love working at Cashe

At Cashea, we have a work culture based on trust and purpose. If you need a clue as to why we are a good choice, these are our core values:

  • We don't work on autopilot. Everything we do is intentional. We love to develop ideas with full awareness of the impact they can have on our users.

  • Your creativity and curiosity are our most important assets.

  • Your voice matters. We listen and make space for ideas and feedback. Everyone belongs, and what's important to you is important to us.

  • We value transparency. Clarity keeps us connected and grounded.

  • Last but not least, we focus on real impact.

If you want to work with us, fill out the application. We'd love to meet you!

jobs.excerpt: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

At TE Connectivity, we help build the technologies that keep the world connected. As a global leader in connectivity and sensor solutions, we partner with customers across industries to develop innovative products that power transportation, industrial, medical, energy, aerospace, and data infrastructure applications.

The Digital Data Networks department is seeking an experienced Staff R&D Product Engineer to lead the development of embedded software, firmware, applications, and data platforms for next-generation intelligent power products. This role is responsible for designing and delivering software solutions that bring advanced monitoring, diagnostics, analytics, and device management capabilities to active power products used in AI, hyperscale data center, industrial, and other high-power applications.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in embedded software and firmware development with strong knowledge of sensing technologies, power systems, data analytics, and connected device architectures. This individual will collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to transform product telemetry into actionable intelligence while enabling differentiated intelligent power solutions for customers worldwide.

Role and Responsibilities

Embedded Software & Active Device Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software and firmware for microcontrollers, sensor ICs, and intelligent power devices.
  • Develop device drivers, bootloaders, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), and real-time applications using bare-metal and RTOS architectures.
  • Create tools and processes for device configuration, calibration, diagnostics, firmware updates, and secure lifecycle management.
  • Lead software architecture, communication interface implementation, code reviews, and technical mentoring to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.

Sensing, Monitoring & Diagnostics

  • Develop real-time monitoring algorithms for electrical, thermal, and electromagnetic measurements in power products.
  • Implement signal processing, calibration, fault detection, event logging, alarm handling, and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to define sensing architectures and measurement requirements.
  • Develop predictive monitoring solutions that improve reliability while balancing cost, manufacturability, and system constraints.

Data Management & Analytics

  • Design and develop data acquisition systems, databases, APIs, dashboards, and analytics platforms for product telemetry.
  • Establish data models, traceability frameworks, retention strategies, and data quality standards across development and production environments.
  • Create analytics solutions for performance trending, failure analysis, predictive maintenance, and continuous product improvement.
  • Integrate monitoring platforms with edge, cloud, manufacturing, and enterprise systems while ensuring cybersecurity and data integrity.

Test, Validation & Product Development

  • Develop automated test and data acquisition software supporting product validation, characterization, and manufacturing testing.
  • Integrate software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment, including power analyzers, oscilloscopes, electronic loads, and thermal chambers.
  • Execute software verification and validation activities including unit, integration, regression, hardware-in-the-loop, and system testing.
  • Support product development from concept through production launch by troubleshooting hardware-software interactions and validating performance.

Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with customers and stakeholders to define technical requirements and intelligent power system solutions.
  • Translate business and product needs into software specifications, architectures, interfaces, and development roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with Electrical, Mechanical, Thermal, Manufacturing, Quality, Test, Product Management, and Customer Engineering teams.
  • Support documentation, design reviews, product integration, deployment activities, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience developing embedded software, firmware, connected devices, monitoring systems, industrial software, or data-driven engineering applications.
  • Proven experience leading software development projects from concept through production deployment and lifecycle support.
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems and Python for test automation, analytics, tooling, and software development.
  • Experience delivering software solutions that interface directly with sensors, hardware devices, laboratory equipment, or industrial systems.
  • Experience collaborating across global, cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and travel up to 25% as required.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Embedded systems development including microcontrollers, RTOS and bare-metal architectures, device drivers, bootloaders, memory management, and in-system programming.
  • Software architecture, modular design, object-oriented development, API development, interface management, and system integration.
  • Strong understanding of sensing and measurement technologies including ADCs, shunts, Hall-effect sensors, thermistors, RTDs, inductive sensing, calibration, and signal processing.
  • Knowledge of power distribution systems, power integrity concepts, voltage drop, power loss, inductance, thermal behavior, and high-current interconnects.
  • Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, telemetry processing, time-series data management, data visualization, dashboards, and reporting platforms.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles including:
    • Secure boot
    • Authentication
    • Encryption
    • Signed firmware
    • Secure update processes
    • Access control
    • Vulnerability management
  • Experience with software development and engineering tools such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, requirements management platforms, automated testing frameworks, and debugging environments.
  • Knowledge of automated test systems, hardware-in-the-loop validation, fault injection techniques, and traceable verification methods.

Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving capabilities across software, electronics, sensing technologies, data systems, and physical product behavior.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex technical projects and competing priorities independently.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to mentor and guide other engineers while promoting disciplined software development practices.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to continuous learning in embedded systems, intelligent power products, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies.
  • Self-driven focus on advancing intelligent power solutions through innovative development, validation, and optimization methodologies.

Other Information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data center power architectures, busbars, power shelves, 48V or 54V power distribution systems, high-voltage DC systems, or high-current cable assemblies and connectors.
  • Familiarity with PMBus, Redfish, OCP specifications, BMC integration, and other power management standards.
  • Experience developing condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, AI/ML analytics, or digital twin solutions.
  • Experience developing web applications, dashboards, cloud-native platforms, edge computing solutions, and containerized deployments.
  • Knowledge of functional safety, product cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and software quality practices for connected products.
  • Experience supporting product development, manufacturing process development, production testing, and customer deployment activities in a global environment.
  • Understanding of low-frequency circuit behavior and power system characteristics.
  • Proven success delivering intelligent monitoring and connected-device solutions throughout the full product lifecycle.

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

Role Description:

Being a Senior Sales Enablement Manager at Defense Unicorns means building the systems that help our Growth team consistently win.Our mission is to make software a strategic deterrent. The Sales Enablement role ensures that our Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, and Sales Engineers are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes required to communicate our value clearly and move opportunities forward.

In this role, you will report to the Business Development organization and work closely with Product Marketing, Product, and Revenue leadership to operationalize our go-to-market strategy. You will own the development and delivery of enablement programs that improve sales productivity, accelerate deal cycles, and ensure consistent execution across the revenue team.

This is an execution focused role. You will design and run repeatable enablement programs, maintain the core sales knowledge system, and ensure the field has the resources they need to succeed.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who can build structure while operating in a dynamic environment.

  • Own and execute the sales enablement strategy
  • Apply prior experience supporting Defense Industrial Base (DIB) customers to ensure enablement programs align with DoD, IC, and federal sales motions
  • Design and deliver onboarding programs for new Account Executives, BDRs, and Sales Architects
  • Develop and maintain sales playbooks, messaging frameworks, and opportunity management guides
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product positioning and messaging into field-ready enablement materials
  • Ensure the revenue team has consistent access to current competitive positioning, product updates, and sales assets
  • Design and run recurring enablement sessions, including product training, competitive updates, and sales skill development
  • Support major product launches by coordinating internal training and field readiness programs
  • Maintain the sales knowledge system, ensuring resources are organized, up to date, and easy for the field to access
  • Partner with Revenue leadership to identify skill gaps and develop targeted enablement programs
  • Measure and improve the effectiveness of enablement programs through feedback, usage metrics, and sales outcomes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to ensure alignment between strategy and field execution
  • Operate effectively in a remote, fast paced environment with high cross functional collaboration

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years Sales/Revenue Enablement experience with clear ownership of onboarding, playbooks, training, and enablement systems
  • Experience designing and running sales enablement programs in B2B/B2G technology company
  • Experience supporting enterprise software sales teams, including Account Executives and Sales Architects
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical products into clear sales narratives and playbooks
  • Experience building onboarding and training programs for growing revenue teams
  • Familiarity with modern sales tools and systems such as HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and enablement platforms
  • Strong organizational discipline and ability to maintain structured knowledge systems
  • Comfortable presenting and facilitating training sessions for sales teams
  • Experience working cross functionally with Product Marketing, Marketing, and Product teams

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA
$145,000—$185,000 USD

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping

  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s

  • Identify technical risks, formulate mitigation options, and escalate unresolved blockers to project management to ensure high-quality software solutions and on-time project delivery.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of overall experience in software engineering, systems design, database management, cloud environments, or software deployment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on OneStream development experience (or equivalent CPM/EPM platform development experience demonstrating a track record of successful project delivery).

  • Proficiency in object-oriented programming using C# or VB.NET, along with practical SQL experience (SQL Server or Oracle) for data manipulation and querying.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
  • Functional understanding of Corporate Performance Management (CPM) or Federal Financial Management concepts (e.g., Consolidations, Budgeting/Forecasting, Reconciliation, PPBE).
  • OneStream Certified Specialist (OCS) in Reports & Dashboards or Financial Close, or OneStream Certified Professional (OCP) – Core Platform.
  • Hands-on experience setting up Single Sign-On (SSO) and assisting with federal Authority to Operate (ATO) compliance procedures.
  • Prior experience in professional services or federal IT consulting environments.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.

Clearance Requirements:

  • US Citizenship with the ability to obtain aPublic Trust clearance or higher.

Physical Requirements:

MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

The Testing Strategy Manager (TSM) leads the development and execution of a comprehensive testing strategy for the Peraton CMS Fee‑for‑Service (FFS) healthcare program. This role focuses on advancing Agile testing practices, expanding test automation, and improving overall quality outcomes across three large, complex, mainframe‑based systems. The TSM collaborates closely with account leadership, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders to drive quality excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement a holistic testing strategy aligned with Agile/DevOps methodologies and prioritizing automation across all testing phases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test schedules across hardware and software platforms.
  • Define and communicate requirements for test environments, test data, and test cycles, collaborating with Infrastructure/Data Center teams.
  • Ensure adequate testing coverage prior to production releases and support production checkout planning through risk identification and mitigation.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of 10–15 technical and business analyst resources, including performance monitoring and annual evaluations.
  • Provide technical leadership to Testing Engineers and promote a culture of collaboration, growth, and quality-minded thinking.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and champion strategies for increasing automation across the program, including test data automation approaches.
  • Implement and refine processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, productivity, and reduce redundancy.
  • Assist in establishing and measuring quality metrics to support process adoption and continuous improvement.

Risk, Defect, and Quality Management

  • Identify and communicate risks related to testing strategies, ensuring clear visibility into business impacts.
  • Analyze defects to support triage, drive resolution, and determine technical and business impacts.
  • Support and participate in design reviews, requirement walk‑throughs, quality assessments, and post‑release reviews.
  • Administer the problem management process, monitoring and reporting on problem resolution activities.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work with account and program leadership to align testing strategy with system roadmaps, transformation efforts, and software development priorities.
  • Collaborate with Release PMs, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Technical Leads on implementation planning and issue resolution.
  • Participate in requirements/user story reviews to ensure clarity, feasibility, and testability.

Strategic Insight & Recommendations

  • Provide recommendations on tools, technologies, and testing practices to improve efficiency and quality outcomes.
  • Help shape Quality Assurance policies, goals, and objectives in partnership with QA leadership.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years of combined experience in software testing, automation, technical analysis, and business analysis.
  • 5+ years managing teams of 10+ resources.
  • Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
  • CMS contract experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills – Must have

  • Experience developing use cases, process flows, and related documentation.
  • Expertise in automated testing practices and tools, including TestRail, Open Text UFT, MS Scheduler, and WFTP Script Editor/Debugger.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and working with Confluence and Jira.
  • Strong relationship‑building abilities across QA, business, and technical teams.
  • Excellent analytical, diagnostic, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Knowledge of mainframe testing and Automated testing.
  • Demonstrated success implementing test automation within Agile/DevOps environments.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical concepts and work independently or within distributed teams.
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment and influence teams toward common goals.

Knowledge & Skills – Nice to have

  • Mid‑tier and cloud testing experience desired.
  • Knowledge of AI Testing tools and Methodologies desired.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS - Agentic Experience
jobs.excerpt: About the teamThe Agentic Experience team sits at the forefront of Zillow's transformation toward an agentic product experience.
jobs.description:
About the team

The Agentic Experience team sits at the forefront of Zillow's transformation toward an agentic product experience. We are the stewards of the agentic UX framework, the foundation that allows Zillow's agentic AI capabilities to come to life across its surfaces, and we operate at the intersection of product and platform: shipping meaningful agentic experiences today while building the durable infrastructure that enables teams across Zillow to build more, faster, tomorrow.
We built and launched the user experience for Zillow AI Mode, now available to every signed-in Zillow user across web, iOS, and Android, and we own and evolve that core experience every day. We also stay at the forefront of agentic UX: exploring what comes after the conversational interface, including generative, context-adaptive interfaces that personalize to each person's goals and stage of their real estate journey, and bringing the most promising of those ideas into a product used by millions.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS, to help build and evolve Zillow AI Mode in the Zillow iOS app. You will be a core contributor to the mobile experience of AI Mode, a multimodal, context-aware agentic experience that is increasingly woven into the rest of the app. Beyond the conversational experience itself, you will help shape the interfaces by which other parts of the Zillow iOS app integrate with AI Mode, so they can hand context to the agent and surface its capabilities in place. And as the team pushes into generative UX, you will have the opportunity to contribute to how we bring frontier interaction patterns into a production app used by millions. This is a hands-on engineering role on a team that is central to Zillow's AI strategy. Much of what comes next is still being defined, and you will have a real voice in defining it.


You Will Get To

  • Build and ship the iOS experience for Zillow AI Mode (conversational, multimodal, and context-aware) in Swift and SwiftUI, with a high bar for craft, performance, and reliability in a consumer app at scale.
  • Design and evolve the integration interfaces that let other surfaces in the Zillow iOS app connect to AI Mode: passing context to the agent and bringing agentic capabilities into the flows where users already are.
  • Contribute to the team's generative UX frontier, helping prototype, evaluate, and productionize AI-composed, hyper-personalized interfaces on iOS.
  • Partner closely with your web and Android counterparts to keep the AI Mode experience consistent across platforms: aligning on experience decisions, evolving the shared schema and protocol, and learning from how each platform solves the same problems, all while building natively on iOS.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, applied scientists, and ML engineers to turn new agentic skills and model capabilities into shippable, measurable user experiences, and support rapid experimentation with real users.
  • Champion operational excellence for the iOS experience, from instrumentation and observability to testing strategy and safe, incremental rollout, so we can move fast without compromising quality or user trust.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400.00 - $262,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200.00 - $249,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • A builder at heart who takes pride in the craft of mobile engineering and has the judgment to balance speed with rigor.
  • A champion for user experience quality. You care how things look, feel, and perform, and you hold a high bar for what great mobile work is.
  • A collaborative engineer who works well across platforms and functions (product, design, AI/ML, and peer engineering teams) and drives outcomes through influence rather than authority.
  • A pragmatic technologist who is comfortable in ambiguity, breaks down complex problems, and surfaces risks and trade-offs early.
  • A clear communicator who documents designs and decisions well and can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.
  • A practitioner of AI-native development. You actively use AI coding tools and assistants in your own workflow and treat them as a genuine force multiplier throughout the software development lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, the majority of it building native iOS applications in Swift.
  • Deep proficiency in SwiftUI and UIKit, Swift concurrency, and modern iOS architecture patterns, with experience evolving a large, long-lived codebase.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping consumer-facing iOS products to a large user base, with an appreciation for performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience quality.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incremental rollout.

Desired Skills

  • Experience building AI-powered or agentic applications, including familiarity with LLMs, streaming responses, tool/function calling, and multimodal input/output (text, voice, images).
  • Experience with server-driven or dynamically composed UI, or other approaches to rendering generative, context-adaptive interfaces on mobile.
  • Experience on a cross-platform team, aligning experience decisions with web and Android counterparts and learning from how other platforms solve similar problems.
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping and iterative product development in a fast-moving, research-adjacent environment.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. The Senior Clinical Payment Associate provides independent, specialized support for complex clinical site payment activities across the Americas portfolio. The role manages higher-risk and non-routine work, interprets complex contractual payment terms, leads issue resolution, oversees vendor delivery, and supports portfolio-level financial analysis and process improvement. The position also provides day-to-day subject matter guidance to Payment Associates.


Job Responsibilities

  • Independently manage higher-complexity study and country payment portfolios, including multiple vendors, currencies, payment models, tax or documentation requirements, and significant exception volumes.
  • Interpret complex Clinical Trial Agreement payment terms and site budgets and determine how they translate into operational payment requirements.
  • Lead resolution of aged, disputed, historical, or cross-functional payment issues, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Oversee vendor delivery against Statements of Work, challenge gaps, review performance trends, and escalate material risks to Clinical Site Payments leadership.
  • Perform budget-versus-actual analysis, funding sufficiency review, forecasting, and variance analysis for assigned portfolios.
  • Lead or co-lead regional payment projects, internalization initiatives, process design, workflow development, testing, and implementation activities.
  • Develop guidance, job aids, and controls for country-specific payment operations and support inspection- and audit-ready evidence.

  • Operate with minimal supervision, independently prioritize competing deliverables, and propose risk mitigation strategies to leadership.
  • Support accurate setup, review, execution, and reconciliation of investigator grant and clinical site payments in accordance with executed Clinical Trial Agreements, approved budgets, company procedures, and country requirements.
  • Work with investigative sites, Clinical Operations, Clinical Site Contracts, Budget Development, Finance, Accounts Payable, and external payment vendors to resolve payment questions and discrepancies.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready payment records, trackers, supporting documentation, and system data throughout the study lifecycle.

Job Qualifications

  • Typically 4+ years of relevant industry experience, or 5+ years in clinical research or the pharmaceutical industry, with substantial experience in clinical site payments, investigator grants, finance, or related operations.

jobs.description:
Stranger Soccer UAE · Reports to CEO

About Stranger Soccer

The #1 way adults play football in the UAE. We operate across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman — 200+ games every month, 30,000+ downloads, a real community of players who show up, play, meet people, and come back. Two years in, we’re at the inflection point where financial discipline, clean reporting, and sharp commercial judgement are everything.

About the Role

You will own the health of our finance function day-to-day. You’re not doing the daily bookkeeping yourself (we have that covered), and you’re not a Finance Director or CFO (we don’t need 10+ years of experience).

You are the person who sits between the CEO and the finance operations team — making sure we have clean, accurate, timely numbers, and more importantly, telling us what those numbers mean and what to do about them.

You will report directly to the CEO. You’ll have one direct report (our Finance & Payments Coordinator, PH-based) and oversight of our external accounting firm (UAE-based).

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. If the P&L is wrong, I need you to spot it, fix it, and tell me what to change so it doesn’t happen again. If a cost line looks off, I need you proactively flagging it. If a decision I’m about to make doesn’t stack up on the numbers, I need you telling me.

This role is also about building structure, not just reading numbers. Our finance workflows, reporting cadence, and process discipline need serious upgrading. You will design, document and enforce a cleaner finance operation.

What You’ll Own

Financial reporting and oversight

Monthly rolling 3-month P&L pack delivered to CEO on the 5th of every month without fail

  • P&L accuracy — you own whether the numbers tie. If they don’t, you fix it before they reach the CEO
  • Balance sheet oversight — cash, receivables, payables, royalty accruals
  • Royalty reconciliation against licensing agreement terms (including credit mechanism)
  • Discount / promo / voucher tracking as a visible line item
  • Variance analysis month-on-month

Business health and advice

  • Interpret the numbers — tell the CEO what’s going well, what’s not, and what needs attention
  • Track and report on KPIs: revenue, gross margin, CAC, LTV, retention, membership economics
  • Model scenarios — pricing changes, membership restructures, partnership economics
  • Flag risks and opportunities proactively — don’t wait to be asked
  • Prepare financial packs for our Singapore Licensor and external stakeholders

Structure, processes and team workflow

  • Design and document the finance function end-to-end — chart of accounts, monthly close process, invoice routing, payment approval workflow, royalty calculation, VAT preparation
  • Build SOPs for the Finance & Payments Coordinator and the external accounting firm
  • Manage our Finance & Payments Coordinator — set KPIs, hold weekly check-ins, coach to higher output
  • Manage our external accounting firm — hold them accountable for quality, timeliness, and compliance
  • Run the monthly business review meeting with the CEO
  • Build and maintain the chart of accounts in our accounting software

What You WON’T Do

  • Daily bookkeeping — the Finance & Payments Coordinator and external accountants handle that
  • UAE VAT / Corporate Tax filings — external accountants do that; you supervise
  • Daily payment execution — Coordinator does that
  • Set company strategy (you support it; you don’t own it)

Requirements

Who You Are

5–8 years of finance experience, ideally some of it in SME or growth-stage startup

  • Background in consumer business, marketplace, subscription, or multi-location operations preferred
  • CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent qualification strongly preferred
  • You’ve actually run management reporting for a business — not just audit or academic finance
  • Strong commercial instinct — you can read a P&L and tell me what’s really happening, not just what it says
  • Proven track record designing or improving finance processes, workflows and chart of accounts — not just operating within an existing system someone else built
  • Experience managing external accounting firms and holding them to account
  • Experience with cloud accounting software — Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or equivalent
  • High-level Excel / Google Sheets competence
  • English fluency essential — this role runs on async communication and clear written analysis
  • Writes clearly and concisely
  • Proactive, independent operator — spots problems, proposes solutions, executes
  • Open to a part-time commitment (4 hours/day, Mon-Fri) — this role is designed to fit alongside other professional commitments

Culture fit

Honesty over politics. Tell me when I’m wrong.

  • Ownership over blame. Fix it before escalating.
  • Data over opinions. Bring the numbers.
  • Speed over perfection. Launch, measure, adjust.
  • Self-direction over supervision.

Working Hours

  • Remote, Philippines-based, part-time: 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday.
  • Working days: Monday to Friday
  • Core hours: 3:00pm–7:00pm PHT (11:00am–3:00pm UAE time) — fully online and reachable for sync with the Finance & Payments Coordinator and ad hoc CEO queries
  • Weekends off: Saturday + Sunday
  • Total effort: 20 hours per week
  • Deliverables-based: monthly reporting pack by the 5th of every month without fail; weekly one-to-one with Finance Coordinator; monthly review meeting with CEO

OTHER

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. As the central commercial marketing leader and primary strategic counterpart to the Product/UX and Strategic Partnership organizations, you will lead the "commercial engine" bridging our product, the market, and our ecosystem. Leading a specialized pod focused on B2C Demand, B2B Merchant Enablement, and Customer Insights, you will help set the core narrative and positioning of Wing’s competitive advantage, and relentlessly pursue what makes our experience unique and differentiated to serve the needs of everyone we serve across the ecosystem. You will ensure tight alignment with our cross-functional teams to set a clear strategic blueprint for our integrated activities across Growth, Content, and Creative teams to scale. The ideal candidate will simplify complex technical operations into audience-first, benefit-driven value propositions and experiences, while managing the end-to-end partner marketing lifecycle.

  • Build a deeply embedded 'Interlock' model with Product, UX, and Engineering—specifically across Demand Generation and Fulfillment. Ensure marketing strategy shapes product development from day one to accelerate commercial adoption.
  • Craft the foundational positioning, messaging, and GTM strategy for both end-users (B2C) and merchant partners (B2B).
  • Serve as the strategic marketing counterpart to BD and Partnerships. Manage the partner lifecycle end-to-end, from developing foundational pitch narratives to executing multi-channel co-marketing campaigns with enterprise brands.
  • Define the Wing value proposition and orchestrate the commercial positioning in the web, app, packaging, and partner ecosystem. Responsible for consumer experience and engagement strategies across our digital delivery applications.
  • Partner across Policy, Comms, Legal, and Marketing to align commercial messaging with aviation and safety standards.
  • Partner closely with our Growth & Media teams to test positioning and scale direct user acquisition, including implementation of promotions strategy.

When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Associate Director, IIT Supply Chain owns drug supply for Investigator Initiated Trials (IITs) across planning, label development, label & pack, and distribution for multiple global clinical studies. Serving as the primary interface with Global Clinical Supply Chain and internal stakeholders, and managing relationships with external supply partners, this role ensures accurate, continuous, and compliant supply to patients while minimizing risk and waste. The Associate Director brings working knowledge of clinical supply best practices and supply chain systems, experience in a cGMP environment, and a commitment to building processes that prepare the organization for the future. As business needs evolve, responsibilities may expand to include supply planning for other Global Medical Affairs (GMA) Medical Operations programs, such as expanded access and Phase IV studies.


Essential Functions of the Job:


Clinical & Commercial Supply Planning and Strategy

  • Develop and oversee supply and inventory plans for assigned IITs to ensure accurate and continuous supply to patients.
  • Partner with the IIT team, investigators, and study sites to understand clinical demand and timelines, and align supply plans accordingly.
  • Forecast and aggregate anticipated IIT drug demand across the portfolio to enable proactive supply decisions.
  • Maintain Excel-based planning tools and dashboards to support decision-making.
  • Develop supply strategies that maximize supply efficiency and minimize waste.
  • Identify supply risks, and develop and execute risk mitigation plans
  • Manage inventory throughout the supply chain, including inventory reporting, expiry management, and drug accountability and reconciliation.

Label Development, Label & Pack, and Distribution

  • Lead label development, ensuring label text and proofs comply with applicable regulations, product specifications, and study protocol(s).
  • Coordinate label review and approval with Regulatory, Quality, Global Clinical Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Plan and coordinate label & pack operations.
  • Plan and coordinate distribution of investigational and commercially approved product to depots, sites, and patients across multiple countries, including temperature-controlled shipments.
  • Coordinate and track shipments to CDMOs, depots, and vendors, and maintain shipping documentation.
  • Support IRT/RTSM user acceptance testing, supply strategy and parameter setup, and ongoing supply activities within the system, as applicable.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management

  • Represent the IIT team and serve as the primary interface with Global Clinical Supply Chain.
  • Provide a high level of service to internal stakeholders (e.g., Global Medical Affairs, Global R&D Sourcing, Regulatory, Quality, Legal, Finance).
  • Manage relationships with, and oversee the daily activities of, external supply partners such as CMOs/CDMOs, depots, couriers, and IRT vendors.

Quality and Compliance

  • Ensure supply activities are conducted in compliance with cGMP, GDP, and GCP requirements, applicable regulations, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Investigate exceptions (e.g., temperature excursions, shipment deviations, product complaints) to determine root cause, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and drive closure.
  • Support audits and inspections related to IIT drug supply.

Budget Management

  • Develop and manage IIT drug supply budgets and forecasts.
  • Provide input to Finance on accruals and planned spend.
  • Manage purchase orders, and review and pay invoices for supply vendors.

Process Improvement and Leadership

  • Work with management to develop and implement process improvements, tools, and best practices that build the organization for the future.
  • Lead cross-functional projects related to IIT drug supply.
  • Create and revise process documents such as SOPs and working instructions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This position does not have direct reports at this time. The role may provide guidance, training, and informal mentoring to IIT team members and colleagues on clinical supply planning processes and tools.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, life sciences, or a related field required; Master’s degree/MBA preferred.

Qualifications:


Required:

  • Bachelors degree with 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience, including at least 5 years in clinical supply chain within the biotech, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry.
  • Experience managing investigational product supply for global, multi-country clinical trials.
  • Working knowledge of clinical supply best practices, supply chain systems, and cGMP, GDP, and GCP requirements.
  • Experience managing CMOs/CDMOs, label & pack vendors, depots, and couriers, including deviation investigation and CAPA implementation.
  • Strong analytical and Excel modeling skills for demand forecasting and supply planning.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple studies and projects, and to work independently and within multi-disciplinary, multi-cultural teams.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills; fluent in spoken and written English.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience collaborating with external sponsors on IITs
  • APICS CPIM certification or equivalent.

Computer Skills:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel (including supply modeling), PowerPoint, Smartsheet, and Outlook.
  • Working knowledge of IRT/RTSM systems, SAP or comparable ERP/planning systems, Ariba Buying & Invoicing/Guided Buying or similar purchasing systems, and Veeva Vault or similar quality/document management systems.

Travel:

  • Work-related travel approximately 5-10%, including face-to-face department meetings.

Work Arrangement:

  • Remote

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $160,100.00 - $210,100.00 annually

BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We work with businesses that want to operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're an entrepreneurial team that values initiative, clear communication, and people who take ownership of their work. Our teams collaborate closely across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Operations to solve problems and improve how our platform works.

About the Role

We're looking for a Pharmacy Implementation Program Manager to lead the onboarding and implementation of new pharmacy partners and pharmacy-related operational workflows at Bask Health.

You'll manage implementation projects from kickoff through launch, coordinating with pharmacy partners, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and internal operations teams.

Your focus will be ensuring that technical dependencies, operational processes, partner requirements, testing, and launch readiness activities are completed before new pharmacy workflows go live.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can bring structure to complicated implementations, keep stakeholders aligned, and take ownership of delivering projects on time.

What You'll Do

  • Own pharmacy implementation projects from initial kickoff through launch and post-launch stabilization.
  • Develop implementation plans with clear timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and completion criteria.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities for new pharmacy partners.
  • Work with pharmacy partners to gather operational requirements and document existing workflows.
  • Translate partner requirements into clear implementation tasks for internal teams.
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on pharmacy integrations and technical dependencies.
  • Track integration progress and ensure outstanding technical requirements have clear owners.
  • Organize implementation meetings and maintain accurate action-item trackers.
  • Identify implementation risks, blockers, and dependencies early.
  • Escalate issues that may affect launch timelines or operational readiness.
  • Coordinate testing of pharmacy order workflows, fulfillment processes, and partner integrations.
  • Maintain testing checklists, issue logs, and readiness documentation.
  • Work with internal teams and pharmacy partners to resolve issues identified during implementation testing.
  • Coordinate go-live readiness reviews and ensure required operational tasks are completed.
  • Develop launch checklists and confirm that responsibilities are clearly assigned.
  • Help establish escalation procedures and communication workflows for newly onboarded pharmacy partners.
  • Coordinate training and operational handoffs for internal teams supporting new pharmacy workflows.
  • Monitor outstanding issues during the initial post-launch period.
  • Coordinate post-launch issue resolution and stabilization activities.
  • Document implementation outcomes, lessons learned, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop reusable implementation templates, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide regular status updates to internal stakeholders and leadership.
  • Work closely with Customer Success to understand merchant-facing dependencies and launch requirements.
  • Manage multiple implementation projects and competing priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation speed, consistency, and operational reliability.
  • Ensure clinical, prescription, and dispensing decisions remain with appropriately licensed pharmacy professionals.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in implementation management, program management, project management, operations, or a related field.
  • Experience managing implementation projects from planning through launch.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple internal teams and external partners.
  • Strong understanding of project planning, milestones, dependencies, and risk management.
  • Experience gathering operational requirements and translating them into implementation plans.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and keep projects moving toward completion.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience coordinating testing, operational readiness, or go-live activities.
  • Ability to identify blockers, manage escalations, and coordinate issue resolution.
  • Comfortable working with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience maintaining project trackers, implementation documentation, and status reports.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work through ambiguity.
  • Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
  • Ability to follow applicable privacy, security, and operational procedures.

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing pharmacy systems or pharmacy partner workflows.
  • Experience working in telehealth, healthcare technology, or pharmacy operations.
  • Familiarity with prescription fulfillment and pharmacy order workflows.
  • Experience coordinating software integrations or API-based implementations.
  • Experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting pharmacy partner onboarding or new pharmacy launches.
  • Familiarity with compounding pharmacy operations.
  • Experience developing implementation playbooks and launch checklists.
  • Experience coordinating user acceptance testing or operational validation.
  • Experience managing post-launch stabilization and incident follow-up.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data privacy and operational compliance requirements.
  • Experience working in a growing SaaS or technology company.

The Senior Systems Developer / Developer III serves as the senior technical lead for the Clarity PPM platform and provides L3 technical support, complex development, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, upgrades, patching, release support, and technical solution design.   • Advanced proficiency with GEL scripting, NSQL, and SQL for complex development, data analysis, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Strong proficiency with XOG, REST APIs, XML, web services, and enterprise application integrations.
  • Advanced experience developing and supporting Clarity custom content, including reports, portlets, workflows, processes, views, and customer-specific functionality.

  • Strong working knowledge of Oracle and/or SQL Server and the ability to perform application-level database analysis without assuming DBA ownership.

Description

MEDvidi is a telepsychiatry platform delivering psychiatric evaluation, medication management, and ongoing behavioral health care to patients in approximately 35 states. We operate through a management services organization supporting affiliated professional corporations, and our clinicians treat conditions that require careful, closely governed prescribing, including controlled substances.

We are now building the commercial insurance infrastructure that will define our next phase of growth. Seeing insured patients and being reimbursed for that care depends on three things moving together: contracts with the right payers, provider credentialing and enrollment in every state we serve, and the operating infrastructure behind them. Each one gates the others. This role brings them under one owner.

About the Role

We are hiring a Head of Payer Strategy & Operations to own MEDvidi’s insurance business end to end, from zero to a scalable, commercially successful offering.

This is a hands-on executive role reporting to the CEO. You will set payer strategy, negotiate with payers, own provider credentialing and enrollment, and define the operational infrastructure needed to see insured patients and get paid, doing much of that work yourself while building the function around you.

You will work daily with Clinical leadership, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and Compliance, and Provider Recruiting. Revenue cycle management sits within Finance with a dotted line to this role. This is a full-time, remote position based in the U.S.

Responsibilities

  • Payer strategy. Map the payer and state landscape: which commercial payers cover the most of our patients and provider licenses, ranked by commercial value; deliver a sequenced contracting roadmap.
  • Payer contracting. Identify, approach, and negotiate with payers on rates, fee schedules, telehealth coverage and parity terms, and codes relevant to psychiatric evaluation and medication management visits. Model contract economics with Finance and set walk-away positions before every negotiation.
  • Payer relationships. Own relationships after signature: escalations, rate renewals, policy changes, network adequacy, and performance reviews.
  • Credentialing and enrollment. Own the end-to-end process across CAQH, payer applications, licensure alignment, and re-attestation; set cycle-time targets and track status by provider, payer, and state. Decide build vs. vendor vs. delegated credentialing, and run the chosen setup.
  • Provider coverage. Work with Provider Recruiting so that hiring and licensing priorities follow payer-state coverage, not the other way round.
  • Billing infrastructure. Define requirements for insurance intake, eligibility verification, claims submission, ERA/EFT, clearinghouse, and billing data across the Patient Portal, Provider Portal, and EHR, and agree priorities with Product and Engineering.
  • Revenue cycle performance. Jointly own RCM KPIs with Finance (clean-claim rate, denial rate, days in A/R, payment posting lag), build payer performance dashboards, and set documentation and coding standards with Clinical and Compliance so visits are billed correctly from the first claim.
  • Commercial and partnerships. Develop a point of view on B2B opportunities and alternative distribution channels, such as employer, health-system, payer-referral, and enterprise partnerships; size them and recommend whether and how to pursue them.
  • Team and vendors. Start as a hands-on builder; hire and lead payer contracting, credentialing, and analytics roles as volume justifies it. Select and manage vendors and advisors (credentialing, clearinghouse, RCM, consulting) against defined SLAs.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in payer strategy, provider or network contracting, or payer-facing leadership in healthcare, including 5+ years in senior leadership.
  • A track record of having done this before: launched or scaled in-network commercial insurance for a provider organization, telehealth, or digital health company, and personally negotiated contracts with national or regional commercial payers.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-state credentialing and enrollment, including CAQH, payer applications, and licensure dependencies.
  • Working knowledge of fee-for-service reimbursement, fee schedules, telehealth coverage and parity, E&M and behavioral health coding, denials and appeals, and core RCM metrics.
  • Financial modeling skills: able to build and defend a contract-economics model with Finance.
  • Comfort operating without a team at the start: a player-coach who builds from zero and reports directly to a CEO.
  • Based in the U.S. and authorized to work in the U.S.; fluent English; able to work core hours across U.S. time zones.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience at a telehealth or digital health company, ideally in behavioral health or psychiatry with medication management.
  • Strategic partnerships or business development experience, including B2B or channel work with payers, employers, or health systems.
  • Medicare Advantage, TRICARE, or Medicaid managed care contracting experience.
  • Payer-side background (network strategy or provider contracting at a health plan) with active relationships.
  • Experience in a professional corporation / management services organization structure.
  • Value-based or outcomes-based contract design experience.
  • MBA, MHA, or J.D.

What we offer

  • Time off: Paid time off (PTO), plus paid sick leave.
  • Wellness: Dedicated wellness days each year to rest and recharge.
  • Retirement: 401(k) with company matching.
  • Health & insurance: QSEHRA eligibility toward medical and dental insurance coverage.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
