00715-26

Mid-Level Sales Associate – IT Solutions

Location and Travel: Remote, with regular travel to client and project sites. Candidates in or near the Warner Robins, Georgia area may be especially well positioned for the role. Significant travel to Huntsville, Alabama may be required.

Career Opportunity
A joint venture is seeking a motivated Mid-Level Sales Associate with federal or Department of Defense IT sales experience to help turn qualified leads into strong client relationships and successful technology opportunities. This client-facing role is ideal for a sales professional who understands government technology needs, communicates business value clearly, and coordinates technical expertise throughout the sales process.
You will take ownership of qualified leads and introductions, lead discovery conversations, assess opportunity fit, and guide viable pursuits through development, proposal preparation, negotiation support, award, or closure. You will work closely with senior leadership, technical personnel, administrative support, and delivery teams while traveling to client and project sites as needed.

What You'll Do
  • Own qualified opportunities: Review lead handoffs, confirm key contacts and stated needs, and establish the next client conversation promptly.
  • Lead technical discovery: Explore each client’s technology environment, operational challenges, requirements, purchasing process, anticipated budget, and timeline.
  • Coordinate technical expertise: Engage joint venture specialists to validate technical fit, feasibility, and the right solution approach.
  • Qualify the pipeline: Evaluate alignment with verified capabilities, access to decision-makers, requirements, and pursuit potential; recommend whether to advance, nurture, or close each opportunity.
  • Build trusted relationships: Engage IT leaders, program managers, procurement contacts, and other stakeholders; translate technical capabilities into business benefits and secure clear next steps.
  • Contribute to opportunity development and proposals: Help shape pursuit strategies, develop proposal content, coordinate presentations and demonstrations, respond to information requests, and manage reviews and submission deadlines with senior leadership and technical personnel.
  • Manage pipeline data: Maintain accurate CRM stages, estimated values, client requirements, timelines, actions, and forecasts; provide weekly updates and flag stalled pursuits or barriers.
  • Support effective handoffs: Share feedback on lead quality, coordinate scheduling, and document awarded scope, commitments, and client contacts for delivery teams.
  • Support negotiations: Participate in pricing discussions and negotiations within delegated authority, securing required approvals before making pricing, technical, or contractual commitments.

What You Bring

  • Professional IT experience and a practical understanding of IT service delivery and technical terminology.
  • Demonstrated sales experience supporting federal government or Department of Defense IT customers and opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead discovery, qualify opportunities, and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating proposals, maintaining accurate CRM records, and managing follow-up across multiple opportunities.
  • Sound judgment, accountability, and the ability to work collaboratively across sales, technical, administrative, and delivery functions.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting federal or DoD IT proposals, capture activities, or solicitation responses.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Exposure to government IT procurement.
  • Experience coordinating technical teams and transitioning newly awarded business to delivery.
Who Will Thrive in This Role
You are consultative, organized, and comfortable discussing technology with both business and technical audiences. You can balance relationship development with disciplined opportunity management, know when to bring in subject-matter experts, and consistently move conversations toward clear decisions and next steps.

Explore This Opportunity
This opportunity offers the chance to build client relationships, contribute directly to opportunity development and proposals, and advance federal and DoD technology pursuits. If you combine government IT sales experience with consultative selling skills and enjoy coordinating people and resources to solve client challenges, we encourage you to explore this remote, travel-based 1099 opportunity supporting a joint venture.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Transformation & Workforce Insights (Location Flexible)
jobs.excerpt: We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential.
jobs.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The Transformation & Workforce Insights Associate Director is a senior practitioner and specialized advisor within RSM’s Enterprise Change Management (ECM) function. The role combines direct change management execution for selected high-priority enterprise initiatives with specialized capabilities in transformation intelligence, workforce impacts, business readiness, adoption measurement, and AI-enabled change analysis.


The position connects initiative-level evidence and cross-portfolio signals to help executives and business leaders make informed decisions about sequencing, sponsorship, capacity, risk, and transformation outcomes. Working with the Enterprise Change Director, the Associate Director implements established ECM standards and contributes to capability development through practical tools, methods, insight, and technical coaching.


The role operates through partnership. Talent, organization design, workforce planning, Digital Solutions, analytics, Communications, Learning, product teams, and business leaders retain ownership of their respective specialist and business decisions.


Core Responsibilities

Direct Priority Change Delivery

  • Personally lead change strategy and execution for selected Tier 1, high-risk, or executive-priority initiatives, with clear ownership of assigned change deliverables and outcomes.
  • Assess initiative complexity, stakeholder and workflow impacts, readiness, adoption risk, and change capacity; recommend fit-for-purpose interventions consistent with the ECM framework and tiered support model.
  • Develop and execute integrated change strategies addressing sponsorship, stakeholder engagement, change impacts, communications, learning, resistance, readiness, adoption, sustainment, and expected business outcomes.
  • Integrate change activities with product, project, technology, implementation, learning, communications, and business plans; track dependencies and escalate material risks with recommended actions.
  • Use evidence, stakeholder feedback, and operational data to adjust interventions and strengthen sustained adoption.

Transformation & Workforce Insights

  • Synthesize change signals across priority initiatives, including readiness, adoption, workforce and role impacts, change saturation, capacity constraints, timing, dependencies, AI implications, and relevant external trends.
  • Identify cross-initiative patterns, overlapping stakeholder populations, collision risks, and opportunities for improved sequencing and enterprise coordination.
  • Partner with data and analytics owners to define decision questions, practical measures, data sources, and reporting requirements; do not duplicate specialist analytics functions.
  • Translate qualitative and quantitative information into concise, executive-ready analysis, options, and recommendations that support sponsorship, capacity, prioritization, and transformation-risk decisions.
  • Partner with Talent, business leaders, and other specialists to surface potential skill, role, organization, and workforce implications while leaving formal workforce-planning and organization-design decisions with accountable owners.

AI, Analytics & Capability Scaling

  • Partner with Digital Solutions and analytics teams to design, pilot, and scale AI-enabled ECM use cases, such as change intelligence, sensing, synthesis, reporting, and practitioner decision support.
  • Promote responsible use of AI and automation to improve delivery speed, consistency, insight, and practitioner effectiveness while preserving appropriate human judgment and review.
  • Develop reusable insight frameworks, assessment instruments, adoption measures, and practical tools that help ECM teams and federated practitioners deliver consistent results.
  • Connect internal change evidence with relevant external workforce, technology, and transformation trends to inform planning and executive foresight.

ECM Standards & Federated Practice Support

  • Apply and operationalize ECM methods, standards, tools, and governance expectations established by the Enterprise Change Director; identify evidence-based opportunities to improve them.
  • Provide subject-matter guidance, technical coaching, and peer review on complex change methods, assessments, readiness, measurement, and related deliverables.
  • Collaborate with embedded and federated change practitioners to share lessons, improve methods, and surface matters requiring enterprise coordination or escalation.
  • Contribute to communities of practice and learning experiences that expand practical change management capability across the firm.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Advisory

  • Build trusted working relationships across lines of business and functions, including Talent, Digital Solutions, Enterprise Project Management, Communications, Learning, Risk, Finance, and operating leadership.
  • Facilitate senior-level working sessions, impact reviews, readiness conversations, and decision forums that clarify implications, trade-offs, ownership, and actions.
  • Present recommendations grounded in business outcomes, operational consequences, stakeholder experience, and credible evidence; influence without relying on formal reporting authority.

Success Measures

  • Selected Tier 1 initiatives have validated change impacts, actionable sponsor engagement, evidence-based readiness decisions, measurable adoption, and effective sustainment.
  • Enterprise leaders receive timely, decision-useful insight into change saturation, workforce impacts, cross-initiative dependencies, readiness, adoption, and transformation risks.
  • Cross-portfolio analysis leads to documented recommendations and improved prioritization, sequencing, or risk mitigation decisions.
  • AI-enabled and reusable ECM methods improve consistency, speed, sensing, and practitioner effectiveness without compromising quality.
  • Federated practitioners have access to stronger methods, coaching, insights, and practical resources.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; education in business, organizational development, human resources, communications, technology, psychology, analytics, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Minimum eight years of progressive experience in organizational change management, transformation, organizational effectiveness, workforce transformation, consulting, strategy execution, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated hands-on leadership of complex, cross-functional or enterprise-scale change initiatives and experience advising senior leaders and executive sponsors.
  • Experience synthesizing quantitative and qualitative evidence, stakeholder feedback, workforce signals, and external trends into practical recommendations.
  • Experience in professional services, public accounting, consulting, or another complex matrixed organization preferred.
  • Change management certification (e.g., Prosci, CCMP, or equivalent) preferred.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Deep practical knowledge of stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, sponsor enablement, communications, learning, readiness, resistance, adoption, sustainment, and measurement.
  • Enterprise perspective, business acumen, strategic judgment, and ability to connect initiative-level findings to broader transformation implications.
  • Strong analytical synthesis, executive storytelling, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority, navigate ambiguity, develop recommendations, and align stakeholders across organizational boundaries.
  • Working understanding of AI-enabled workflows, analytics concepts, workforce trends, and responsible use of emerging technology

jobs.excerpt: About Monterail Monterail is an agentic development company with 130+ experts.
jobs.description:
About Monterail

Monterail is an agentic development company with 130+ experts. The company delivers custom web and mobile applications for fintech, proptech, healthtech, and eCommerce. Since 2010, Monterail has completed 900+ projects globally. Monterail works with recognized global brands including Bosch, DocPlanner, EY, Merck, and SharkNinja. Monterail was recognized by Deloitte and the Financial Times.

About HealthTech at Monterail

For over 15 years, our HealthTech team has been building digital health products with startups, scale-ups and corporate R&D teams: 75+ shipped so far, including 15+ regulated medical devices built for FDA and EU MDR pathways.

We're looking for a salesperson to join our HealthTech team: someone who takes leads from the first call to a signed contract and isn't shy about sharing ideas on how we could sell better.

You'll work directly with Piotr Zając, our HealthTech Director, who leads the division. He'll onboard you and support you along the way, so you'll learn the market, our offer and how we sell to digital health companies.

Requirements

What you'll do

  • Own the full sales cycle for HealthTech leads, both inbound and outbound: from first contact to signed contract.
  • Take over our live European pipeline and own each deal, inbound and outbound, from first contact to signed contract.
  • Build new pipelines with two kinds of clients: health startups and scale-ups, and corporate R&D teams at MedTech and pharma companies. An outreach agency books meetings for you, and you prospect on your own with LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Lead intro and discovery calls: understand the client's product, regulatory context, and business goals, and qualify the opportunity.
  • Prepare estimates and proposals together with our tech leads, designers, and the HealthTech Director.
  • Take over US accounts once our HealthTech Director has opened them, and run them to close. Some calls will be in US hours (late afternoon or evening CET).
  • Work with Piotr Zając, our HealthTech Director, on go-to-market strategy: target segments, messaging, events, and partnerships.
  • Keep Pipedrive and GitHub up to date. It's where the whole team reads the pipeline.

What we're looking for

  • At least 3+ years of proven B2B sales experience in which you personally owned targets and closed deals.
  • At least 1.5 years selling in HealthTech, MedTech, digital health or pharma, plus experience selling IT, software, or digital products, including working on estimates with a tech team.
  • Understanding of how health products are built and sold: you're comfortable talking about medical devices, clinical users, and regulatory requirements (e.g. EU MDR, FDA, HIPAA), even if you're not an expert.
  • Experience with both inbound and outbound, including prospecting and cold outreach.
  • Independence: you can plan your own work, prioritise leads and drive a process without day-to-day supervision.
  • Strategic thinking: you have opinions about markets, ICPs and positioning, and you're happy to discuss and defend them.
  • Fluent English (C1+), written and spoken.
  • Comfortable usage of AI tools every day

Nice to have

  • A network in the European and/or US digital health ecosystem.
  • Experience with regulated products (SaMD, connected medical devices).
  • Experience selling custom software development services (software house or agency).
  • You've worked conferences as a seller: meetings booked before, follow-ups done after.

What we offer

  • A live pipeline on day one.
  • A portfolio that sells: 22 case studies you can name and show, including Elvie, Eargo and Merck. Our HealthTech team includes Untitled Kingdom, the MedTech software house Monterail acquired in 2024.
  • Support from tech leads, designers and regulatory specialists in every proposal.
  • About 2 trips a year to conferences and client meetings in Europe or the US, starting after your first 6 months.
  • A path to leading HealthTech sales as the team grows.

Organisational

Contract: B2B (about 40 hours a week)

Pay: 60-83 PLN hourly net ( ~ 10,000–14,000 net a month)

Ideal Start: January or February 2027

jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - New Jersey Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. We welcome accommodation requests to help make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. Please advise us about accommodation needs at any point by contacting our Recruitment Team at

Job Description Summary

Do you have a strong desire to provide prompt, courteous and fair service to customers? Are you a skilled investigator, negotiator and communicator? If you thrive in an environment where you can problem-solve workers’ compensation claims resolution, while following processes that provide fair resolution, customer satisfaction and cost management, then we want to hear from you!

As a Claims Specialist, you’ll investigate and handle medical and/or loss-of-time workers compensation claims from multiple states to determine compensability, entitled benefits, average weekly wage and benefit rate according to applicable state workers’ compensation statute. We’ll count on you to promote and provide exemplary customer service. Key to success will be your ability to establish timely and appropriate case reserves aligned with Best Practices and manage claims to appropriate resolution. You’ll also communicate frequently with customers, injured workers and medical providers.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides appropriate notices to policyholders and injured employees according to applicable state workers’ compensation statute and obtains appropriate forms and documentation to verify employee/employer relationship and average weekly wage. Completes and files appropriate first and second notice of injury as required by individual state workers’ compensation statute and electronic data interchange reporting regulations.

  • Employs appropriate claims management techniques and direct intervention (e.g., independent medical examinations, referral for rehabilitation, utilization review, etc.) to manage each claim. Maintains contact with policyholders and injured worker and pursues return to work initiatives. Utilizes effective Telephonic Nurse Case Manager or Field Nurse Case Management services to assist with managing medical care and return to work activities. Consults with internal Claims Medical Specialist for future care needs and issues of life expectancy. Evaluates exposures, manages ongoing case reserves in alignment with best practices and negotiates settlements as appropriate. Documents significant activity and decisions in each claim via on-line claim system.

  • Evaluates all pertinent information and works in conjunction with claimant/client to pursue most appropriate claims resolution.

  • Investigates and pursues third party recoveries and any applicable deductibles. May utilize the services of Nationwide recovery unit, and/or partner with designated outside counsel/trial division, or by giving notice of lien to plaintiff counsel handling third party litigation. Claim Zone Field assist referrals and/or outside consulting expert may be utilized to gather, obtain and secure critical information.

  • Manages litigated claim issues in alignment with Best Claims Practices. Obtains appropriate litigation budgets and develops appropriate power of attorney in partnership with counsel. Manages litigation expenses of Nationwide Trial Division or approved outside counsel.

  • Manages assigned claims with little to no direction and oversight. Makes decisions within delegated authority as outlined in company policies and procedures. Adheres to high standards of professional conduct consistent with the delivery of superior service.

  • Submits severe incident reports, reinsurance reports and other information to home office, claims management, and underwriting.

  • Reviews files for Medicare reporting obligations and submits appropriate Medicare query, Ongoing responsibility for Medicals (ORM) and Total Payment Obligation to claimant (TPOC) reports. Responsible for claims involving Medicare Set Aside at time of settlement and which may be funded by a structured settlement.

  • Partners with Special Investigative Unit (SIU) and Subrogation to identify fraud and subrogation opportunities.

  • Delivers a positive customer service experience to all internal, external, current and prospective Nationwide customers.

  • May periodically conduct customer/account visits to review reserves and discuss status of significant claims. May also present educational workshops to client personnel.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Supervisor/Manager. No direct or indirect reports.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies in business administration or related field preferred and/or relevant Workers’ Compensation experience.

License/Certification/Designation: State licensing where required. Successful completion of required/applicable claims certification training/classes.

Experience: Three to five years prior experience in workers’ compensation claims.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Advanced knowledge of insurance theory and practices, insurance contracts and their application. Familiarity with claims processing and claims best practices and procedures preferred. Proven knowledge of insurance contracts, medical terminology, workers compensation, and the legal aspects of court procedures affecting legal liability for all lines of insurance. Knowledge of claims systems. Excellent customer focus and proven ability to proactively meet customer needs. General knowledge of insurance theory and practices, insurance contracts and their application. Familiarity with claims processing and claims best practices and procedures preferred. Knowledge of insurance contracts, medical terminology, workers compensation, and the legal aspects of court procedures affecting legal liability for all lines of insurance. Knowledge of claims systems. Analytical skills necessary to make decisions and resolve conflict in such areas as application of coverage to submitted claims, application of laws of jurisdiction to investigation facts, application of policy exclusions and exceptions. Ability to establish repair requirements and cost estimates for extensive losses and serves as a subject matter expert on respective claims projects. Proven organizational skills to effectively prioritize increased and more complex workloads. Demonstrates strong but flexible standards to balance the conflicting demands of the position. Excellent written and verbal communication skills necessary to effectively communicate and/or negotiate with policyholders, claimants, attorneys, agents, and general public. Demonstrated leadership capabilities to effectively train, coach, and provide feedback to less experienced associates.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Must be willing to work irregular hours and to travel with possible overnight requirements. Must be available to work catastrophes (CAT) requiring travel to CAT site with multiple on-site responsibilities and/or for extended periods of time. Extended and/or non-standard hours as required.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about being part of a team at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales that delivers extraordinary care to help individuals and businesses prepare for and protect their future? If so, then Nationwide Financial could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This Consultant-level role is a high-visibility opportunity to help shape the next generation of life underwriting. The role sits at the intersection of research and development, technology integration, underwriting, and business transformation—with the opportunity to turn new ideas into working capabilities.


You will join a small, highly collaborative team with a start-up mindset inside a large, established organization. The team is hands-on, moves quickly, and works closely with senior leadership, internal technology partners, reinsurance partners, and third-party vendors.

What you will do

  • Help design, test, and implement new underwriting capabilities, tools, and processes.
  • Translate innovation concepts into practical solutions that can be delivered and adopted by underwriting teams.
  • Work directly in the underwriting technology environment, including navigating Workbench and supporting user acceptance testing.
  • Coordinate project activities, manage deadlines, surface risks, and keep work moving from concept through execution.
  • Collaborate with IT, underwriting, data, product, operations, reinsurance, and external technology partners.
  • Contribute to research and development efforts that improve underwriting speed, quality, consistency, and customer experience.
  • Provide a thoughtful voice in project discussions—raising questions, challenging assumptions, and advocating for the right outcome.

What makes this role different

This is not a maintenance-oriented role with a predictable daily rhythm. Priorities may change quickly as new information emerges, and the successful candidate will be comfortable adjusting plans while maintaining focus on the outcome.

The work is transformative and execution-focused. You will help build what comes next while also navigating the practical details required to make change successful in a regulated, complex environment.

What success looks like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted, hands-on partner who can:

  • Move comfortably between strategy, technical details, testing, and execution.
  • Take ownership of projects and follow through on commitments.
  • Build productive relationships with internal and external partners.
  • Speak up with confidence and candor, including with senior leaders.
  • Bring structure to ambiguity without needing every answer defined in advance.
  • Help the team deliver visible progress and create meaningful improvements in life underwriting.

This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.

Job Description Summary

Developing the underwriting strategy and ensuring it meets our risk appetite is essential to Nationwide's profitability and overall success. Our team utilizes our analysis and problem-solving skills to enable solutions that drive underwriting efficiency and streamlined approaches. If you are a creative problem solver, have strategic agility, and are an excellent communicator, we want to know more about you!

As a Consultant, you’ll drive the development and implementation of innovative underwriting strategies and technologies. You will focus on enhancing underwriting processes, improving risk assessment accuracy, and driving efficiency through the adoption of cutting-edge solutions.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Innovation Strategy: Supports the development and execution of plans for underwriting innovation, ensuring alignment with company goals.

  • Technology Integration: Assists in identifying and implementing new technologies to improve underwriting processes and decision-making.

  • Process Improvement: Participates in initiatives to optimize workflows, reduce turnaround times, and enhance customer experience.

  • Data Analytics: Uses data analytics and machine learning to help refine risk assessment models and improve accuracy.

  • Collaboration: Works with cross-functional teams, including IT, data science, product development, and operations, on innovation projects.

  • Training and Development: Provides support and training to underwriting teams on new tools and technologies.

jobs.description:
Applied AI Engineer — Global Health & AI


ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking an Applied AI Engineer to build frontier-model systems for various global health and survey programs. This role will support the development of AI-enabled tools that draft survey reports, let researchers and policymakers analyze data in natural language, translate questionnaires into low-resource languages, and support interviewers and data quality in the field. No tool is adopted unless it matches or beats the expert-led process it replaces. You will build the prompting, agent, and pipeline layer across the program. You will also build the evaluation harnesses that show whether each tool actually works, judged against ground truth produced by some of the most experienced survey methodologists in the world.


This position can be remote within the United States, with occasional travel.


It is contingent upon award of program funding.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build LLM pipelines and agents for survey workflows, including:
    • an AI-assisted data-to-report pipeline
    • natural-language analysis of survey data
    • multilingual questionnaire translation
    • field support tools for interviewers and supervisors
  • Build evaluation harnesses as first-class deliverables. Work with the Technical Lead and survey experts to define acceptance criteria before the work is judged. Build test sets from expert-produced ground truth and run the non-inferiority comparisons that decide whether a tool moves forward.
  • Route work across models based on reasoning complexity, volume, cost, latency, and data-residency requirements.
  • Manage inference cost by tracking token usage, context limits, prompt caching, and batch processing, and account for these operating costs in model-selection decisions.
  • Connect models to data services and to the applications built by full stack developers.
  • Use agentic coding tools to produce software from clear specifications, then review, test, and own the resulting code.
  • Monitor production systems, conduct disciplined error analysis, and report positive and negative results.
  • Document methods and results for public release, including negative results. Help transfer tools to partner-country institutions so they can run them on their own.

Minimum Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent years experience)
  • Minimum 4 years of professional software development experience, including building LLM-powered systems that real users relied on in production
  • U.S. citizenship is required by federal government contract

Additional Required Skills and Experience

  • Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Go) for back-end and AI application development
  • Hands-on experience building with frontier-model APIs (from any provider, or through any cloud platform), including tool use and retrieval-augmented generation
  • Demonstrated experience designing LLM evaluations, including test-set construction, automated and human grading, regression testing, and ship/no-ship decisions.
  • Working knowledge of LLM cost, latency, and model-selection trade-offs
  • Experience building and deploying on a major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
  • Demonstrated experience using agentic coding tools, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, or GitHub Copilot agent mode, to specify, review, test, and take ownership of production code.
  • Experience with agent frameworks and AI evaluation tooling.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with tasks where ground truth came from subject matter experts (for example, statisticians, clinicians, scientists, or methodologists)
  • Experience with grounded generation over structured or tabular data, or with LLM-assisted statistical analysis
  • Experience with multilingual or low-resource-language NLP, translation, or speech
  • Experience deploying open-weight models
  • Experience with sensitive or regulated data, such as health data or human-subjects research
  • Familiarity with model governance, monitoring, and responsible AI practice
  • Experience in global health, international development, or low- and middle-income country settings
  • Public work such as open-source contributions, published evaluations, or technical writing about systems you built undefined

Professional Skills

  • Explains AI trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including funders, survey experts, and partner-government staff
  • Collaborates effectively across disciplines, cultures, time zones, and organizational levels while treating domain experts as the source of truth
  • Communicates uncertainty, limitations, and negative results candidly.Self-motivated
  • Finds ways to add value without a lot of direct supervision

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior GTM Engineer

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITYAt Salesloft, our Senior GTM Engineer is pivotal to turning signals into pipelines. You will be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering, with real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline.

We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, and now we need someone who builds. You will own the systems that connect our data (Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks) to action (Salesloft Rhythm, Marketo, LeanData), turn buying signals into plays reps actually run, and put AI agents to work on the busywork that slows marketing, sales, and CS down.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for building and running the GTM systems that drive the pipeline. Specifically, you will:

  • Build and maintain integrations and workflows across Salesforce, Salesloft, Clari, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, 1mind, and Tines.
  • Write SQL and Python against Snowflake and Databricks to build signal logic, scoring, and data products.
  • Turn usage, intent, job change, pipeline-trigger, and deal-health signals into Rhythm plays, and measure what they produce.
  • Build and run AI agents and automations with logging, guardrails, and a named owner for each one.
  • Keep data clean through deduplication, enrichment waterfalls, field governance, and routing hygiene.
  • Partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.
  • Document everything, so that if you’re out for two weeks, the system keeps running.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role)

  • Move as One: You’ll partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.
  • Evidence over Ego: You’ll measure what your plays produce and retire the signals that don’t perform.
  • Lead from the Front: You’ll own the systems you build from launch through monitoring, with a named owner for each one, and document them so they keep running when you’re out.
  • Make Your Mark: As the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the team, you’ll shape how we turn signals into pipelines and help hire the next GTM Engineer.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FORYou’re a bias-towards-action, results-oriented builder who ships production systems, explains them to a sales leader in plain English, and stays laser-focused on the pipeline. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING

  • 5+ years building in GTM systems (RevOps, marketing ops, sales ops, or GTM engineering), with production builds you can walk us through.
  • Strong SQL and working Python or JavaScript, and comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience, plus at least two of: Marketo, LeanData, Salesloft or Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Snowflake.
  • Experience with a workflow or iPaaS tool such as Tines, Tray, Workato, or n8n.
  • You’ve shipped something with LLMs or agents that real people rely on every day.
  • You can explain a build to a sales leader in plain English and tie it to the pipeline.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience with dbt, reverse ETL (Census, Hightouch), or Databricks.
  • Experience with Clay or ZoomInfo GTM Studio.
  • You’ve been through a merger or a CRM migration.
  • A background in marketing ops or RevOps before moving into engineering.

THE TEAMYou’ll be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering. We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, so you’ll have real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline. You’ll hear “Yes, let’s do that!” and then have the opportunity to execute on your ideas.

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital's measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup.

You'll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones.
  • Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts.
  • Build and automate a data quality process. Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out.
  • Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query.
  • Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts.
  • Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client's own layer.
  • Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex's AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them.

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size.
  • Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code.
  • Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control.
  • Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases.
  • Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic.
  • An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results.
  • Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer.
  • Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust.
  • Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users.

Helpful but not required

  • Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift).
  • Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data.
  • Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools.
  • Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role
  • Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources.
  • Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source.
  • Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages.
  • Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps.
  • Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround
  • AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup.
  • Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout.
  • Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
    • Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

R1 is seeking a Senior Director, Technical Product Marketing to articulate the technical foundations, architecture, and innovation behind Phare OS, the company's agentic Revenue Operating System. This leader will translate complex platform capabilities into clear, credible narratives for CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects, data and AI leaders, strategic customers, analysts, investors, and executive stakeholders.


The role is less about owning the market positioning of individual Phare OS solutions and more about explaining how the platform works, why its architecture matters, and how its technical elements create durable value. The Senior Director will connect product architecture to customer and business outcomes while maintaining the depth and precision expected by sophisticated technical audiences.


Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Corporate Strategy, Investor Relations, Sales, and portfolio product marketers, this leader will shape platform-level technical content, executive and investor communications, and high-impact product demonstrations. The ideal candidate combines technical fluency, strategic judgment, and exceptional storytelling, with the ability to move comfortably from an architecture discussion with engineers to a boardroom or investor presentation.


Key Responsibilities

Technical platform narrative

  • Develop and maintain the technical narrative for Phare OS and its foundational capabilities, including the Data Platform, Phare Intelligence, Payer Atlas, agentic AI, workflow orchestration, interoperability, and command-center experiences.
  • Explain how shared data, intelligence, governance, and orchestration work together across the platform, avoiding isolated feature-by-feature storytelling.
  • Translate architecture, product roadmaps, and engineering concepts into clear narratives that connect technical design choices to scalability, trust, workflow performance, and customer outcomes.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to ensure technical claims, diagrams, terminology, and proof points are accurate, differentiated, and supportable.

Technical buyer engagement

  • Create audience-specific messaging and content for CIOs, CTOs, chief digital officers, enterprise architects, AI and data leaders, security stakeholders, and revenue cycle technology teams.
  • Develop technical presentations, architecture overviews, white papers, FAQs, solution briefs, and executive briefings that support evaluation of platform maturity, extensibility, integration, governance, and AI strategy.
  • Support strategic customer conversations, executive briefing sessions, technical workshops, and high-value sales engagements where platform depth and credibility are essential.

Investor, analyst, and executive communications

  • Partner with Executive Leadership, Corporate Strategy, Finance, and Investor Relations to explain R1's technology strategy, platform investments, innovation roadmap, and sources of technical differentiation.
  • Develop concise, evidence-based materials for investor presentations, earnings-support content, board discussions, analyst briefings, and executive thought leadership.
  • Build narratives that help non-product audiences understand the relationship between technology investment, platform reuse, product expansion, operational leverage, and long-term enterprise value without overstating product readiness or outcomes.

Product demonstration strategy

  • Partner with Product Management, Design, Engineering, and Sales to define the narrative arc for strategic Phare OS demonstrations.
  • Transform product demos from feature walkthroughs into coherent stories that show how data, intelligence, agents, workflows, and human expertise work together across the revenue cycle.
  • Create reusable demo frameworks, scripts, talk tracks, proof points, and audience-specific variants for customer meetings, executive briefings, analyst sessions, investor events, and industry conferences.
  • Establish demo-readiness standards and ensure demonstrations accurately reflect available capabilities, roadmap items, data requirements, and implementation realities.

Launch and portfolio partnership

  • Partner with portfolio product marketers on launches and commercialization, providing the technical storyline behind major capabilities, releases, and platform investments.
  • Equip sales, enablement, communications, and marketing teams with technically credible content that connects individual products to the broader Phare OS architecture.
  • Monitor developments in healthcare AI, agentic systems, data platforms, interoperability, revenue cycle technology, and enterprise software architecture, translating relevant shifts into recommendations for Product and Marketing leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, marketing, business, or a related field; advanced technical or business degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of B2B enterprise technology experience, including significant experience in technical product marketing, platform marketing, solution marketing, product strategy, or a closely related function.
  • Demonstrated ability to market complex SaaS, cloud, data, analytics, AI, automation, or platform technologies to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, agentic systems, data platforms, APIs, integration patterns, cloud architecture, security, governance, and enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Experience developing technical demonstrations and working directly with product managers, engineers, designers, architects, sales engineers, and executive leaders.
  • Exceptional writing, presentation, and public-speaking skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity without sacrificing technical accuracy.
  • Healthcare technology, payer-provider, or revenue cycle management experience strongly preferred.

Leadership Profile

  • Technical translator: earns credibility with product and engineering teams while making complex ideas understandable and relevant.
  • Strategic storyteller: connects architecture and innovation to business, customer, and investor value.
  • Collaborative operator: influences across functions without relying on direct authority and brings structure to ambiguous, cross-functional work.
  • Trusted steward: distinguishes current capability from roadmap vision and builds confidence through precision, transparency, and sound judgment.

Measures of Success

  • A clear, consistent, and technically credible Phare OS platform narrative adopted across executive, customer, analyst, and investor communications.
  • Higher-quality strategic demos that connect technical capabilities to differentiated customer and business outcomes.
  • Stronger engagement and confidence among technical buyers during platform evaluations and executive briefings.
  • Improved alignment across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Strategy, and Investor Relations on how R1 communicates its technology investments and roadmap.

The role in a nutshell:

The Client Success Advisor plays a critical role in building and sustaining strong, long‑term relationships across a portfolio of small to mid‑sized clients who currently leverage a limited set of Safeguard Global services but demonstrate meaningful near‑term growth potential. As the client’s primary point of contact, the Advisor develops a deep understanding of each client’s business, translating their goals into actionable plans that drive satisfaction, retention, product adoption, and expansion. Managing a portfolio of 20–50 clients utilizing 1–2 services, the Client Success Advisor partners cross‑functionally to ensure successful service delivery, mitigate risks, and identify opportunities that support both client success and Safeguard Global’s revenue growth.


How you will make a difference:

  • Establish client relationships with operating and senior level contacts (CHRO/CFO, VPs, Directors, Global Mobility, etc.) for each account within assigned client portfolio.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, and long‑term goals, and translate that insight into success plans that drive meaningful outcomes. This includes defining desired results, identifying risks, establishing governance, and guiding adoption—ultimately turning client needs into actionable initiatives that strengthen partnership value and support revenue growth.
  • Provide timely and accurate response to client queries using all appropriate communication methods and ensuring documentation in customer service tool while maintaining CRM activities in Salesforce to provide visibility of client KPIs.
  • Develop and demonstrate a holistic understanding of Safeguard Global’s service suite to educate clients on advanced product capabilities, roadmap items, and best practices to maximize adoption and value.

jobs.excerpt: About the role: The Trainer and Content Developer is a member of the Altium Training team responsible for delivering high quality, industry leading training on Altium Designer and related solutions.
jobs.description:
About the role:

The Trainer and Content Developer is a member of the Altium Training team responsible for delivering high quality, industry leading training on Altium Designer and related solutions. This role combines certified Instructor Led Training delivery with active participation in training content development, reviewing, and ongoing maintenance across both ILT (instructor-led training) and on-demand formats.

This position is intended for an experienced PCB design professional with strong hands on Altium Designer experience who is comfortable delivering technical training to professional engineering audiences. The role requires a high level of technical competence, strong communication skills, and the ability to deliver consistent, high quality training experiences aligned with approved course content and learning objectives.

Customer training is a critical component of Altium’s long term success. This role directly supports customer adoption and best practice usage through professional, technically accurate, and engaging training delivery.

A day in the life of our Trainer and Content Developer:

Training Delivery

  • Deliver certified Instructor Led Training across the full Altium training portfolio, both online and onsite.
  • Complete and maintain certification across all ILT courses prior to independent delivery.
  • Deliver training using approved course materials and defined learning objectives.
  • Demonstrate Altium Designer workflows and features using practical, real world experience and knowledge.
  • Adapt delivery style to suit different customer experience levels while maintaining consistency.
  • Represent Altium professionally in all customer interactions.

Technical Expertise

  • Maintain strong hands on proficiency with Altium Designer, including advanced functionality.
  • Apply real world PCB and system design experience to contextualise training content.
  • Stay current with product updates and changes relevant to delivered training.

Content Development and Support

  • Contribute to the development, review, and maintenance of ILT and on-demand training content.
  • Assist with creating and reviewing storyboards and scripts for on-demand training, including voiceover scripts.
  • Capture training videos and audio recordings when required, following defined standards.
  • Review training materials, recorded videos, and supporting assets for technical accuracy.
  • Update existing content to align with new releases, platform changes, and evolving best practices.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Work collaboratively with internal teams involved in training delivery and content development.
  • Communicate clearly regarding content readiness, preparation status, and assigned tasks.
  • Participate in reviews, pilots, and continuous improvement activities related to training quality.

Who We’re Looking For:

  • US citizenship is required due to potential training delivery on military bases.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Five + years of hands on experience using Altium Designer in professional environments.
  • Five + years of PCB and system level design experience.
  • Strong verbal communication, presentation, and technical writing skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to engineering audiences.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects effectively.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Willingness to travel as required for onsite customer training, including travel outside of the United States.

Preferred

  • Previous experience delivering technical training, both onsite and online.
  • Experience supporting instructional content development or reviewing.
  • Familiarity with video capture tools such as Camtasia.
  • Experience using AI based tools for voiceover or media production.
  • Exposure to structured instructional or technical documentation workflows.

Working Conditions:

  • Remote US
  • Travel required for onsite customer training as needed.

When not traveling, time will be split between online training delivery, content development

The salary range for this role is $118,000 to $141,000. Actual compensation packages within this range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate and role requirements, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
HubSpot is looking for a Customer Success Manager who is interested in interested in leading with AI to deliver customer value, build long-lasting relationships, and help customers unlock their full HubSpot potential to achieve their goals. Customer Success Managers are the trusted inbound advisors for each of their customers. They have an intimate understanding of how their businesses work and what the businesses need to grow and thrive. In working with your customers, you will find that no two of them are the same. In the morning, you could be working with the Marketing Manager at a carpet manufacturer about how to rank for the keyword “stain resistant carpet” through more effective blogging. In the afternoon, you could be talking to the CMO of a software company about how to convert more of their free trials into customers through marketing automation and the sales platform.

This role is open is open fully remote, hybrid or in our Dublin office

In this Role you’ll get to:

  • Manage 150 – 180 customer relationships. Some of your customers will be new while others may have been using HubSpot for several years.
  • Work with your customers on a regular basis to understand their goals and aligning them with the necessary resources to achieve them.
  • Partner with different teams at HubSpot to 'solve for the customer' including onboarding, up-sell/x-sell, and renewals. Along the way, you will get to know HubSpot’s software incredibly well and help your customers fully adopt the platform.
  • Your day-to-day is a mix of proactive and reactive work, and CSMs have a lot of autonomy in managing their “book of business”. The proactive work includes 4-5 scheduled deep-dive meetings per day with customers, where you review their progress, make strategic and tactical recommendations, and keep them up to date on the latest and greatest features from HubSpot. The reactive work runs the gamut from questions about invoices to “how to” questions about the software
  • Promote the growth of your install base by uncovering, scoping and qualifying opportunities where customers can use more Hubspot products and services to ensure customer retention and growth
  • Understand technical roadblocks and make recommendations on solution implementation and core integrations using Hubspot to overcome them

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

jobs.description:
Summary

We're looking for a Next Gen Operations Coordinator to support two busy Senior Directors who lead partner Next Generation (Next Gen) teams and help with cross-functional coordination across teams and administrative support.

Flexibility to travel and work across different time zones required.
