  • Report to the Impact Operations Senior Coordinator and exercise judgement to keep your work aligned with wider Impact team objectives and timelines, while supporting both Senior Directors’ day to day.

  • Be the connective tissue for the Next Gen teams and other teams (larger Impact, Operations, People and Culture teams) in the organization.
  • Design, implement, and maintain cross-team systems to seamlessly coordinate conferences and event participation, cross-team collaboration, and engagement with external parties.
  • Own and develop the cadence and facilitation of cross-functional meetings, establishing clear agendas and action steps to optimize participant time and outcomes.

  • Drive end-to-end organization of professional development workshops, team deep dives, and specialized staff training programs.

3. Growth Opportunities

  • Identify, propose, and take ownership of special projects and team support.
  • Participate in Impact efforts by providing project management and other support.
  • Attend and represent Canopy at select events.
  • Drive the follow-through and organizational clarity that lets the Senior Directors operate at their highest level.
  • Ensure the Next Generation teams have strong visibility into priorities and progress to function as a cohesive unit.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Three to five years in executive assistant, operations coordinator, or leadership support roles in a complex and fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable in a remote-work environment; tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools.
  • Experience working in sustainability, forest conservation, supply chains, or mission-driven environments is an asset.
  • Exceptionally organized and dependable.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions oriented.
  • A thoughtful, clear, and influential communicator.
  • Embrace a “Yes, AND...” mindset to foster innovation and collaboration
  • A sense of humour!

Assets

  • Experience with Asana or similar project management tools.
  • Environmental experience and/or interest.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a cover letter which includes a separate response to the prompt below. Applications missing either the cover letter or the prompt response will not be considered. Please keep your response to 300–400 words.

Describe a specific situation where you had to support a busy leader navigating competing priorities. Using the STAR method, introduce the situation and challenges. Be sure to detail your internal logic, the frameworks or tools you used to triage the issues and summarize the quantifiable results.

On AI use and authenticity: You may use AI tools to brainstorm, edit, or proofread, but please do not use AI to write your cover letter. We want to hear your voice, experiences, and perspective. If you use AI for minor editing, add a short note at the end of your cover letter (e.g., "I used [tool name] to proofread this response"). Applications written in a genuine, original voice will be prioritized.

Canopy is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those underrepresented in the sector. If you require accommodations at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. All applications are treated in confidence. We thank all applicants; however, we will only contact candidates selected for an interview.

If you love to optimize operations by proactively supporting directors and busy teams, this role is for you!

Canopy is a solutions-driven not-for-profit environmental organization dedicated to protecting forests, species, and the climate. For more than 25 years, we've been transforming wood-based supply chains, from publishing and packaging to fashion and textiles, to eliminate fibre from the world's most critical forests and help secure a thriving planet for all.

We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

Operations Readiness Lead, PV & BESS

About this role

As an Operations Readiness Lead, PV & BESS on Intersect's Operations team, you'll ensure our utility-scale solar, battery storage, substation, and transmission facilities are built for safe, reliable, long-term operation well before they leave construction. Bringing an operator's lens to early design and equipment decisions, you will guide projects from engineering review through commissioning and final handover into commercial operations.

In close partnership with Engineering, Development, Construction, Asset Management, and external EPCs and OEMs, you will verify testing milestones, close critical deficiencies, and establish operational infrastructure—from EMS/SCADA interfaces to CMMS readiness and safety protocols. Your work directly protects asset performance and builds long-run value across our clean energy fleet. This role is planned to start in December 2026.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition. The Operations team bridges development, engineering, and construction with long-term asset stewardship to ensure our utility-scale power infrastructure operates safely and at peak reliability. Joining this team means shaping how multi-hundred-megawatt solar and storage projects transition into commercial service, giving you the opportunity to influence fleet-wide standards and grow alongside dedicated industry experts.

What you'll do

Influence Early Design and Equipment Selection

  • Critique PV, BESS, substation, and transmission engineering drawings and specifications early in the lifecycle to embed operability, maintainability, and safety.

  • Deliver operational feedback on major equipment selections, including modules, trackers, inverters, main power transformers, battery enclosures, PCS, EMS/SCADA, and fire protection systems.

Drive Commissioning Verification and Quality Assurance

  • Partner with E&C, commissioning, and testing teams to monitor construction progress and escalate risks impacting operational readiness.

  • Witness and evaluate Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and commissioning milestones while driving rigorous punch-list and deficiency closure.

  • Direct and manage comprehensive quality inspections across all solar facility assets.

Lead Operations Handover and System Readiness

  • Define and verify commercial handover deliverables, encompassing O&M procedures, spare parts inventories, specialized tooling, site training, CMMS configuration, and as-built documentation.

  • Align EMS/SCADA, substation controls, and grid/market interface requirements across Operations and Asset Management.

Institutionalize Continuous Improvement Across the Fleet

  • Capture construction, commissioning, and early-operations lessons learned and codify them into updated technical standards for future clean energy projects.

  • Manage multiple concurrent project integrations, keeping cross-functional leadership aligned on readiness status, technical risks, and mitigation plans.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with utility-scale solar PV, BESS, substation, and transmission systems across engineering, construction, commissioning, or operations

  • PMP certification preferred.

  • Proven track record bridging construction and operations on large-scale power projects, including managing FAT/SAT verification, commissioning documentation, and commercial handover.

  • Strong working knowledge of PV and BESS electrical architectures, PCS, transformers, EMS/SCADA integration, and CMMS implementation.

  • Familiarity with applicable electrical and BESS safety codes and standards (such as NEC, IEEE, NERC, NFPA 855, and UL 9540A), including thermal runaway mitigation and fire protection design.

  • Proficiency in reading and redlining complex electrical and mechanical engineering drawings and technical specifications.

  • Self-directed, detail-oriented approach with the communication skills to align EPCs, vendors, and internal teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Commitment to operational excellence, safety, and collaborative problem-solving, aligned with Intersect's values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Total Rewards

Total Compensation: $221,000- $260,000 (total compensation includes base salary + bonus in USD)

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance available for employees and dependents

Family support: Up to 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave; access to family planning and family care support through Maven

Financial support: Generous 401(k) and RRSP retirement plans

jobs.excerpt: WHAT WE DONitrogen equips financial advisors with a suite of AI-powered products that showcase the value of their advice so they can attract clients and keep them fearless.
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Nitrogen equips financial advisors with a suite of AI-powered products that showcase the value of their advice so they can attract clients and keep them fearless. Since launching Riskalyze in 2011, we've been on a mission to create what we call Catalyst Moments — those powerful instances when an advisor leads a client from confused and fearful to confident and fearless.

Nitrogen is a connected suite of advisor products designed to showcase the value of advice in every client meeting. Combining agentic AI with Risk Alignment, Insurance Alignment, Investment Research, Income Planning, Tax Intelligence, and Legacy Planning, with trusted, deterministic analytics to turn complex financial insights into persuasive visuals. The result: clearer conversations, stronger relationships, and advisors who can prove their value in every client meeting.

Trusted by tens of thousands of advisors, backed by an industry-leading Net Promoter Score of 71, and the first wealthtech company to earn ISO 42001 certification, Nitrogen is built on fifteen years of advisor data and half a trillion dollars in assets on platform. We invented the Risk Number®, built on a Nobel Prize-winning academic framework, and we champion the Fearless Investing Movement — because a world empowered to invest fearlessly starts with empowered advisors.

WHY DESIGN MATTERS AT NITROGEN

The last mile of financial advice isn't more data; it's clarity. It's the moment someone goes from confused to fearless. At Nitrogen, we help financial advisors showcase the value of advice in every client interaction. A lot of that comes down to great design. An advisor can have powerful analytics, but if their client can't understand what it means for their future, it doesn't really help them. Our job is to make that part clear, so clients walk away feeling confident.

Three principles guide how we design and build at Nitrogen:

  • AI does the work. Nucleus™, our AI engine, doesn't just summarize or make suggestions. It takes action for advisors. You'll help design how that works, so advisors understand what it's doing, when it needs their input, and how to stay in control.
  • Connected intelligence makes the work right. Our analytics are grounded in proven methodology, not AI-generated math, and our products are designed to work better together. You'll help create the shared patterns and connected experiences that make the whole suite feel cohesive.
  • Persuasive visuals make the client feel it. You'll turn complex financial data into visuals that help clients understand where they stand, see the value of advice, and feel confident about what's next.

THE ROLE

This is a chance to help shape what AI-native financial advice looks like. You'll have a real voice in product decisions, room to experiment with new ways of working, and the opportunity to set a high bar for design in a complex product that advisors rely on every day. Our advisors love Nitrogen, and it shows in our Net Promoter Score of 71.

We're a small design team with a well-structured process that moves fast. Every designer owns real parts of the product from start to finish. As Nitrogen’s Senior Product Designer, Design Systems, you'll own the system libraries that our product and brand teams rely on. But this opportunity is more than maintaining a component library. It's about making it possible for anyone at Nitrogen (designers, engineers, marketers and agents) to build experiences that look, feel and work like Nitrogen, without the design team driving every change. How we build software is changing. More people can create than ever before. That makes design judgment more important, not less. AI agents build from the system every day, so it has to be clear enough for a person and structured enough for AI tools to build from accurately. It also keeps what an advisor sees in the app and what a prospect sees from our marketing team feeling like one cohesive experience.

You don't need an extensive background in wealth management to be a great fit. Most of us didn't either when we started. We have insurance experts, CFPs, and people who've built advisor tools for over a decade on the team, and they'll help get you up to speed fast. What matters more is your curiosity, your ability to make complex ideas clear, high standards for your own work, and your drive to make a real impact.

We're a fully remote team spanning Poland to California, and we welcome applicants across time zones in the US. Our core collaboration hours are Monday through Friday, 10am to 2pm ET, and you'll need to be reliably available during that time to collaborate with teammates, including our engineers in Poland. Some of our most valuable work happens during these overlapping hours, when we can work through problems, make decisions, and move ideas forward together quickly in real time. You won't be in meetings the entire time, but we do expect you to be available to collaborate during that window. Outside those hours, you have the flexibility to manage your own focused design time. We trust you to work with strong accountability, autonomy, and a commitment to delivering results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Elevate Nitrogen's visual and interaction design. Raise the bar for typography, hierarchy, density, motion, responsive behavior, accessibility and the states beyond the happy path.
  • Own the product design system. Build components, tokens, patterns and documentation, kept in sync with code alongside our engineers. Decide what to preserve, evolve, simplify or replace based on what builders and customers need.
  • Make great design reproducible. Encode what makes Nitrogen's product and brand assets great, so people and agents can produce coherent, usable, on-brand experiences by default.
  • Make the system easier for AI to build from. You'll work with engineers to structure components and tokens, write the documentation and context files, and connect tools like Code Connect and Storybook MCP so AI dev agents build our UI accurately. You'll measure it with benchmarks and UI quality trends.
  • Reimagine what a design system can be. Expand the system beyond components and tokens into composition, interaction patterns, agent guidance and evaluations.
  • Shape the shared AI patterns for Nucleus: how it shows progress, keeps the advisor in control, handles uncertainty, mistakes and partial failures, asks for permission and hands work back to a person.
  • Own our brand libraries. Build templates that let marketers create on-brand social posts, emails, one-pagers and case studies on their own.
  • Enhance the client experience. Turn dense client-facing deliverables like reports into something a client understands and trusts, in a way that holds up under any advisor's brand and colors.
  • Prototype early and often. AI prototyping is a core part of how we work. We use Figma, v0, Claude and Devin every day. You'll run system-quality checks in design reviews and do last-mile polish in code when that's the fastest path.

Requirements

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design skills. Your work shows attention to detail and an ability to make complex experiences feel simple. You have sharp taste and strong opinions about typography, hierarchy, interaction and motion.
  • Design system ownership. Deep systems thinking and experience building systems that others actually adopt. You can show how your work improved both their speed and the quality of what shipped.
  • Active use of AI in your design workflow. You're deeply curious about AI and already using it to change how you work. You prototype with it as a habit, and a static mockup is no longer your main artifact. You understand where AI helps, where it fails and how to improve its output.
  • Systems built for people and AI. You know how to structure tokens, name components and write documentation so AI tools can use them. You've turned design principles into practical guidance, reusable patterns and quality checks that work at scale.
  • Client-facing design experience. You've designed things that end up in front of a non-expert, like reports, proposals, statements or onboarding, and made complex information feel simple and on brand.
  • Curiosity and a bias toward learning. You can get your head around an unfamiliar domain quickly, identify what you need to learn, and use research, experimentation, and real feedback to guide your next move.
  • Conviction and humility. You're willing to ask hard questions, experiment, and advocate for what you believe is right. You're just as willing to listen, take feedback, and change your mind when you learn something new.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience designing and shipping agentic AI features, with patterns reused across more than one product or team.
  • Experience with a multi-brand system where one set of components carries many brands, or with connecting product and brand experiences.
  • Experience with a major redesign, a design system modernization or a company-wide change in how teams build.
  • Experience designing investing, finance, or insurance products. You’re the one who's always tinkering with the newest AI tool on the weekend or the friend people ask about their 401(k).

The expected compensation range for this role is a $140k-$150k + annual bonus target.

Lesser experience may result in lower compensation and greater experience may result in greater compensation than the stated range.

Nitrogen is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We are committed to being fair and intentional in our hiring decisions by reviewing every application thoroughly.

Benefits

Financial Benefits & Perks

  • 4% 401(k) Match. Our employees invest so much in our company and we love getting to invest in them. The company will match your contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to 4% of your total annual compensation.
  • Free Financial Planning Services. By working at a financial technology company, you get the benefit of fantastic financial advice. This is offered to all employees wanting expert guidance on how to handle their money.

Health & Family

  • Medical, Dental & Vision insurance plans. We want to help keep you (and your family) healthy! Comprehensive health insurance options for you & your family.
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) available depending on chosen medical plan. We know that investment risk isn’t a one-size-fits all and neither are your health savings options!
  • Generous maternity & paternity leave for either the birth or adoption of a child. Mom's & Dad's need time with their new family members!
  • Discounted pet insurance available. Pets are family too!!

Time Away & Culture

  • 3 weeks vacation & 1 week sick time per year.Take the time you need for fun or simply time to recover from not feeling well.
  • 11 paid company holidays per year. Enjoy your time off; you deserve it!
  • Remote & in-person team building activities help our employees stay connected and engaged. We absolutely love to hype our people up!
  • Company wide meetings held by our CEO benefit all employees by keeping everyone in the loop. We are one team, and we tackle projects together.
  • Employee development is our priority. From leadership training, to mentorship, to industry resources, we care about progressing you in your career.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

While you can learn a lot from a job description, you may have more questions, and that’s totally okay! We encourage all individuals interested in working at Nitrogen to learn more about us by checking us out on our website and social media platforms:

jobs.excerpt: Top 3 Reasons To Join Us• 100% remote, with a global, diverse team • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers About UsAt CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader
  • Lead and shape how an AI-native security function finds and prevents vulnerabilities at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world’s leading insurers

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Paid Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted the content of CoverGo’s Privacy Notice and you consent to the processing of your data as part of this application.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

Role overview

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive for ANZ, you will own and grow GitLab’s enterprise relationships across Australia. You’ll help large organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform through strategic, consultative SaaS sales. You’ll engage customers on how Agentic AI, AI orchestration, and integrated security can support secure software development and business outcomes. You’ll lead the end-to-end sales cycle—from territory and account planning, prospecting, and qualification through complex deal execution, deployment, adoption, and long-term expansion.

Reporting to our Regional Sales Director, you’ll take a customer-centric approach to understanding complex business and technical needs, guiding customers through evaluation, and coordinating pre- and post-sales resources to achieve successful deployments and measurable business outcomes.

You’ll operate with minimal supervision on complex enterprise opportunities, act as the voice of the customer within GitLab, and partner closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified pipeline and win new customers. In your first year, you’ll establish and execute account plans for enterprise prospects and customers across ANZ, build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and manage your pipeline and forecast with transparency and discipline.

What you’ll do

  • Support GitLab’s strategic prospects and customers in the ANZ Market, owning the full sales cycle for large and enterprise accounts
  • Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals
  • Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers
  • Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products
  • Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management
  • Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels
  • Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements

What you’ll bring

  • Experience managing complex sales cycles with ANZ large, strategic enterprise customers.
  • Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management.
  • Familiarity with software development concepts and tools; exposure to Git, software development tools, DevSecOps, application lifecycle management, Agentic AI, AI orchestration, or software and application security is preferred.
  • Proficiency in consultative, solution, value-based, and consumption-based selling—including discovery, uncovering business needs, aligning solutions to customer outcomes, driving product adoption and expansion, and delivering persuasive proposals and presentations.
  • Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion
  • Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes
  • Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to share customer feedback and lessons learned with sales management, product, marketing, and technical teams
  • Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly

About the team

The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the ANZ market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.

Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.

  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.

  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Marlboro Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

This role supports the Research IT and Data Governance (ITDG) group’s enterprise AI activities focused on research portfolio analysis, operational reporting, AI-enabled analytics, and development of scalable data capabilities supporting research, policy, and operational decision-making.

The Data Analyst will support data analysis, reporting, statistical programming, and analytics activities associated with strategic AI initiatives, research operations, and enterprise modernization efforts. The position will work closely with technical teams, project managers, operational leadership, and stakeholders to support data integration, reporting automation, AI pilot initiatives, and analytics-driven operational improvements.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analyst with experience working directly with healthcare or research data, applying statistical modeling and evaluation methods, and producing descriptive reporting that supports research and operational decision-making.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), 100% remote position. It is currently funded through September 29, 2027 under the current contract period of performance, with potential for extension into the next option year based on contract continuation and program needs.

This position may be filled at the Data Analyst – Junior or Data Analyst – Senior level. Level and salary will be determined commensurate with the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support analytics and reporting activities associated with enterprise AI, research, and operational modernization initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, data visualizations, and operational analytics supporting leadership decision-making.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation, analysis, validation, and reporting activities across multiple enterprise data sources, including VA data sources.
  • Support development and optimization of ETL workflows, reporting processes, and analytics activities.
  • Conduct statistical programming and modeling, program evaluation, and descriptive and operational reporting supporting research and organizational priorities.
  • Support AI-enabled analytics initiatives, including activities involving large language models (LLMs), retrieval workflows, and operational data analysis.
  • Assist with development of scalable analytics workflows and rapid testing approaches to improve operational efficiency and reporting responsiveness.
  • Support integration and analysis of data from research systems, operational platforms, databases, and cloud-based environments.
  • Collaborate with technical and operational stakeholders to support AI pilots, analytics initiatives, and reporting priorities.
  • Support data quality management, validation, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Prepare summaries, presentations, dashboards, and executive-level reporting materials for technical and non-technical audiences.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, computer science, healthcare informatics, mathematics, public health, or a related field.
  • 3+ years (Junior level) or 8+ years (Senior level) of experience supporting data analytics, reporting, statistical programming, or enterprise data operations in a complex organization.
  • Experience with SQL and at least one statistical programming language (R, Python, or SAS), along with ETL processes, databases, and analytics/reporting environments.
  • Hands-on experience applying statistical modeling and evaluation methods (e.g., regression, trend, or cost-effectiveness analysis), as well as descriptive reporting.
  • Experience developing reports and data visualizations that communicate analytic findings.
  • Experience supporting cloud-based analytics, data warehouse, or data lake environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights.
  • Experience supporting data quality management and validation activities.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting VA, VHA, federal healthcare, research, or enterprise analytics environments.
  • Familiarity with VA data systems such as the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW) and VistA.
  • Familiarity with analytics and dashboarding tools and platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Palantir Foundry.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML technologies, large language models (LLMs), retrieval workflows, or AI-enabled analytics.
  • Familiarity with REDCap, healthcare data systems, or research data environments.
  • Experience supporting operational analytics, portfolio analysis, or reporting modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, matrixed environments supporting multiple concurrent priorities.
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and mature judgment in handling sensitive information.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager — Contract
Overview
The Senior Product Manager will support our AI & Automation initiatives and strengthen product execution across IsI’s Security Control, Facility Control, and CMMC Control products. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Product, you will partner with Engineering, Support, and business stakeholders to turn customer needs and operational challenges into clearly prioritized, actionable work.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with independent prioritization within assigned areas and responsibility for coaching other Product Managers. You will build a strong understanding of our systems, improve intake and delivery practices, and reduce avoidable interruptions that pull teams away from their priorities. As your product and industry knowledge develops, you will contribute to roadmap and strategic decisions.
You will also bring the project management discipline needed to keep cross-functional work moving: establish clear owners and milestones, coordinate dependencies, communicate progress, and escalate risks early. You will hold stakeholders accountable for decisions and commitments while adapting plans as priorities and constraints change.
Success in this role is measured by stronger execution: clearer priorities, better-defined requirements, fewer recurring questions and unnecessary escalations, and work that delivers measurable customer and business value to drive efficiency gains and EBITDA impact.
Key Responsibilities
Product Knowledge and Business Understanding
Develop a strong working understanding of our products, customers, internal service workflows, and technical dependencies. Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand how our systems support security management, facility clearance workflows, cybersecurity compliance, and service delivery. Use this knowledge to assess requests, identify gaps, and make informed product decisions.
Intake, Triage, and Prioritization
Own intake and triage within assigned areas, turning requests from Support, Engineering, customers, and internal stakeholders into clear problems and actionable next steps. Prioritize against customer impact, business value, urgency, effort, and risk. Make tradeoffs visible, sequence work against available capacity, and escalate decisions when broader alignment is needed.
Requirements and Delivery
Translate ambiguous requests into clear scope, lightweight product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Partner with Engineering and QA to refine work, resolve questions, and validate results. Establish milestones and delivery expectations with the teams doing the work, and follow initiatives through release and adoption.
Process Improvement and Focus
Improve how requests, questions, and decisions move through the product organization. Establish practical intake, documentation, and communication practices that reduce repeated questions, unnecessary meetings, and avoidable interruptions. Help teams distinguish urgent issues from work that can follow normal prioritization, and address recurring sources of reactive work.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Build trusted relationships with Engineering, Support, and business stakeholders. Clarify ownership, set expectations, and resolve competing needs through direct communication and sound judgment. Challenge proposed solutions when a clearer understanding of the problem could lead to a better outcome.
AI and Automation Initiatives
Support AI & Automation initiatives by defining workflow problems, assessing opportunities, and preparing work for delivery. Partner with business and technical teams to establish scope, dependencies, and success measures such as hours saved, cycle time, cost avoided, and adoption. Help validate results after launch and identify opportunities to reuse solutions across teams.
Planning, Coordination, and Follow-Through
Keep cross-functional initiatives moving by establishing clear owners, next steps, dependencies, and target dates. Track decisions and commitments, follow up on outstanding actions, and resolve blockers before they stall delivery. Adjust plans as new information emerges, make the impact of changes visible, and maintain accountability without adding unnecessary process.
Stakeholder Management and Communication
Build trusted relationships with Engineering, Support, and business stakeholders. Align participants on scope, priorities, responsibilities, and delivery expectations. Communicate progress, decisions, risks, and changes proactively, tailoring the level of detail to the audience. Escalate early when competing priorities, unresolved decisions, or capacity constraints put outcomes at risk, bringing a clear assessment and recommended path forward.
Coaching and Product Practice
Serve as a practical guide to other Product Managers through collaboration, feedback, and example. Help teammates strengthen prioritization, requirements, stakeholder communication, and delivery practices. Introduce approaches that improve consistency and independence without adding unnecessary process.
Roadmap and Strategy Contributions
Use customer feedback, operational insights, and delivery results to inform roadmap recommendations. As product knowledge develops, identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes, increase efficiency, retain revenue, and support growth. Present recommendations with clear rationale, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex B2B SaaS product work
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage intake, triage, prioritization, requirements, and delivery
  • Experience working across multiple products or concurrent workstreams in a small, fast-moving organization
  • Strong judgment in balancing customer needs, business impact, technical dependencies, and available capacity
  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, scope, and acceptance criteria
  • Technical fluency and comfort discussing APIs, integrations, data models, and implementation tradeoffs with Engineering
  • Proven ability to learn unfamiliar systems, workflows, and industry concepts quickly
  • Experience improving product processes in ways that reduce friction and strengthen execution
  • Experience mentoring Product Managers or improving team practices through influence and example
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to set expectations and align technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to connect product decisions to measurable customer and business outcomes
  • Strong project management skills, including cross-functional coordination, milestone and dependency tracking, stakeholder communication, follow-through, and timely escalation of risks and blockers
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in government contracting, defense, security, or compliance
  • Familiarity with personnel security, facility clearance, or cybersecurity compliance workflows
  • Active or previously held U.S. security clearance
  • Experience supporting products used by both external SaaS customers and internal service teams
  • Experience with AI-enabled products, workflow automation, or operational efficiency initiatives
  • Experience with Linear, Notion, or comparable product delivery and documentation tools
What We Offer
  • Six-month contract engagement at $105 per hour, 40 hours per week
  • Remote work with regular collaboration across U.S. time zones
  • A casual, friendly, and relaxed work environment
  • Occasional travel for quarterly or semiannual team on-sites
  • Opportunity to own meaningful work across growing AI & Automation initiatives and an established SaaS portfolio
  • Direct partnership with product leadership and the opportunity to shape how the team operates
  • Target start date as soon as possible

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital's measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup.

You'll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones.
  • Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts.
  • Build and automate a data quality process. Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out.
  • Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query.
  • Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts.
  • Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client's own layer.
  • Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex's AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them.

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size.
  • Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code.
  • Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control.
  • Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases.
  • Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic.
  • An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results.
  • Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer.
  • Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust.
  • Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users.

Helpful but not required

  • Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift).
  • Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data.
  • Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools.
  • Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role
  • Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources.
  • Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source.
  • Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages.
  • Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps.
  • Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround
  • AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup.
  • Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout.
  • Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
    • Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

About SafePaaS

SafePaaS helps organizations manage access risk, strengthen financial controls, and automate compliance across business-critical applications. We work at the intersection of identity security, enterprise technology, and governance, helping businesses understand who has access, what has changed, and which transactions need attention.

We’re looking for a Digital Advertising & Creative Specialist who can turn complex business challenges into compelling advertising and manage campaigns from the first idea through to measurable results.

About the role

You will own the planning, writing, design, production, launch, and optimization of paid advertising campaigns across LinkedIn, Instagram, Google, and relevant online industry publications.

Your work will support two connected goals: build awareness among the right audiences and generate qualified leads for SafePaaS.

This is a hands-on role for someone with excellent writing skills, strong visual judgment, practical video production skills, and experience managing paid campaigns. You should be equally comfortable developing a campaign concept, writing platform-specific copy, creating the creative assets, configuring targeting and tracking, and explaining what the results mean.

You will work closely with marketing, sales, and subject matter experts to reach decision-makers in Identity, IT, security, audit, risk, and compliance.

What you’ll do

Develop advertising strategies and campaign plans

  • Translate marketing priorities into advertising plans with clear audiences, objectives, budgets, timelines, and success measures.
  • Research buyer needs, search intent, audience behavior, competitor advertising, and relevant industry publications.
  • Recommend the right combination of channels, formats, offers, and messages for each campaign.
  • Develop campaigns that move prospects from initial awareness to content engagement, and conversion.
  • Plan testing across audiences, messaging, creative, offers, and landing pages.

Write compelling, audience-specific advertising

  • Develop campaign concepts, headlines, ad copy, calls to action, video scripts, and supporting landing page copy.
  • Adapt messaging for different platforms, buyer roles, industries, and stages of the buying journey.
  • Translate technical subjects into clear business messages that explain the problem, its consequences, and the value of taking action.
  • Write with accuracy, originality, and attention to grammar, tone, and detail.
  • Maintain consistency between the promise in the ad and the experience after the click.

Design and produce visual and video assets

  • Create static ads, carousels, display banners, short-form videos, and other assets suited to each channel.
  • Take creative work from concept and storyboard through design, editing, and final delivery.
  • Produce video content using interviews, webinar footage, product material, motion graphics, captions, and other relevant sources.
  • Adapt assets for different placements, dimensions, and viewing behaviors while maintaining SafePaaS brand standards.
  • Build creative variations to test which messages and visuals resonate with each audience.

Build and manage paid campaigns

  • Configure and launch campaigns across LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Ads.
  • Manage audience targeting, account lists, exclusions, retargeting, keywords, negative keywords, bidding, and budget allocation.
  • Check links, forms, creative specifications, tracking, and campaign settings before launch.
  • Coordinate landing pages, lead capture, and follow-up with the wider marketing and sales teams.
  • Monitor spend and delivery, troubleshoot issues, and refresh campaigns as performance changes.

Manage industry publication advertising

  • Identify publications and media partners whose audiences match SafePaaS target buyers.
  • Evaluate media kits, audience profiles, placement options, and evidence of performance.
  • Negotiate rates, placements, schedules, deliverables, and reporting requirements within agreed budgets.
  • Coordinate creative delivery, tracking links, launch dates, and campaign reporting.
  • Assess whether each placement delivers relevant exposure, engagement, and leads.

Measure, report, and improve performance

  • Establish reliable campaign tracking using conversion events, campaign naming conventions, and UTM parameters.
  • Monitor results against each campaign’s objective, including reach, engagement, conversions, cost per lead, and lead quality.
  • Work with sales and marketing operations to understand which campaigns generate qualified conversations and contribute to pipeline.
  • Provide clear reports explaining what happened, what you learned, and what should change.
  • Use performance evidence to improve creative, targeting, landing pages, and budget allocation.
  • Stay informed about platform changes, advertising formats, and competitor activity, applying developments that are relevant to our buyers.

What you’ll bring

  • Demonstrated experience managing paid digital advertising campaigns from planning through execution and optimization.
  • Excellent written English, with a portfolio showing clear, persuasive copy adapted for different audiences and platforms.
  • Strong design skills and the ability to create polished, effective advertising assets yourself.
  • Practical video production and editing skills, including scripting, storyboarding, captions, and platform-specific formatting.
  • Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, and Meta Ads Manager.
  • Confidence using creative tools and design and video software where necessary.
  • Experience with campaign analytics, conversion tracking, and reporting, using tools such as GA4 and a CRM or marketing automation platform.
  • An understanding of B2B buying journeys and the difference between generating a form submission and generating a qualified lead.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
  • The judgment to recommend where we should invest, explain why, and adjust when the evidence changes.

We welcome candidates with relevant practical experience and a strong portfolio, whether your background is in-house, agency, or freelance.

Experience that would be an advantage

  • B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, identity governance, ERP, compliance, or enterprise technology marketing.
  • Advertising to senior IT, security, finance, audit, or risk professionals.
  • Account-based advertising and campaigns targeting defined companies or buying groups.
  • Media buying with specialist technology or industry publications.
  • Promoting webinars, executive events, research reports, and educational content.
  • Landing page optimization and testing.
  • Responsible use of AI tools to accelerate research and creative production, supported by careful human review.

What success looks like

  • SafePaaS reaches more of the people and organizations most relevant to its solutions.
  • Campaigns launch on time, within agreed budgets, with accurate messaging and reliable tracking.
  • Copy, visuals, and video communicate clearly and feel appropriate to each platform.
  • Campaigns generate relevant engagement and qualified leads, with visibility into subsequent sales outcomes.
  • Testing produces useful insights that improve future campaigns.
  • Stakeholders understand where advertising spend is going and what it is achieving.

Why join SafePaaS?

Own the complete campaign. You will have responsibility across strategy, writing, creative production, delivery, and optimization, with a clear connection between your work and its results.

Make complex topics compelling. You will help explain business challenges that matter to enterprise decision-makers, from excessive access and financial risk to audit readiness and governance as AI enters business workflows.

Have a visible impact. In a focused marketing team, your ideas and execution can directly influence how SafePaaS reaches new audiences and creates demand.

Build breadth and depth. The role offers scope to develop across paid media, B2B copywriting, design, video, media buying, and campaign analytics.

What we offer

  • Meaningful ownership of advertising campaigns from concept to results.
  • Close collaboration with marketing, sales, and subject matter experts.
  • The opportunity to shape campaign messaging, creative direction, and channel investment.
  • A varied mix of brand awareness, educational content, event promotion, and lead generation campaigns.
  • Room to propose ideas, test approaches, and build on what works.

How to apply

Please submit your Resume and a portfolio of relevant advertising work.

Include examples that show:

  • Copywriting: Headlines and ad copy written for different platforms or audiences.
  • Visual creative: Static ads, carousels, display banners, or similar campaign assets.
  • Video: At least one example you scripted, produced, or edited.
  • Campaign results: A short example explaining the objective, your contribution, the outcome, and what you learned.

Please make your personal contribution clear for collaborative projects. Anonymized examples are welcome where client confidentiality applies.

If you can write the message, create the assets, build the campaign, and use the results to make the next one better, we’d like to hear from you.
