jobs.title: Openshift Architect
jobs.excerpt: The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for an Openshift Architect to join us in Brazil.
jobs.description:
The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for an Openshift Architect to join us in Brazil. In this role, you will create possibilities, solve problems, and establish working relationships with our customers.


You will be challenged to apply your skills and knowledge to provide direct support for critical environments and help ensure the stability of services by performing dedicated support activities, engaging in automation activities, issue remediation, and performing root cause analysis (RCA) to maximize uptime and reduce costs for enterprise customers.


You will consistently rely on your knowledge of production support and your background in dev-ops processes, including incident/change/problem management, call triaging, and critical issue resolution procedures. You will collaborate with our customers, internal teams, architects, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to troubleshoot complex and challenging issues.


This position extends well beyond product support as you will be a trusted partner to our enterprise customers by offering developer-to-developer assistance for cloud-native service development and architecture; you will work closely with junior and senior engineers and developers, fixing and improving code and identifying automation opportunities.


You'll partner closely with development engineering teams and work alongside some of the brightest developers in the open source community. You will also work with Red Hat’s key strategic cloud partners to jointly solve customer Multi-Cloud issues.


What you will do:


  • Support Red Hat’s customers using our OpenShift Ecosystem running on different Hybrid Cloud solutions (public providers including Azure, AWS, Google and also on premise deployments)
  • Actively support and provide guidance to other Red Hat engineers dealing with more complex issues
  • Resolve Red Hat’s customers issues across different components such as Logging (Elasticsearch, FluentD, Kibana), Monitoring, Networking (SDN / OVN kubernetes), Storage, Service Mesh/Istio
  • Be a regional / global subject matter expert on one of the above mentioned OpenShift components
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot complex technical problems, often going through product code, to identify the root cause
  • Constantly work on your skills so you can keep up with the latest technology trends as well as new products and features in Red Hat’s portfolio
  • Build on your expertise by going through intensive onboarding, which includes taking RHEL and Openshift Certifications, such as Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), Containers & Kubernetes (DO180)/Operating a Production Kubernetes Cluster (DO280), Scaling Kubernetes Deployments in the Enterprise (DO380)
  • Consult the customer cases with in-house support engineers and developers to promote creative solutions and improve customer experience
  • Contribute to the global Red Hat knowledge management system
  • As a part of your professional development, you can collaborate with your colleagues on different projects outside of your day to day work, contribute to the success of the global team and / or contribute to OpenSource community and product code

What you will bring:


  • Excellent communication skills, ability to analyze and effectively resolve customer's issues
  • Previous experience configuring and troubleshooting OpenShift or Kubernetes and one of its components such as (Logging, Monitoring, Networking, Storage, Service Mesh)
  • Previous professional Linux system administration experience
  • Passion for problem-solving and investigation of the customer and technical problems
  • Ability to work with conflicting priorities, take initiative, and maintain a customer-centric focus
  • Team player attitude, open-minded and collaborative approach
  • Ability to read code in one of the following languages (Python / C / C++ / GoLang, Java), interest in deepening the knowledge of GoLang
  • Practical experience with developer tools for code management (git, GitHub, GitLab) and bug tracking systems (Bugzilla, Jira etc)
  • Thirst for knowledge, ability to further grow and enhance your technical/interpersonal skills

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.


Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

jobs.description:
Our Essence:

Cresteo is on a mission to be the world leader in people-first and honest nearshore tech services. We prioritize a people-centered approach in an industry that often feels distant and impersonal. Our services are led by experienced, incredibly talented professionals who are changing the system from within - while collaborating with top global clients.

  • Profit-sharing

When it comes to recruitment, we won't box you into rigid questionnaires; we genuinely want to get to know you. Our interactions are not transactional but human-centered, seeking genuine understanding and connection.

You'll hear about our core values and experience them with us firsthand. They define our essence.

Join Cresteo and be part of the change we're championing!

Why You Belong Here

As a QA Engineer at Cresteo, you'll be more than just a developer; you will be part of transforming the tech industry through our honest, transparent, and people-centric approach.

Your role will be diverse and dynamic. You'll be instrumental in developing and maintaining our software solutions, working with a varied technology stack, and ensuring that our products are functional, efficient, reliable, and scalable.

By joining us, you're not just choosing a job; you're aligning with a vision that values the human side of tech, where your skills and passion are recognized, nurtured, and celebrated.

What you will do

  • Define the test approach for each change, sized to its risk: functional, regression, integration and data checks.
  • Build and maintain regression suites for each system, starting from little or no existing coverage.
  • Run accessibility checks against WCAG 2.1 AA on every user-facing change, using automated tools and manual testing with screen readers and keyboard navigation.
  • Verify third-party integrations after changes: single sign-on, video hosting, payments, search and data feeds.
  • Validate scheduled and background jobs, including cases where a silent failure could hide or remove content.
  • Produce release evidence for each change: test scope, results, defects and sign-off.
  • Log defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps, severity and impact.
  • Contribute to each system’s runbook and test documentation during knowledge transfer and after every change.

What We're Looking For

  • Several years of professional experience in software QA, with ownership of test strategy for web applications.
  • Strong manual testing skills: exploratory, functional and regression testing on systems with incomplete documentation.
  • Hands-on test automation experience for web UI and APIs (for example Playwright, Selenium or Cypress, and Postman or similar).
  • Proven experience testing against WCAG 2.1 AA, with tools such as axe or WAVE and screen readers such as NVDA, JAWS or VoiceOver.
  • Working SQL skills to set up test data and validate results in relational databases, ideally SQL Server.
  • Experience testing integrations, SSO flows and batch or scheduled processes.
  • Experience working within a formal release and change management process, using Jira for defects and test tracking.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools for test case generation and documentation, within strict data-handling rules.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal, to support documentation, issue reporting, and cross-team collaboration.
  • Advanced English level

Be the quality and accessibility gate for a portfolio of legacy education platforms used by schools and libraries. Define how each system is tested and prove every release is safe to ship.

Our Commitment to You:

  • 100% Remote
  • USD above-average salaries
  • Profit Sharing Policy
  • Unlimited PTOs after your first year (20 PTOs the first year)
  • Equipment for your setup
  • Great work/life balance
  • Honest, simple, and transparent culture
  • US-based clients and international teams

Everyone has a story. We're eager to hear yours and help you write the next chapter.

Are you ready for a change?

#Wearethechange!

jobs.excerpt: Corporate Travel Consultant (Bechtel Team)FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.
jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant (Bechtel Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid).This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85. Hourly rate is dependent on relevant factors, including experience, geographic location, and job requirements.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

We welcome accommodation requests to help make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant (AMDOC Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid). This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85. Hourly rate is dependent on relevant factors, including experience, geographic location, and job requirements.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI tools to assist in various stages, including the screening and assessment of applications. These tools support our evaluation of candidates based on role relevant qualifications, skills and experience. All decisions are made by our hiring team and stakeholders.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Gaddang-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: GaddangInterpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.75 - $0.90 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Gaddang Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Gaddangand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inGaddangand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Connected Devices team at Life360 owns end-to-end device software readiness across our portfolio — firmware, app, and cloud engineering working as one team to ship the trackers and wearables that keep families connected to the people, pets, and things they care about most. We're not just a firmware team: we own the full device software stack, from the hardware modules to the cloud, across the whole lifecycle — architecture and hardware bring-up through mass production and post-launch refinement.

We're moving toward a more intelligent hardware ecosystem — processing continuous multi-sensor telemetry on the device itself, in real time, within tight power and memory budgets. We're an AI-Native engineering team: AI isn't just a tool we use, it's how we work — across specifications, code, test, review, data analysis and triage. Today that means firmware running across our Tile and Pet GPS tracker lines — devices shipping in the hundreds of thousands of units.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager, Connected Devices, and works day-to-day alongside our firmware, app, and cloud engineers, quality assurance, data science, hardware, operations, and data teams.

About the Job

We're looking for a Senior Firmware Engineer II to drive low-level embedded execution, security, and hardware integration across Life360's connected devices portfolio.

You are a firmware engineer with deep roots in Electrical Engineering. In this role, application code is secondary—your primary mandate is low-level firmware architecture, hardware EE collaboration, and wireless robustness. "Senior II" means you take high ownership of complex technical challenges across the stack. You can dive into schematic reviews, troubleshoot board-level anomalies, secure communications, manage low-level RF control, or optimize radio coexistence, flexing seamlessly across new product development and fleet maintenance as priorities shift.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $109,500 to $199,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 158,500 to 185,000 CAD.Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

Drive Low-Level Firmware & Hardware Integration

  • Develop and maintain low-level drivers, DMA pipelines, and peripheral interfaces (GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART) across RTOS and bare-metal environments (Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX).
  • Implement reliable on-device storage architectures, flash wear-leveling strategies, and efficient Inter-Process Communication (IPC).
  • Partner closely with EE on schematic reviews, hardware validation, and building hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) stress test rigs to verify edge-case stability.

Secure the Device Ecosystem

  • Architect and maintain device security pipelines, covering AWS IoT authentication, cryptographic key storage, encryption, and signed, rollback-protected OTA updates.

Optimize RF Performance & Compliance

  • Implement low-level RF control schemes and support GNSS assistance pipelines.
  • Mitigate wireless coexistence challenges across BLE and Wi-Fi to ensure stable concurrent connections.
  • Write RF compliance firmware to pass global regulatory standards and manage formal FCC/CE compliance testing requirements.

Work AI-Natively and Support the Fleet

  • Leverage AI development tools daily to accelerate prototyping, code review, documentation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Share technical ownership of shipped products by participating in on-call rotations, field triage, and team code reviews.

What We’re Looking For

Foundation & Core Technical Bar

  • 7+ years of embedded firmware experience shipping production consumer devices at scale.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Deep proficiency in C/C++ and practical, hands-on experience with RTOS internals (Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX) or bare-metal embedded architectures.
  • Strong EE fundamentals: ability to read schematics, evaluate power trees, and debug hardware hands-on using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
  • Direct experience with flash storage management and low-level peripheral buses (GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART).

Security Track Record

  • Demonstrated background deploying on-device security (secure boot, key provisioning, encryption) and integrating with cloud security backends (such as AWS IoT).

Wireless & RF Expertise

  • Prior experience shipping multi-radio wireless devices (BLE, Wi-Fi, GNSS).
  • Hands-on experience with low-level RF control and calibration.
  • Proven ability to navigate RF regulatory compliance labs, including managing FCC/CE compliance testing.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Experience integrating cloud/app endpoints and designing complex firmware state machines.
  • Deep power management profiling (sleep modes) and hardware/software watchdog implementations.
  • Exposure to Cellular (LTE-M/NB-IoT) integration or manufacturing test line bring-up.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use — you use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) every day for real firmware work: drafting and refactoring code, debugging on-device failures, writing specs and design docs. This isn’t autocomplete; it’s a standing part of how you work.
  • Judgment and ownership — you review every line of AI-generated code as critically as you would a human PR before it ships to a device in the field. The AI writes it; you’re accountable for it.
  • Velocity — you’re expected to use AI to compress timelines that used to take weeks, from specifications to working prototype to validated on-device behavior, and to be able to explain your approach when you don’t.
  • Team leadership — you share what you learn (patterns that work, guardrails you’ve added, failure modes you’ve hit) through code review, design docs, and pairing, and you help raise the team’s AI fluency, not just your own.
  • Continuous learning — you stay current on embedded-AI tooling and techniques and bring recommendations back to the team rather than waiting for them to arrive.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Position: Estimating & Project Coordinator (Fire Protection/ Building Services)

Salary: up to AUD 2,000 per month

Working Hours: Australian Hours

Holidays: Public holidays in AU

About the Role

Our client in AU is a dynamic fire protection and building services business seeking a detail-oriented, commercially sharp Estimating & Project Coordinator to join our growing operations team as a dedicated remote team member.

In this central operational role, you will bridge the gap between pre-construction fire estimating and active project delivery. Working closely with our Fire Estimators, System Designers, and Project Managers, you will manage tender setups, perform preliminary quantity take-offs, cross-check subcontractor quotations against fire and building schematics, and administer live project workflows across Uptick and Microsoft Teams.

This role is designed for an organised estimating or project coordinator who is comfortable reading technical plans, spotting scope discrepancies early, and keeping multiple active fire tenders and project handovers moving forward reliably without administrative bottlenecks.

Key Responsibilities

Fire Estimating & Tender Coordination

  • Tender Registration & Setup: Receive and register incoming fire protection tenders and Requests for Quotation (RFQs), setting up accurate tender, estimate, and project records inside Uptick.
  • Document Control: Systematically organise architectural/engineering drawings, fire services specifications, schedules, and tender documentation.
  • Bluebeam Take-Offs & Scope Reviews: Assist fire estimators with Bluebeam quantity take-offs (e.g., counting fire safety devices, detectors, sprinklers, and equipment schedules) and preliminary scope reviews, flagging potential scope gaps, exclusions, and specification requirements.
  • Register & Deadline Tracking: Maintain up-to-date tender registers, monitor strict closing dates, and coordinate estimating data across estimators, Project Managers, and offshore support personnel.

Project Delivery & Handover Administration

  • Project Onboarding: Set up newly awarded fire protection projects within Uptick, Microsoft Teams, and internal project tracking systems.
  • Contract & Variation Tracking: Maintain accurate project records including drawings, contracts, purchase orders, and variations.
  • Estimating-to-Delivery Handover: Facilitate seamless project handovers from the fire estimating team to project delivery, maintaining live project dashboards and following up on outstanding information.
  • Subcontractor Coordination: Assist Project Managers with subcontractor documentation and side-by-side scope comparisons.

Scope Verification, Compliance & Systems Administration

  • Quotation & Drawing Cross-Checks: Cross-check quotations against fire drawings, specifications, and subcontractor pricing, ensuring all tender exclusions, qualifications, and assumptions carry through into project documentation.
  • Compliance & Specification Escalation: Assist with detailed scope reviews for specification-driven projects (including DoE and SSU) and promptly escalate scope or compliance concerns to the appropriate Estimator, Designer, or Project Manager.
  • Centralised Workflows & Process Improvement: Maintain data accuracy across Uptick and Microsoft Teams, support business unit integration into centralised systems, coordinate administrative tasks completed by offshore support, and help refine fire estimating templates and project tracking processes.

Requirements

  • Fire Protection / Building Services Coordination: Proven background in estimating support, project coordination, contracts administration, or engineering administration within fire protection, electrical, or MEP building services.
  • Drawing & Scope Literacy: Practical ability to read technical drawings, fire schematics, specifications, and schedules to identify scope gaps, exclusions, and pricing discrepancies.
  • Take-Off & Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Bluebeam Revu (or comparable quantity take-off/PDF markup tools) alongside strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Teams, SharePoint, Outlook).
  • Multi-Tender Organisation: Exceptional attention to detail and organisational discipline to manage multiple concurrent fire tenders, strict closing deadlines, and project handovers simultaneously.
  • Clear & Professional Communication: Strong written and verbal English skills for liaising confidently with estimators, Project Managers, builders, suppliers, and internal staff.
  • Compliance & Confidentiality: High professional integrity, maintaining strict commercial confidentiality and adhering to company WHS policies and procedures.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience using Uptick (fire protection and field service management software).
  • Familiarity with fire safety systems (e.g., wet/dry fire systems, detection/alarms, passive fire, emergency lighting) and Australian fire standards.
  • Tertiary qualification or background in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or Construction Management.

What Success Looks Like

Every fire protection tender is logged accurately and tracked ahead of closing deadlines, scope gaps and exclusions are caught before causing costly delivery issues, and Uptick and Microsoft Teams remain clean, reliable single sources of truth. Fire Estimators and Project Managers are freed from administrative and preliminary take-off bottlenecks, enabling smooth handovers from initial quote through to project completion.

  • Build and operate a risk-based patching and vulnerability remediation program across servers, endpoints, network, and cloud services, prioritizing by CVSS severity, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, asset criticality, exposure, and compensating controls.
  • Define remediation targets for critical and high-risk vulnerabilities, manage exceptions and escalation, and report patch compliance, remediation aging, and residual risk.
  • Coordinate testing, deployment, verification, and rollback readiness for patches and security updates.
  • Identify end-of-support and unpatchable systems and drive remediation or replacement plans with IT and business owners.

Security Automation & DevOps

  • Automate correlation of newly disclosed CVEs with Galvanize’s hardware, software, and cloud services, using vendor advisories, the National Vulnerability Database, and CISA KEV to drive prioritization, remediation, and validation.
  • Replace manual patching, configuration validation, backup verification, and failover procedures with tested automation that includes peer review, logging, secrets management, and rollback.
  • Manage infrastructure, Intune, Entra ID, and security configuration as code (e.g., Terraform or Bicep, Microsoft365DSC) in Git, deployed through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines with pull-request review, automated testing, and drift detection.
  • Partner with IT to manage ZIA and ZPA configuration as code where feasible (e.g., Zscaler Terraform providers).

Security Operations & MSSP Management

  • Serve as primary technical liaison to the MSSP/SOC, translating alerts, findings, and incidents into internal remediation and tracking them to closure.
  • Ensure MSSP/SOC visibility and logging coverage across endpoints, servers, identity, network, and cloud services.
  • Build Galvanize-specific detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK (e.g., Microsoft Defender XDR or Microsoft Sentinel queries), managed as code and validated with the MSSP/SOC through attack simulation.
  • Conduct service reviews using mean time to detect, acknowledge, and respond (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR), and maintain a responsibility matrix (RACI) reviewed annually for functions better performed in-house.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration tests and participate in incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Align escalation criteria so significant incidents, including third-party incidents, reach Legal and Finance promptly; materiality and disclosure decisions remain with Legal, Finance, and executive leadership.

Resilience: DR, Backup & Business Continuity

  • Lead the technical DR program, identifying critical systems and dependencies, defining Recovery Time and Recovery Point Objectives (RTOs/RPOs) with business owners, and maintaining recovery and failover runbooks.
  • Validate recoverability through actual restore and failover testing rather than backup job status alone, and automate failover where practical.
  • Engineer ransomware-resilient recovery, including immutable or logically isolated backups administered separately from production identity, covering Microsoft 365 data and Entra ID, Intune, and Conditional Access configuration.
  • Facilitate business impact analyses to align continuity procedures with technical recovery capabilities.
  • Run tabletop and recovery exercises, including ransomware scenarios, on a sustained cadence, and track findings and single points of failure through remediation.

Identity, Cloud & Data Protection

  • Engineer and automate Entra ID and Intune hardening, including Conditional Access, phishing-resistant multifactor authentication (MFA) and passkeys, Privileged Identity Management where licensed, and removal of legacy authentication; IT retains day-to-day administration.
  • Measure and remediate Microsoft 365 and Entra ID configuration against Microsoft Secure Score and CISA Secure Cloud Business Applications (SCuBA) baselines.
  • Establish a secure Microsoft Azure baseline as Galvanize expands beyond its current Entra ID and Microsoft 365 footprint, reviewing new cloud workloads before production use.
  • Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and data loss prevention (DLP) for intellectual property, clinical, and financial information, with data owners defining classification and handling rules.

AI Security & AI-Enabled DevOps

  • Establish and operate Galvanize’s AI security program, aligned with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, including an AI security standard, approved AI tools and agents, security review of new AI tools, and an inventory with named owners.
  • Extend identity and data guardrails to AI services, including Conditional Access, consent governance for AI apps and agents, remediation of overshared content before broad rollout, and DLP for AI interactions.
  • Security-test and red-team internally deployed AI applications and agents for prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency, referencing the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
  • Partner with the MSSP/SOC to monitor and respond to AI-related threats, including unsanctioned AI use, anomalous agent activity, and AI-enabled phishing.
  • Use AI to accelerate engineering, secure AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot), and hold AI-generated code to the same review, testing, and scanning gates as other code.
  • Design governed agentic automation for IT and security operations (e.g., alert triage, CVE applicability analysis) with least-privilege identities, action logging, human approval for consequential actions, tested rollback, and CI/CD evaluation gates.

Zero Trust Network Security (Zscaler)

  • Define the security baseline and policy standards for ZIA, ZPA, and ZTB, and approve security-impacting changes within agreed decision rights, without taking on day-to-day administration.
  • Conduct configuration audits and administrative access reviews, and maintain a pre-approved standard-change catalog and a record of approved exceptions.
  • Define generative AI usage guardrails enforced through ZIA (e.g., Cloud App Control, inline DLP), consistent with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps controls.

Governance, Controls & Leadership

  • Maintain standards, runbooks, and key performance and risk indicators (KPIs/KRIs) aligned with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, and CISA guidance, and provide evidence for audits and cyber-insurance assessments.
  • Design security-related IT general controls (ITGCs) for financially significant systems with automated evidence collection, and include Zscaler changes and administrative access in ITGC change management and access reviews.
  • Report security metrics and risk to the Director, Information Systems and Security; executive leadership; and, where applicable, the Board or Audit Committee.
  • Direct contractors and service providers, prepare business cases that prioritize existing Microsoft licensing and tool consolidation, and help recruit and lead staff as headcount is approved.

This role pays between $175,000 and $190,000 per year, and your actual base pay will depend on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Galvanize offers a robust benefits package to full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, short- and long-term disability protection, 401(k), and flexible paid time off.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Productivity  (Remote, Canada)
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US & Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, SDLC, security and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Productivity group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Productivity group, which owns SDLC tooling, application security and observability, of the resources, systems and workloads used to build and run Grafana Labs products. The group enables product development through the provision of performant and feature-rich SDLC tooling, governing the use and configuration of that tooling. We are responsible for guiding the product teams in application security good practices, reviewing product changes for security compliance and enabling security functions through self-service automation. We also own and maintain the internal observability platform, using our own products to give visibility into cloud resource cost, usage and sustainability, and vulnerability management.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Productivity squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production SDLC infrastructure and governance, security and monitoring.
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as SDLC infrastructure and enablement, developer experience, SDLC governance and compliance, application security, or observability and cost visibility. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: SDLC tooling, developer experience, application security, and observability.
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure, SDLC tooling expertise, developer experience and making the right way the easy way, application security, monitoring tooling and alerting. You can challenge a threat model or a system design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams.
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale.
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure.
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $192,891 CAD - $231,469 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

RethinkFirst was founded in 2007 with a mission to provide scalable, evidence-based autism treatment training tools and caregiver supports to an underserved population. Over the past fifteen years, RethinkFirst’s mission has evolved to transform the behavioral health landscape by inspiring and empowering all individuals with behavioral health challenges and those who support them. We continue to focus on the future of transforming behavioral health through data science, analytics, and enabling value-based care. With patent-pending solutions and the largest published ASD dataset, RethinkFirst can focus on improving outcomes and having a positive impact on the millions of lives it supports.

Rethink Billing Overview
Our Billing Services Division specializes in Revenue Cycle Management, Enrollment and Credentialing, and Benefit Authorization Management services. We are growing and are looking for new team members that will offer our clients best-in-class billing services. We support mission-oriented companies that impact the lives of thousands of individuals with autism and their families. We are excited to offer the opportunity for professional and collaborative individuals to grow and be part of something exciting.

Job Summary
The RCM Billing Specialist is responsible for supporting our billing teams by working with insurance companies to ensure efficient and prompt reimbursement for therapy sessions for our customers through timely and clean claim submission..

  • Manage and operate in multiple different billing platforms dependent on client needs which could include Azalea, Tebra, Central Reach and/or Rethink Integrated Billing Module
  • Manage assigned client accounts billing scrubs for primary and secondary claims
  • Submit claims electronically for primary and secondary payors
  • Solve clearinghouse rejections
  • Submit corrected claims for billing errors, rebill projects (new plans/new year, new information on payor policies)

  • Review client billing documentation to ensure claims are submitted based on payor requirements

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Revenue Assurance Analyst to help Bask Health identify revenue discrepancies, strengthen billing accuracy, and improve visibility into how merchant activity translates into revenue.

You'll analyze commercial agreements, merchant activity, billing records, and financial data to identify situations where revenue may be missing, incorrectly calculated, or billed inconsistently.

This role goes beyond reviewing individual invoices. You'll investigate recurring discrepancies, identify their underlying causes, and work with internal teams to improve the processes and controls that prevent revenue leakage.

You'll collaborate with Finance, Revenue Operations, Billing Operations, Product, and Engineering to reconcile financial information, resolve issues, and develop reliable reporting.

We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating complex data problems, pays close attention to detail, and can turn financial findings into practical operational improvements.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze merchant billing and revenue data to identify potential revenue leakage.
  • Compare expected revenue against actual billed amounts using approved commercial terms.
  • Reconcile merchant activity, applicable fees, and billing records.
  • Investigate missing charges, incorrect rates, misapplied discounts, and other revenue discrepancies.
  • Review contract terms and pricing schedules to validate revenue calculations.
  • Identify recurring patterns in billing errors and revenue inconsistencies.
  • Build reports that track revenue discrepancies and potential financial exposure.
  • Work with Finance to validate revenue data and reconcile identified differences.
  • Collaborate with Billing Operations to investigate and resolve billing exceptions.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to clarify approved commercial terms and pricing arrangements.
  • Analyze how pricing configuration errors may affect realized revenue.
  • Identify gaps between merchant activity data and billing system records.
  • Support reviews of transaction-based, subscription-based, and other applicable billing arrangements.
  • Develop reconciliation methods to identify missing or inaccurate charges.
  • Investigate discrepancies involving pricing effective dates, contract amendments, and discounts.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of identified revenue issues.
  • Prioritize findings based on their potential financial and operational impact.
  • Track revenue assurance investigations and document their resolution.
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering when discrepancies involve system behavior, data quality, or integrations.
  • Recommend checks that help prevent recurring billing and revenue errors.
  • Develop and maintain revenue assurance reports, dashboards, and reconciliation trackers.
  • Support periodic reviews of billing accuracy and revenue completeness.
  • Identify opportunities to automate revenue validation and exception reporting.
  • Monitor trends in revenue discrepancies and report findings to stakeholders.
  • Help improve documentation of pricing assumptions, billing logic, and reconciliation procedures.
  • Verify that corrective actions have resolved identified revenue issues.
  • Support internal financial reviews by providing accurate supporting analysis.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success when revenue discrepancies affect merchant accounts.
  • Evaluate how changes to pricing or billing processes may affect revenue accuracy.
  • Support improvements to data consistency across commercial, billing, and financial systems.
  • Prepare clear summaries of revenue risks, findings, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Support additional revenue integrity and financial operations projects as business needs evolve.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in revenue assurance, revenue operations, billing analytics, financial operations, or a related field.
  • Experience reconciling financial, billing, or transaction data.
  • Experience identifying discrepancies between expected and actual revenue or billed amounts.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills, including complex formulas, data comparisons, and reconciliation.
  • Ability to analyze revenue, pricing, and billing data across multiple sources.
  • Experience investigating financial discrepancies and identifying underlying causes.
  • Understanding of billing controls, financial accuracy, and revenue leakage risks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Experience preparing financial reports, reconciliation summaries, or operational analyses.
  • Ability to evaluate the financial impact of billing or revenue discrepancies.
  • Experience collaborating with Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Operations, or technical teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex financial findings to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple investigations.
  • Experience documenting analytical findings and corrective actions.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of assigned investigations.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial and commercial information responsibly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in revenue assurance for a SaaS or technology company.
  • Familiarity with subscription, usage-based, or transaction-based billing.
  • Experience identifying revenue leakage in merchant billing environments.
  • Experience using Stripe Billing or similar financial platforms.
  • Familiarity with contract-to-billing reconciliation.
  • Experience working with e-commerce or merchant-facing technology platforms.
  • Experience using SQL to investigate financial or billing discrepancies.
  • Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience developing automated revenue reconciliation processes.
  • Familiarity with billing system integrations and financial data pipelines.
  • Experience collaborating with Product or Engineering on billing issues.
  • Experience supporting internal financial controls or audit readiness.
  • Familiarity with telehealth or healthcare technology.
  • Understanding of cash-pay healthcare business models.
  • Experience working in a growing SaaS or technology company.
