jobs.title: Remote Clinical Psychologist - South Carolina
jobs.excerpt: Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.
jobs.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Role

We're hiring Licensed Psychologists (Ph.D/Psy.D) to conduct autism assessments for adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affordable, accessible diagnostic services while helping to shape best practices in adult autism assessment.

Our clinicians come from diverse backgrounds and career stages - whether you're building your career foundation, balancing work with other responsibilities, or expanding your clinical expertise, we offer flexibility to match your needs.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct comprehensive autism assessments for adults via telehealth
  • Deliver actionable feedback to clients following evaluations and develop personalized post-assessment plans
  • Write clear, thorough clinical reports that document findings and recommendations
  • Participate in case consultations and clinical collaborative opportunities
  • Focus on direct client care while we handle administrative tasks and insurance billing

What We Offer

Flexible Work Options:

  • Schedule autonomy (7am-10pm - 7days a week)
  • Part-time/Contract roles start at just 18 hours per week
  • Full-Time salaried positions available with benefits
  • Work from your private office or space, regardless of geographic location

Clinical Support Structure:

  • Administrative support including scheduling, billing and insurance done for you, not by you so you can focus on clinical work
  • Purpose-built technology for effective telehealth assessment and report writing
  • Paid, structured onboarding program - we will set you up for success no matter your level of experience with Autism
  • Inclusive, neurodiversity-affirming community of clinicians that values diverse perspectives and collaborative growth

Professional Development:

  • Regular case consultation groups and monthly case conferences in a Project ECHO format
  • Mentorship opportunities with experienced clinicians while you acclimate to our processes and systems
  • Clear career advancement opportunities with pathways to lead roles and clinical leadership positions

Benefits (Full-time Positions):

  • Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • 15 days PTO plus major holidays

What We Look For:

Required Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree (PhD/PsyD) from an APA-accredited program
  • Current state licensure as a Licensed Psychologist with no disciplinary actions
  • Identity-affirming approach to patient care
  • Strong clinical judgment and clinical interview skills
  • Proficient remote communication abilities
  • Tech competence and self-direction
  • Desire to support an underserved population of autistic adults

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PSYPACT licensure or eligibility
  • Experience with adult diagnostic evaluations
  • Background working with neurodivergent populations

Join Our Team

Ready to transform lives while advancing your career? Apply today to join Prosper Health's team of dedicated professionals making a real difference for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Prosper Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who identify as neurodivergent, LGBTQ+, or BIPOC.

For those interested in 1099 opportunities, we offer a per assessment rate, paid upon submission of the assessment.

Weekly pay
$1,650—$2,200 USD

We also offer salaried roles that come with full benefits.

Annual Salary Range
$100,000—$120,000 USD

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Sprint With Sprinters

At Sprinto, your work has purpose — and your life has space. We are a workplace where you’re empowered to execute on your most ambitious ideas and deliver your best output in a fast-paced, innovative, and supportive environment.
Joining Sprinto means you will never run alone; you will always have the freedom to take your shot and the support to go farther than you imagined.

What The Role Involves:
At Sprinto, partnerships are the backbone of our revenue strategy. As the Director of Strategic Alliances & Channel Partnerships, you will play a critical role in developing, managing, and scaling strategic relationships with key identified partners . Your primary objective? Fuel Sprinto’s growth by owning and driving 25% of the company's revenue. You’ll have the opportunity to build a high-performing ecosystem of partners and help Sprinto achieve success on a global scale.

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Build Sprinto's partner-led growth engine - Design the strategy, commercial models, and operating rhythm that transform partnerships into a predictable and meaningful revenue channel for the business.
  • Create partnerships that compound - Identify, recruit, and grow relationships across MSPs, MSSPs, GSIs, consulting firms, and strategic technology partners—building an ecosystem that expands Sprinto's reach far beyond direct sales.
  • Turn partnerships into revenue - Design joint go-to-market plans, co-selling motions, and commercial programs that consistently generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across global markets.
  • Build relationships that shape industries - Become a trusted advisor to founders, partner executives, and business leaders, creating long-term relationships that extend beyond individual opportunities.
  • Build the team behind the ecosystem - Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing partnerships team while creating the processes, operating cadence, and culture that enable them to succeed.
  • Shape how Sprinto grows - Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Leadership to ensure every strategic alliance creates value for customers, partners, and Sprinto alike.
  • Create a channel that outlives you - Everything from partner segmentation and governance to enablement and business reviews will become the foundation Sprinto scales for years to come.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

    You'll likely thrive in this role if...
  • You've spent 8–12 years building strategic partnerships, alliances, or commercial businesses, and are excited by the opportunity to create a global revenue engine rather than simply manage existing relationships.
  • You've built partnerships that generated measurable commercial outcomes—not just signed agreements. You think in pipeline, revenue, and long-term business value.
  • You naturally earn the trust of founders, CXOs, and partner executives because you understand how to create outcomes where every stakeholder wins.
  • You've built partner programs before—designing commercial models, joint go-to-market strategies, enablement, and governance that scaled with the business.
  • You enjoy building teams as much as building partnerships. Hiring, coaching, and creating repeatable operating systems are all part of how you think about leadership.
  • You think strategically but execute relentlessly. Whether it's negotiating a complex alliance, reviewing partner performance, or solving cross-functional challenges, you're comfortable moving between vision and execution.
  • You're curious about technology and understand how integrations, APIs, and ecosystem partnerships can become meaningful competitive advantages—not just technical projects.
  • Greenfield opportunities energise you. You enjoy creating structure where none exists and building businesses that leave a lasting impact.
    • If you're looking for a role where you'll inherit a mature partner organisation with established playbooks and predictable revenue, this probably isn't it. But if you're excited to build Sprinto's partnerships business into one of the company's largest growth engines, we'd love to meet you.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

jobs.description:
At the start of 360Learning's growth, we were only 10 developers in the R&D department working on a single codebase. Today, we are a team of 60+ engineers divided into 10 product squads. Each squad includes developers, product managers and designers. Our technical teams are paramount to 360Learning’s response to our increasingly demanding customers and are strategic players for the growth of the company. We have the opportunity to:
Lead real and complex technical challenges: A complex codebase on which analysis and modeling capabilities are key. Significant traffic (2.3M registered users, 200K unique monthly visitors) with a considerable volume of data to manage. A strong focus on “clean architecture” for long-term growth.
Work on an attractive technical stack: We work on MongoDB, Node.js and Vue.js, three of the most popular JS technologies on the market. We are currently migrating to TypeScript.

  • Discover the 360Learning platform
  • Have a global view on our codebase
  • Become familiar with team's processes
  • Implement your first tickets
  • Integrate our decentralized peer review process to adopt our best practices

  • Share your best practices within the team
  • Create your own courses on the 360Learning platform
  • Implement cross-functional tools, to allow the team to maintain its quality standards and increase its velocity
  • Document, refactor, analyze features to maintain a high level of quality and transparency

Within 12 months, you will:

  • Onboard the new engineers in your team
  • Be the owner of part of the codebase
  • Work on complex functionalities that impact several teams and stakeholders
  • Work on architectural changes impacting our entire codebase

The Skill Set

  • You have significant full stack programming experience including experience with Agile methodologies, SaaS software architecture, and modern programming languages
  • You have an interest in JavaScript technologies (you don't have to be an expert!)
  • You are used to creating quality interfaces : intuitive, efficient, elegant...
  • You are comfortable with algorithms
  • You have a product-oriented mindset and care deeply about the customers and the customer experience.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary and a variable component 📈
  • Benefits: Work From Home allowance, social security, health insurance, unemployment insurance, common contingency, salary guarantee fund. Leave requests are subject to local policies.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, Total work from home possible anywhere in Spain 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: & find out more about the teams, product and processes 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Interview Process

  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Technical Test to do at home on HackerRank
  • Discovery Meeting with a Software Engineer (including a Kata)
  • Clarification Meeting with a Software Engineer
  • Culture-fit interview with Fabrice, our Engineering Director
  • Offer!

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

jobs.title: Project Keid - Native Arabic Speaker - Short Video Recording (Malaysia)
jobs.excerpt: We’re running a short video data collection project for one of our clients.
jobs.description:
We’re running a short video data collection project for one of our clients. We’re looking for native Arabic speakers across multiple Arabic-speaking countries and dialects to record a 15–20 second video, speaking naturally in Arabic and looking directly into the camera. The videos collected will be used to help train and evaluate an AI model that distinguishes real, human-recorded video from AI-generated (synthetic) video.

Project Details:

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 1 session

Commitment: 1 hour.

Job Type: Freelance

Location: Malaysia (Remote)

Language/Dialects:Yemeni

Pay Rate: $5.50/ per accepted Video

$5.50 per approved video, plus a 25% bonus for first-attempt quality (up to $6.88 ). You get 20% on submission + 80% on approval, with one re-record opportunity if your first video needs adjustments.

#L1-CC1

Eligibility

    • 18 years of age or older.

    • Native Arabic speaker (self-identified). You may be asked to complete a brief screening step to confirm your dialect before your submission is finalized.

What you’ll do

    • Record a single 15–20 second video in your native Arabic dialect.

    • Speak naturally (no script). Suggested prompts: briefly introduce yourself, mention where you live, or talk about an interest/hobby.

    • Look directly at the camera the whole time.

    • After recording, answer a few short questions about yourself (e.g., age range, country, dialect) to help us organize the dataset.

Recording specifications (must meet all to be accepted)

    • Video quality: 1080p or higher

    • Length: 15–20 seconds

    • Framing: Head-and-shoulders, face centered and fully visible

    • Lighting/background: Well-lit face (no harsh shadows), plain/neutral background

    • Expression: Neutral/relaxed while speaking naturally

    • Audio: Clear speech, no background noise, music, or echo

    • Orientation: Portrait or landscape acceptable (hold steady, no shaky footage)

    • Environment: Quiet indoor setting preferred

    • Prohibited: Filters/beauty modes, sunglasses, hats/hoods, face coverings, headphones/earbuds, watermarks, stickers, borders, other people/pets in frame

Your Privacy

    Before you begin, you’ll be asked to review and accept a consent form explaining how your video and any information you provide will be used, stored, and who it will be shared with.

jobs.excerpt: Position: Revenue Operations Analyst II Department: Revenue OperationsLocation: India(Remote)Shift: 2 pm -11 pm IST About Us HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth.
jobs.description:
Position: Revenue Operations Analyst II

Department: Revenue Operations

Location: India(Remote)

Shift: 2 pm -11 pm IST

About Us

HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals. HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million domain names.

Our People

With over 2000+ team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

You are a player-coach with genuine analytical depth and a builder's instinct. You do not wait to be asked what matters before it becomes urgent and bring recommendations, not just observations. You identify trends, gaps, and opportunities and share insights with relevant stakeholders. You are comfortable walking into a room of experienced GTM leaders and supporting them with data and insights. You see broken workflows as problems to fix, not facts of life, and you have the operational credibility to implement the fix yourself. You thrive on unstructured problems and ambiguity is your baseline, not your blocker.

About the Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst in the team. In this role, you'll own analytics, reporting, and process for a dedicated segment of the revenue org becoming the go-to person who turns raw performance data into the reporting, programs, and workflows that team runs on day to day. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who's equally comfortable building a dashboard, designing a process from scratch, and troubleshooting a broken workflow, and who wants a direct line of sight into how their work moves the business.

What You'll Do

Analytics & Reporting

  • Own and manage all performance analytics and reporting for your assigned segment, giving leadership a clear, real-time view of how the business is performing
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and recurring reports that leadership relies on to make decisions
  • Own program attribution — the tracking, operations, and reporting that connect activity to outcomes

Process & Program Development

  • Design, build, and optimize end-to-end processes for your segment, from initial concept to rollout and iteration
  • Own pipeline/workflow management for your segment, identifying bottlenecks and driving improvements

Strategic Initiatives & Performance

  • Track performance against goals and KPIs for your segment, flagging gaps early and calling out what's working
  • Identify growth opportunities by digging into the data where conversion is leaking, where capacity is underused, where a small change could move a big number
  • Build the business case for new initiatives: scope the opportunity, size the impact, and get leadership buy-in
  • Execute initiatives end-to-end, from planning through rollout, adjusting as you go based on what the data shows
  • Report on initiative outcomes against the original goals, and use those learnings to shape what you tackle next

Tools, Systems & Automation

  • Build, own, and maintain the backend workflows and automations that power your segment's day-to-day operations in the HighLevel’s CRM
  • Leverage AI solutions for reporting, dashboards, and analysis

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as the analytics and operations partner to your segment's leadership — meeting with them regularly (e.g., weekly) to review progress, surface issues, and align on priorities
  • Support onboarding, training, and change management when new processes or tools roll out
  • Fulfill ad hoc requests from leadership, prioritizing and scoping work independently

What We're Looking For

  • 2-4 years of experience in business/revenue analysis, sales/marketing operations, or a related analytical or operational field
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL; experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience with a CRM (Salesforce preferred) and comfort building within or alongside GTM systems and automation platforms
  • Proven ability to build a process or program from scratch — scoping it, standing it up, and iterating based on results
  • Experience building or maintaining backend workflows, automations, or internal tools (no-code/low-code platforms, Zapier, workflow builders, etc. are a plus)
  • Strong attribution/tracking instincts — comfortable connecting activity data to outcomes and building reporting that holds up to scrutiny
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex analysis into a clear narrative for leadership audiences
  • A track record of operating independently in ambiguous situations, troubleshooting systems issues, and driving work to resolution
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus, not a requirement

EEO Statement:

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

About the Role

The Technical Customer Success Manager for AI Agents is a vital client-facing role focused on ensuring the success of our B2B SaaS customers. In this position, you will take ownership of post-sales processes, working closely with clients to configure our software, troubleshoot any issues, and implement AI agents and workflows. This role is not engineering-focused; rather, it requires a technical background to understand and manage integrations and determine when engineering support is necessary.
You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where quick responses to customer needs are essential. Your proactive approach and technical curiosity will empower you to build strong relationships with our clients, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes with our solutions. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of customer success principles and a passion for technology.

Responsibilities

  • Manage post-sales processes for B2B SaaS customers, ensuring successful implementation and ongoing support.
  • Configure software solutions based on customer requirements, ensuring optimal setup for AI agents and workflows.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and provide timely resolutions to customer inquiries and challenges.
  • Collaborate with clients to develop effective AI prompts and integrations that meet their business needs.
  • Maintain ownership of customer issues and open items, providing updates and follow-through on resolutions.
  • Identify when engineering support is necessary and communicate effectively with the integration engineering team.
  • Foster strong relationships with customers to build confidence in our solutions and support offerings.
  • Document customer interactions and solutions to enhance knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Provide training and guidance to customers on using our software effectively.
  • Work within US business hours to ensure availability for customer support.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in a customer success management role, particularly within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical aptitude to configure software, troubleshoot issues, and understand integrations and AI workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ownership mentality, with a proactive approach to customer service and issue resolution.
  • Comfort with technical tools and platforms related to AI agents and integrations.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including engineering when necessary.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple customer accounts and issues simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI technologies and their application in customer service or operations.
  • Familiarity with API integrations and software development processes.
  • Previous experience in a technical support or implementation role.
  • Knowledge of customer success metrics and best practices.
  • Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) tools and customer success software.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing company at the forefront of AI technology.
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages professional growth.
  • Access to ongoing training and development to enhance your skills and knowledge.
  • Remote work opportunities that allow for a flexible work environment.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Supportive team culture that values ownership, speed, and proactive engagement.
We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all walks of life and strive to create equal opportunities for everyone. Thank you for considering a career with us!

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT YOUWe are looking for a Developer Evangelist – Community to be the public face of Xsolla in the game developer ecosystem, building trust, engagement, and advocacy across online and offline communities.
jobs.description:
ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Developer Evangelist – Community to be the public face of Xsolla in the game developer ecosystem, building trust, engagement, and advocacy across online and offline communities. This role focuses on technical content creation including coding, SDKs, and APIs, community presence, and relationship-building to help game developers discover, adopt, and succeed with Xsolla’s products.
You will act as a storyteller and connector—translating complex technical concepts into accessible, inspiring content while ensuring Xsolla has a strong, credible voice in the most relevant developer spaces.

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish and maintain a strong presence in top game developer communities .
  • Represent Xsolla at developer conferences, meetups, and industry events .
  • Organize and participate in developer meetups, hackathons, and regional gatherings.
  • Produce high-quality technical and inspirational materials, including: Articles, blog posts, and tutorials. Videos, webcasts, and looms. Social media stories, posts, and developer updates.
  • Keep all content up to date and aligned with the latest product releases and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Developer Marketing to amplify content reach and engagement.
  • Act as a trusted liaison between developers and Xsolla’s Product/Technical teams.
  • Gather, organize, and share feedback from the community to help improve product features and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities for lighthouse integration cases and partner with internal teams to bring them to life.
  • Track and report on: Reach and engagement of produced content. Community participation and growth. Developer satisfaction with materials and events.
  • Use insights to refine outreach tactics and maximize impact.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • 3–5 years in Developer Advocacy, Community Management, or related roles, ideally in the game industry.
  • Technical background and software development experience.
  • Solid understanding of game development processes and tools (mobile, PC, and/or web).
  • Proven ability to produce engaging technical content across multiple formats.
  • Strong presence in online developer communities and comfort in public speaking.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to travel for conferences, meetups, and other community events.

Benefits:

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Team Description:

The Ads Retrieval ML team builds the machine learning systems that identify relevant advertising candidates for Reddit users. Retrieval sits at the heart of the ads delivery funnel: before downstream ranking and auction decisions, our models determine which campaigns and ads are eligible to compete. We work on large-scale retrieval across multiple objectives, placements, and geographies. Our work combines representation learning, candidate generation, nearest-neighbor search, behavioral and contextual signals, and rigorous offline and online experimentation.

Role Description:

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Retrieval ML team. You will lead the design and evolution of retrieval models and modeling practices that improve relevance, advertiser outcomes, and user experience at Reddit scale. This is an applied ML role centered on retrieval modeling and end-to-end product impact. You will be expected to stay close to the technical details—from data and objective design through model development, evaluation, experimentation, and launch—while setting direction for other engineers.

Responsibilities:

  • Define the technical direction and multi-year roadmap for ads retrieval modeling in partnership with engineering, product, data science, and ads stakeholders.
  • Design, develop, and launch candidate-generation and retrieval models for campaigns and ads across Reddit’s advertising surfaces.
  • Apply modern approaches such as two-tower architectures, representation learning, embeddings, sequence models, graph-based methods, and other deep learning techniques when they create meaningful product value.
  • Improve the retrieval stack across key modeling decisions, including objectives, labels, sampling strategies, hard-negative mining, feature design, embedding generation, candidate filtering, and retrieval depth.
  • Work with approximate nearest-neighbor and vector retrieval systems, reasoning about recall, relevance, freshness, diversity, coverage, latency, and cost trade-offs.
  • Establish strong evaluation practices that connect retrieval metrics—such as recall, precision, candidate coverage, calibration, and downstream lift—to ads and user outcomes.
  • Lead offline analysis and online experiments, interpret ambiguous results, and translate findings into the next modeling iteration.
  • Partner with downstream ranking, ads platform, auction, measurement, and product teams to ensure retrieval models integrate effectively into the full ads funnel.
  • Write design documents, review code and model changes, and raise the quality bar for modeling, testing, observability, and production ownership.
  • Mentor ML engineers and help grow the team’s expertise in retrieval, recommendation, and representation learning.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of industry experience, including substantial experience building and shipping applied ML products.
  • Deep experience with information retrieval, candidate generation, recommender systems, ranking, or related relevance problems.
  • Strong understanding of retrieval modeling concepts, including DNN, embeddings, two-tower or dual-encoder models, approximate nearest-neighbor search, and multi-stage retrieval.
  • Deep experience training, evaluating, debugging, and deploying deep learning models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ownership of ML projects from problem framing and data preparation through offline evaluation, online experimentation, production launch, and iteration.
  • Strong command of experimental design and model evaluation, including how offline retrieval metrics relate to downstream business and user metrics.
  • Experience working with large-scale behavioral, contextual, or content datasets and complex feature pipelines.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to write clear, reliable, maintainable production code.
  • Technical leadership experience: setting direction, leading complex projects, influencing partner teams, and mentoring other engineers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex modeling choices to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with ads retrieval, ad serving, recommendation, search relevance, or marketplace optimization
  • Experience modeling user, content, campaign, or ad interactions with sequential, graph, or multimodal signals
  • Experience connecting retrieval improvements to downstream ranking, auction, conversion, revenue, or user-experience outcomes
  • Experience in ads marketplaces at peer companies
  • Publications, patents, or industry contributions in applied ML or ranking systems
  • Experience with sequential modeling (e.g., RNNs, Transformers)

Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a systems-minded, digitally fluent Senior Designer to build the visual foundations that make Insider One unmistakable and scalable.     • Use Claude, Adobe AI tools, and Model Context Protocol-enabled workflows to research, ideate, prototype, automate repetitive work, and improve developer handoff.

    • Review live implementation and other designers’ work, giving precise feedback that protects the brand, raises craft, and develops the wider team.

    • Manage multiple projects with strong file hygiene, version control, documentation, and prioritization, using performance feedback to improve future work.

What You Will Need

    • 6+ years of experience in brand, visual, digital, or web design within fast-growth B2B SaaS, technology, a design studio, or an agency.

    • A collaborative, low-ego approach, with the ability to strengthen other designers’ work and contribute across global teams.

Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global, integrated healthcare services and products company connecting patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination and better patient management. Backed by nearly 100 years of experience, with more than 50,000 employees in nearly 60 countries, Cardinal Health ranks among the top 20 on the Fortune 500.

What Application Development & Maintenance contributes to Cardinal Health
Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.

Application Development & Maintenance performs configuration or coding to develop, enhance and sustain the organization's software systems in a cross-functional team environment through adherence to established design control processes and good engineering practices. This job family programs and configures end user applications, systems, databases and websites to achieve the organization's internal needs and externally-facing business needs. Application Development & Maintenance partners with business leaders, investigates user needs and conducts regular assessments, maintenance and enhancements of existing applications.

Medical Enterprise IT Organization has an open job role for an Engineer, Software Engineer SAP S4 PTP, SCE and MM supporting Medical Core Systems.

The Medical Global Supply Chain Execution team is responsible for managing the IT relationship between Cardinal Health business and IT teams. The team focuses on both Run (Daily production support) and Build (Project) support. The role is responsible for both tactical project execution and determining strategic opportunities for improving business processes through IT functionality.

  • Develop business process knowledge and able to apply the knowledge to development of software functionality and related documentation

  • Collaborate with other EIT teams as needed in performing the support activities
  • Communicate effectively to business partners and other supporting teams

Qualifications

  • Functional SAP knowledge preferred
  • SAP MM (Materials Management) module

  • Experience with creating configurations within the and MM modules and experience PTP

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Healthcare Technology Platform
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryWe are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead product strategy, requirements, and delivery for our healthcare technology platform.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead product strategy, requirements, and delivery for our healthcare technology platform. This role owns product strategy, stakeholder engagement, prioritization, roadmap execution, and provides hands-on technical participation in solution design, integrations, and delivery planning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
  • Own backlog prioritization and requirements management.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between executive leadership, customers, operations, and engineering.
  • Translate business needs into actionable user stories and technical requirements.
  • Participate in architecture, integration, API, and solution design discussions.
  • Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release management.
  • Assist with technical analysis, troubleshooting, and proof-of-concept efforts.
  • Drive customer feedback collection and support ticket analysis to fulfill continuous product improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of Product Management, Technical Product Management, Business Analysis, Software Engineering, or related experience.
  • Experience delivering enterprise software products.
  • Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Great organizational skills.
  • Healthcare technology experience.
  • Java and Spring Boot ecosystem familiarity.
  • REST APIs, SQL, Azure, and microservices experience.
  • Healthcare interoperability knowledge is a plus.
  • Understanding of HIPAA, SOC 2, and security best practices.

Additional Details

We're looking for a Technical Product Manager who is a motivated, hands-on leader who can balance strategic thinking with technical depth, embrace complex challenges, and drive product excellence from concept through delivery. This position will require someone who can speak fluent business, fluent customer, and fluent engineer. That combination is much more valuable to us today than hiring a pure Product Manager or a pure engineering leader.

You will be required to own product strategy, stakeholder engagement, prioritization, and roadmap execution for the development organization, enabling the CTO to focus on technology leadership, architecture, and strategic initiatives, while also bringing enough hands-on technical expertise to effectively partner with engineers and contribute to technical documentation and product development success.

Ready to Take on the Challenge?

If you are passionate about building innovative healthcare technology solutions and thrive at the intersection of product strategy, customer engagement, and technical execution, we would love to hear from you. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our platform, influence key business decisions, and work closely with executive leadership and engineering teams to deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers.

If you're excited by the opportunity to make a significant impact in a growing organization and help scale the next generation of healthcare technology, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Founded in 1979, The Chicago School is an independent professional graduate school with a dynamic student body and a professionally accomplished faculty. Our curriculum and training opportunities prepare graduates to deliver outstanding professional services emphasizing the ability to understand and work with diverse populations.

Position Summary:

The Doctorate in International Psychology Program (Online Campus) at The Chicago School is currently seeking qualified individuals to supervise the dissertation research studies of the doctoral students. All the milestone dissertation courses at The Chicago School are 7 weeks long and are taught in the Canvas Learning Management System.

Milestone dissertation courses:

  • IP901 - Dissertation Proposal Preparation
  • IP902 - Dissertation 1: Proposal Completion and IRB
  • IP903 - Dissertation 2: Data Reporting and Analysis
  • IP904 - Dissertation 3: Final Draft Preparation and Defense

Principal Duties:

The dissertation chairs will approve the dissertation proposal (chapters 1, 2, and 3) of the doctoral students and the committee readers proposed by the students, assist students in the development of the oral proposal defense, participate virtually in the oral proposal defense, help students with the IRB application, supervise the data collection of the research studies, support students in the development of chapters 4 and 5 and the final dissertation defense as well as attending the virtual dissertation defenses.

All Online adjunct faculty members at The Chicago School are expected to be available (online) and responsive to students five out of seven days during the course of the week. This “availability” includes:

  • Active participation in the discussion forum;
  • Posting course-related announcement(s);
  • Timely grading of assignments and providing quality feedback;
  • Holding virtual office hours.

In addition, it is expected that all adjunct faculty members adhere to the following duties during a 7-week term:

  • Posting a welcome message to all students outlining weekly virtual office hours.
  • Creating a video welcome message and post to Canvas course site.
  • Holding one voluntary conference call or synchronous chat each term, either via Zoom (account information provided by the Department Manager).
  • Responding to each student’s initial post in a discussion forum.
  • Grading quizzes and providing feedback on short assignments within 48 hours.
  • Providing grading and feedback on larger assignments within 3 days after due date.
  • Responding to all student email(s) within 24 hours.
  • Issuing final grade on time (by Tuesday midnight after Week 7 ends).

All online adjunct faculty are required to complete an 8-week training course reviewing online pedagogy best practices prior to teaching their assigned courses.

Position Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree in Psychology or International Psychology
  • Previous online teaching experience (3 years preferred)
  • Exemplary professional experience
  • Engagement in research and scholarship (preferred)

Disclaimer:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

This job posting, and all others for adjunct faculty roles with The Chicago School, are posted as “evergreen” roles. This means that there is usually an ongoing need for departments to hire 1-2 adjuncts each semester (usually for teaching specialized topics), and they prefer to keep a running pool of applicants to select from when the need to hire arises. Given this information, please note that your application to our evergreen roles will be reviewed on an as needed basis and you may not hear back immediately. If you would like an update on your application status, you can email . We sincerely appreciate your interest in working with us and hope this won’t deter you from continuing to submit your application for any current or future roles you may be interested in.

Compensation & Benefits

This opportunity is budgeted at $1,124-1,540 per credit and may vary per course with student enrollment. Additional compensation factors may impact total compensation. To learn more about our competitive benefits and additional rewards, including generous paid time-off, medical and dental insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement plan with employer contribution, multiple flexible spending accounts, tuition reimbursement, click the link below.

The Chicago School is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Please note: For the protection of faculty, staff, students, and all who enter our facilities, The Chicago School strongly recommends that all employees are fully vaccinated for COVID-19 per CDC guidance.

Work From Anywhere in the Philippines

Work Schedule: Mountain Time (Alberta) | 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM MT, 12.5-hour shifts on a seven-day rotation (three on, three off or similar). These hours fall during daytime in the Philippines.

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. They're looking for the sharpest, hungriest candidates who they can consistently promote and work with over many years. Candidates we've hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US.

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for:
Watch here:

About the Client

A Canadian energy operations company managing generation assets in Alberta's electricity market is looking for an Electricity Power Dispatcher to run daily operational planning and real-time grid coordination for a 24/7 operations center.

The company operates a round-the-clock control function that sits between its own generation assets, the on-site operators who run them, and the Independent System Operator that governs the market. It is building out a remote dispatch crew to cover the overnight Alberta window, with company-provided equipment and secure VPN access to all operating systems.

About the Role

Mornings run on a hard deadline: between 6:30 AM and 10:00 AM Alberta time you build and submit the daily operational plan, determine what each asset will do today and tomorrow, and get that plan accepted by the system operator before the market window closes. After 10:00 AM the work shifts to monitoring web-based portals, holding compliance against the accepted plan, and responding to system operator notifications within a two-minute window while coordinating on-site operators and internal teams. Success is zero missed market deadlines, zero missed response windows, and every communication loop closed and confirmed before the handover.

Core Responsibilities

Morning Operations Planning (40%)

  • Build and submit the daily operational plan between 6:30 AM and 10:00 AM Alberta time for current and next-day asset activity.
  • Submit asset offers to the Independent System Operator ahead of market deadlines.
  • Confirm plan acceptance by the system operator before moving into monitoring mode.
  • Coordinate across internal teams and on-site operators to close out plans inside the morning window.

Real-Time Monitoring and Compliance (35%)

  • Monitor operations against the accepted plan for the remainder of the shift.
  • Track web-based portals and communication systems for alerts, notifications, and system operator messages.
  • Respond to system operator notifications within two minutes, coordinating all affected stakeholders.
  • Verify that instructed actions are executed and confirmations are received, with no open loops left running.

Stakeholder Communication and Coordination (25%)

  • Act as the communication hub between on-site generation asset operators, system operators, and internal teams.
  • Apply documented operating procedures when alerts trigger: categorize the issue, contact the right parties, gather information, and relay updates.
  • Run direct operational communication with external operators by internet-routed phone and digital channels.
  • Complete a 15-minute handover at both ends of each shift and join quarterly cross-team sessions with the Alberta-based crew.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 2+ years currently working as a Power Dispatcher, System Operator, Grid Operator, or Control Center Operator in the Philippine utility or energy sector, active in the role today
  • Hands-on Independent System Operator (ISO) coordination, including building and submitting daily operational plans or asset offers within market deadlines
  • Energy trading or generation asset dispatch experience covering market offers, scheduling, or grid compliance
  • 24/7 operations center experience with documented response-time requirements under five minutes
  • External-facing operational communication with on-site operators, system operators, or regulatory bodies via phone and web-based portals
  • Availability for 12.5-hour shifts covering 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM Mountain Time on a seven-day rotation including holidays, with wired internet plus a documented backup connection (separate-provider LTE hotspot or satellite)
  • C1+ English (CEFR) for real-time phone coordination with external operators and system operators

Nice-to-Have

  • Coding or scripting ability for workflow automation (Python, VBA, or equivalent micro-scripts)
  • SCADA or energy management system (EMS) platform experience
  • Dispatcher certification or a power systems / electrical engineering credential
  • Track record of onboarding quickly onto multiple web-based operations portals
  • Experience across more than one asset class (transmission, generation, or distribution)

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy
  • Health Coverage for PH-based talents: HMO coverage after 3 months for full-time employees
  • Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts
  • Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth
  • Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application
  2. Screening
  3. Skills Assessment
  4. Topgrading Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Job Offer
  7. Client Onboarding

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re empathetic, organized, and passionate about improving patient experiences through operational excellence, this role is for you. Apply now to help make specialized healthcare more accessible to patients across the U.S.

jobs.description:
MEP BIM Coordinator for Data Centers – Independent Contractor (Philippines)

Location: Philippines, Remote

Industry: Mission Critical Facilities and Data Centers

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor Agreement for Provision of Services (long term)

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced MEP BIM Coordinator for a long-term independent contractor engagement.

This is an ongoing contractual engagement with a US-based company and is not limited to a single project. The role supports multiple hyperscale and AI data center projects based on business needs.

You will provide services as an independent, self-employed professional under a formal independent contractor agreement.

How to Apply: Submit your resume in English, describing your MEP BIM coordination and data center project experience.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced MEP BIM Coordinator to coordinate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection models for mission-critical data center projects.

You will manage multidisciplinary model coordination, perform clash detection, lead issue-resolution workflows, and verify that MEP models meet project BIM requirements. You will work closely with MEP engineers and designers, architects, structural engineers, BIM specialists, project managers, and trade partners to produce coordinated, constructible design information.

Success in this role requires advanced Autodesk Revit and Revizto software expertise, practical knowledge of MEP systems, strong spatial coordination skills, and experience delivering complex data center or other mission-critical facility projects in a collaborative BIM environment.

What We Offer

  • Experience in a high-tech industry completing work for an international company.
    • Unique, cutting-edge data center projects.
    • Dynamic work partnering with a team of professionals focused on engineering.

• Competitive hourly rate.

• Ability to collaborate remotely.

  • Supportive dynamic environment.

• English classes made available.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate federated BIM models across mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, and structural disciplines for data center projects.
    • Perform 3D clash detection, spatial coordination, and interference analysis using Navisworks, Revizto, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or comparable platforms.
    • Plan and facilitate regular MEP coordination meetings, assign issues to responsible parties, and document agreed resolutions and due dates.
    • Create, maintain, and track clash reports, coordination logs, model health reports, and issue dashboards through closure.
    • Review equipment layouts, routing, penetrations, access zones, service clearances, ceiling spaces, and plantroom arrangements for constructability and maintainability.
    • Verify that discipline models comply with the BIM Execution Plan, project coordinates, naming conventions, approved Revit templates, model segmentation, and file exchange requirements.
    • Review model geometry and data for the required Level of Development and Level of Information, including system classifications, parameters, equipment data, and asset information.
    • Coordinate major data center systems, including HVAC and cooling, hydronic and plumbing networks, electrical distribution, containment, fire protection, controls, and related equipment interfaces.
    • Support the production and review of coordinated drawings, installation information, schedules, and model-based deliverables at each project stage.
    • Work with design and construction teams to resolve coordination-related RFIs, design changes, field constraints, and model discrepancies.
    • Manage model exchange, publishing, version control, and issue workflows in Autodesk Construction Cloud and other project collaboration environments.
    • Contribute to BIM quality assurance, coordination standards, Revit content, templates, and continuous improvement of digital delivery processes.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, architecture, construction management, or a related discipline.
    • Minimum 5 years of hands-on BIM experience on multidisciplinary building projects, including substantial MEP model coordination responsibility.
    • Experience coordinating data centers, mission-critical facilities, industrial buildings, healthcare facilities, or other technically complex projects.
    • Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems and their spatial and operational interfaces.
    • Advanced Autodesk Revit skills, including model linking, worksharing, coordination, creation of families, parameters, and schedules.
    • Strong experience with Navisworks or Revizto for clash detection, issue tracking, and multidisciplinary coordination.
    • Working knowledge of Autodesk Construction Cloud, including model publishing, document control, coordination spaces, and issue workflows.
    • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, equipment layouts, system diagrams, and construction documentation.
    • Knowledge of BIM Execution Plans, common data environments, Level of Development requirements, model QA/QC, and digital delivery standards.

This is a remote position.

About Datahash

Datahash is a privacy-centric first-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low-code, no-code integrations between web, app, e-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.

The role

Datahash is entering the US with a specific thesis: mid-market and enterprise brands running customer data platforms and reverse-ETL tools pay too much for what they use, and Datahash Signals is a drop-in replacement for the data-activation half of that stack at a fraction of the cost. You will carry that wedge into a named list of accounts, working with our Head of Sales who is relocating to the US, with a US anchor client as your reference, and with agents producing the target list, account intelligence and outreach drafts behind you. You will also carry SYNAPSE, our AI-driven product, into US design partners as it launches.

What you will do

  1. Work the wedge. Pursue a named list of US accounts running Hightouch, Segment, Tealium or similar, from first conversation to displacement, on a technical, multi-stakeholder sale.
  2. Build pipeline. 300K of qualified pipeline by month three and 700K by month six, sourced from the wedge, partner referrals and the reference account.
  3. Land SYNAPSE. Two SYNAPSE closes in the first year with US design partners.
  4. Prove the case. Turn the US anchor account into a published case study and a referenceable customer.
  5. Report clean. CRM current, every conversation logged, weekly read against pace.

What success looks like

  • Pipeline milestones met at month three and month six, then bookings on plan.
  • Two SYNAPSE closes and a live US case study in year one.
  • A repeatable displacement pitch documented for the next US hire.

How we hire

We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. An AI assistant helps us screen applications against the must-haves in this description and helps schedule conversations; every decision about a person is made by a person.

Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.

We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.


Requirements

What we need from you

  • Eight to ten years selling data infrastructure, martech, CDP, analytics or adtech to US mid-market and enterprise brands, with named wins.
  • You have displaced an incumbent tool before and can explain how you built the business case.
  • Real understanding of the modern data stack: CDPs, reverse ETL, warehouses, conversions APIs, identity and consent.
  • Comfort selling for a company that is new to the US market: you build credibility yourself, with proof and references, not with brand.
  • Disciplined CRM habits and daily, fluent use of AI tools.
  • Based in the US with the right to work; able to travel to clients and to our Dubai and India teams occasionally.

Nice to have

  • Existing relationships with marketing-operations and data leaders at retail, DTC, travel or subscription brands.
  • Experience selling with or into Google, Meta or Amazon Ads ecosystems.

Probably not a fit if

  • You need a large marketing and SDR engine to feed you; the first US seat builds its own pipeline with agent support.
  • Your background is agency or services without a product sale.

Benefits

  • A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
  • Competitive compensation and one of the most employee-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
  • Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
  • Health cover for you and your family.
  • Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
  • A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.

Variance Analysis & Strategic Insight

Performance Monitoring & Ad-Hoc Analysis

Stakeholder Support & Investor Diligence

  • Come up with ideas that work best for each platform. A TikTok isn't a LinkedIn post (thankfully).
  • Turn dev updates, gameplay chaos, community moments, memes and whatever the internet is obsessed with this week into content that feels fresh, funny and very PANIC STATIONS.
  • Keep our voice consistent and recognisable across the studio, the games and the community.
  • Try new stuff constantly: formats, hooks, edits, trends, platforms. Some of it will flop. That's fine, that's the job.
  • Spot the moment and jump on it fast, whether it's a cultural thing, a gaming conversation or something the community's kicked off.
  • Be the face (and voice) of the studio when it's needed: videos, livestreams, community chats and the odd presentation.

2 - Live and Breathe Our Socials

Make players feel heard, welcome and hyped to be part of the community.

  • Chat with players across socials and community channels. Be real, be kind, be on-brand. Be funny without relying on being edgy.
  • Be a voice for the studio online that people trust and actually enjoy.
  • Keep an eye on what players are saying: questions, feedback, vibes and anything that's bubbling up.
  • Bring the good feedback back to the team so everyone knows what players love, want or are getting stuck on.
  • Help build a community that runs on personality, humour, consistency and genuine interaction.
  • Use social listening tools to keep tabs on conversations, creators, trends and sentiment around our games and the genre.

3 - Planning, Numbers & Reporting

Yes, there's a spreadsheet bit. Use data, insight and new tech to figure out what's working and where we can grow.

  • Help the Growth Manager build and keep on top of content calendars, workflows, campaign plans and trackers.
  • Watch how the channels are doing: reach, engagement, follower growth, video performance, sentiment and whatever else each platform cares about.
  • Pull together regular reports covering what worked, what we learned, what's next and what you'd do about it.
  • Use what the numbers tell you to sharpen the content and the channel strategy.
  • Stay on top of platform updates, trends, gaming culture and what good short-form looks like right now.
  • Work closely with the devs and the rest of the studio so the content shows the games properly and fits their creative vision.

Requirements

  • Love video games, gaming culture and being part of a gaming community.
  • Get internet culture: memes, influencers, trending audio, the lot. And you can bring that humour across online without it feeling forced.
  • Know your way around X, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn and Discord.
  • Are handy with Adobe Creative Cloud (mainly Premiere Pro and Photoshop) or similar tools.
  • Know how the next wave of gamers talk, post and play online, and can spot what's next before the rest of us catch on.
  • Open to the use of new tools and emerging technologies.

  • WRITE IT DOWN: Identify and work cross functionally to resolve inefficiencies in systems and processes.
  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Prioritize the Twilio customer experience and protect the Twilio Brand.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years of experience with 4 years in building teams, managing all monthly forecasting, and can support fiscal planning and revenue tracking for all major accounts in the region.
  • Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets & business objectives.

  • Highly analytical and data driven; an innovative thinker and creative problem solver who is naturally curious.

Desired:

Location

Travel

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Deal Strategy & Operations Analyst to help Bask Health evaluate commercial deal structures, coordinate internal reviews, and improve the processes that support merchant agreements.

You'll work closely with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to analyze proposed commercial arrangements, prepare deal documentation, and help move agreements through the appropriate approval processes.

This role combines commercial analysis with hands-on operations. You'll review pricing structures, identify missing or inconsistent information, compare deal scenarios, and coordinate the steps needed to move approved agreements toward execution.

You'll also analyze recurring deal issues and help improve how our teams manage quotes, approvals, and commercial handoffs.

We're looking for someone who is analytical, organized, comfortable working with commercial data, and able to manage details while coordinating with multiple teams.

  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations on reporting and process standardization.
  • Coordinate cross-functional discussions needed to resolve deal-related issues.
  • Track outstanding deal requirements and follow through until the appropriate teams have completed them.
  • Prepare clear commercial summaries and recommendations for internal stakeholders.
  • Help improve communication between Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Deal Desk.
