jobs.description:
[El texto en español se encuentra a continuación]

1. Call for new GMP members

The International Trans Fund (ITF) is seeking applications from committed activists to be members of its Grant Making Panel (GMP). Applicants may be based and organize within any region of the world.

2. About the ITF

The International Trans Fund (ITF) is a participatory grantmaking fund led by trans activists and donors. We resource trans-led groups globally to advance human rights, self-determination, well-being, and movement power. We have a specific focus on supporting groups with limited access to funding.

3. Role of the GMP

The GMP reviews eligible applications and makes funding decisions consistent with ITF’s mission, values, and priorities. Decisions of the GMP are final, pending Board ratification.

The key responsibilities of the Grant Making Panel are to:

  • Participate in online GMP training.
  • Join one annual 6-day in-person meeting (location varies) or a virtual equivalent.
  • Take part in online discussions and at least 75% of scheduled online meetings.
  • Lead grantmaking tasks:
    • Encourage trans communities to apply.
    • Review, score, and provide feedback on applications.
    • Make collective funding decisions.
    • Recommend grantmaking priorities and advise on strategy as relevant.
  • Strictly uphold ITF confidentiality and conflict-of-interest policies.

4. Profile of the Activists we are Seeking
Before deciding to apply, please confirm that:

  • You are committed to advancing trans rights and building sustainable trans movements.
  • Your peers consider you credible and trustworthy.
  • You value participatory grantmaking and collective, movement-accountable decision-making.

5. What “trans” means at ITF

We use “trans” as a political term for people whose gender identity or expression differs from their sex assigned at birth, including binary and non-binary identities and culturally specific identities worldwide. We do not privilege any identity or terminology over another.

6. Time Commitment

  • Annual training: 3–5 hours.
  • Application review: 30–50 applications over ~6 weeks (~50 hours/year).
  • Annual meeting: 6 days + travel (in-person or virtual).

7. Candidate Qualifications

Essential

  • Identify as trans (refer to item 5 above).
  • Minimum 3 years of direct trans activism, ideally as a regional and/or international level.
  • Recognized by trans activists in your region as a community activist/leader.
  • Fluency (spoken and written) in English or Spanish.
  • Able and willing to work in a diverse environment (activists and donors).
  • Passport enabling international travel (for in-person meetings).
  • Reliable in meeting tasks and deadlines.
  • Experience managing and reporting on grants for trans work.

8. Conflict of Interest

GMP members (and immediate family members) may not be significantly involved in any group applying to ITF during their tenure and may not benefit financially from assessed or existing ITF grants (See ITF Conflict of Interest Policy). Please note that this means that if you are part of/involved in an organization and selected as a member of the GMP, the organization will not be eligible to apply for grants during their tenure.

9. Term & Compensation

  • Term: Three (3) years, appointed by the Board.
  • Compensation:USD $1,500 per one-year grant cycle, plus covered travel and per diem for ITF meetings.

10. Selection Process

The Board will appoint seven activists with attention to diversity across gender identities/expressions and inclusion of further-marginalized groups within trans communities. We highly encourage trans men and trans masculine folks to apply.

11. How to Apply

Please submit an application in BambooHR by November 30, 2026.

We intend to inform all candidates of our decisions by January 2027.

//

1. Convocatoria para nuevas personas integrantes del PCA

El Fondo Internacional Trans (FIT) busca activistas comprometides para formar parte de su Panel de Concesión de Apoyos (PCA) . Las personas solicitantes pueden residir y organizarse en cualquier región del mundo.

2. Acerca del FIT

El Fondo Internacional Trans (FIT) es un fondo participativo de apoyos financieros liderado por activistas trans y donantes que lo apoyan. Proporcionamos recursos a grupos liderados por personas trans en todo el mundo para promover los derechos humanos, la autodeterminación, el bienestar y el empoderamiento de los movimientos, especialmente para aquellos grupos con acceso limitado a financiación.

3. Función del PCA

El PCA revisa las solicitudes que cumplen los requisitos y toma decisiones de financiamiento acordes con la misión, los valores y las prioridades de FIT. Las decisiones del PCA son definitivas, a la espera de la ratificación de la junta directiva.

Las principales responsabilidades del panel de concesión de apoyos son:

  • Participar en la capacitación en línea del PCA.
  • Participar en una reunión anual presencial de 6 días (la ubicación varía) o en su equivalente virtual.
  • Participar en los debates en línea y en al menos el 75% de las reuniones en línea programadas.
  • Liderar las tareas de concesión de apoyos financieros:
    • Alentar a las comunidades trans a presentar una solicitud.
    • Revisar, calificar y proporcionar comentarios sobre las solicitudes.
    • Tomar decisiones colectivas sobre el financiamiento.
    • Recomendar prioridades en la concesión de apoyos financieros y asesorar sobre la estrategia pertinente.
  • Respetar estrictamente las políticas de confidencialidad y de conflicto de intereses del FIT.

4. Perfil de las personas activistas que buscamos
Antes de decidirse a presentar su solicitud, confirme que:

  • Tienes compromiso con el avance de los derechos de las personas trans y la construcción de movimientos trans sostenibles.
  • Tus pares te consideran una persona creíble y digna de confianza.
  • Valoras la concesión participativa de apoyos financieros y la toma de decisiones colectiva y responsable ante el movimiento.

5. ¿Qué significa “trans” para el FIT?

Usamos “trans” como término político para referirnos a las personas cuya identidad o expresión de género difiere del sexo que se les asignó al nacer, incluyendo identidades binarias y no binarias, así como identidades culturalmente específicas en todo el mundo. No privilegiamos ninguna identidad ni terminología sobre otra.

6. Compromiso de tiempo

  • Capacitación anual: 3-5 horas.
  • Revisión de solicitudes: entre 30 y 50 solicitudes durante aproximadamente 6 semanas ( aproximadamente 50 horas al año ).
  • Reunión anual: 6 días + viaje (presencial o virtual).

7. Requisitos de la persona postulante

Básico

  • Identificarse como persona trans (consultar el punto 5 anterior).
  • Mínimo 3 años de activismo trans directo, idealmente a nivel regional y/o internacional.
  • Tener reconocimiento de activistas trans de tu región como activista/líder comunitarie.
  • Fluidez (oral y escrita) en inglés o español .
  • Capaz y con disposición a trabajar en un entorno diverso (activistas y donantes).
  • Pasaporte que permite viajar internacionalmente (para reuniones presenciales).
  • Confiable en el cumplimiento de tareas y plazos.
  • Experiencia en la gestión y presentación de informes sobre financiamientos para proyectos relacionados con personas trans.

8. Conflicto de intereses:

Las personas integrantes del PCA (y sus familiares directos) no podrán participar activamente en ningún grupo que solicite financiamiento al FIT durante su mandato, ni beneficiarse económicamente de los apoyos financieros del FIT ya concedidos o en curso ( véase la Política de Conflicto de Intereses de la FIT ). Ten en cuenta que, si formas parte de una organización o participas en ella y se te selecciona como integrante del PCA, dicha organización no podrá solicitar apoyos financieros durante su mandato.

9. Duración y remuneración

  • Duración del mandato: Tres (3) años, designado por la Junta.
  • Compensación:
    1.500 dólares estadounidenses por ciclo anual de apoyos financieros, además de los gastos de viaje y dietas cubiertos para las reuniones del FIT.

10. Proceso de selección:

La junta designará a siete activistas, prestando especial atención a la diversidad de identidades y expresiones de género, así como a la inclusión de grupos más marginados dentro de las comunidades trans. Alentamos encarecidamente a hombres trans y personas trans masculinas a presentar su solicitud.

11. Cómo solicitar

Por favor, envía tu solicitud a través de BambooHR antes del 30 de noviembre de 2026.

Tenemos previsto informar a todas las personas postulantes de nuestras decisiones antes de enero de 2027.

But it was once a humble boy’s school in Smyrna, Turkey which despite many struggles, had grown to become a beacon of distinction in Asia Minor.

The story of IC started in 1891 when Canadian Protestant Minister Reverend Alexander MacLachlan opened the “American Boys School” in Smyrna, Turkey.

After several name changes, it finally became known as the International College in 1903 when it was chartered by the Common Wealth of Massachusetts.

jobs.excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Exposure Management Engineer to support GuidePoint Security's Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management practice, with a primary focus on deploying, configuring, and operating the Axonius Asset Cloud to power risk-based vulnerability management and cyber asset management for our clients. This role will engage in the development of unified asset inventories, risk-based prioritization models, and automated remediation workflows in Axonius while providing “Wow Them” service to clients and/or internal customers or co-workers.

The Exposure Management Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong asset management, integration, and risk-based vulnerability management skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive exposure management programs — built on Axonius — that will align the delivery of business objectives and priorities.

About the Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management Practice

The Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management Practice is responsible for helping clients see everything they own and fix what matters most. We build unified, real-time asset inventories and risk-based exposure programs — with the Axonius Asset Cloud at the center — that turn fragmented data from hundreds of security and IT tools into a single, trusted asset model and a prioritized, business-aware remediation backlog.

Our team of exposure management engineers, Axonius platform specialists, and automation developers focuses on cyber asset attack surface management (CAASM), risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM), and exposure prioritization. We partner with client security, IT, infrastructure, and cloud teams to eliminate blind spots, de-duplicate findings across tools, assign asset ownership, and drive measurable risk reduction.

Key focus areas of the practice:

  • Deploying and configuring the Axonius Asset Cloud — data connections, asset correlation, and coverage gap analysis
  • Configuring risk-based vulnerability management in Axonius — de-duplication, asset criticality, exploitability, and business-context prioritization
  • Automating enforcement, ticketing, and remediation workflows using the Axonius query and enforcement engine

Roles and Responsibilities:

Axonius Platform Engineering

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain the Axonius Asset Cloud (Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management / exposure platform) across complex hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises client environments.
  • Design and build data connections (adapters) to onboard data from security, IT, identity, cloud, endpoint, and network sources — EDR, vulnerability scanners, MDM, IdP, CMDB, cloud providers, NGFW, and case management tools — via API.
  • Configure and tune the Axonius asset correlation engine so that data from disparate sources resolves into unified, de-duplicated asset records.
  • Perform daily operational support, monitoring, and maintenance of the Axonius platform, including adapter health, data freshness, and system performance.
  • Work with third parties and client tool owners to ensure the correct data is onboarded, credentialed, and refreshed on the right cadence.

Platform Operations

  • Operate and maintain security platforms including vulnerability management, CAASM, and CNAPP tools
  • Monitor security findings and support prioritization and remediation workflows
  • Assist in platform tuning, configuration optimization, and integration with client environments
  • Support onboarding of new assets, applications, and cloud environments into security platforms

Exposure Management Operations

  • Review exposure findings and assist with prioritization and remediation tracking
  • Help manage remediation workflows with client engineering teams
  • Generate operational dashboards and reporting for security leadership
  • Assist in maintaining asset inventory coverage and scanning accuracy

Risk-Based Vulnerability Management (Axonius) Configuration

  • Configure risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM) in Axonius so that vulnerabilities are prioritized by real-world risk — business impact, exposure, and exploitability — rather than by CVSS score alone.
  • Ingest and consolidate vulnerability findings from multiple scanners (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) into Axonius, and configure de-duplication so a single vulnerability reported by different tools is represented once.
  • Build and maintain asset criticality ratings and business-context tags in Axonius so prioritization reflects the importance of each asset to the business.
  • Configure enrichment of findings with threat intelligence and exploitability signals (e.g., known-exploited, active-in-the-wild) to surface the vulnerabilities attackers are most likely to use.
  • Design saved queries and dynamic asset/vulnerability views that isolate high-risk, exposed, mission-critical findings and filter out low-risk noise and items already within SLA.
  • Configure risk scoring, severity mapping, and prioritization logic that combine CVSS, exposure (internet-facing vs. isolated), exploit status, asset criticality, and existing mitigating controls.
  • Build Axonius Enforcement Center actions to automate remediation workflows — create and route tickets to the correct owner in ServiceNow/Jira, notify teams, and track SLA and patch-window adherence.
  • Configure escalation (“fire alarm”) logic and SLA-based rules for critical and zero-day vulnerabilities that require faster-than-standard remediation.
  • Build dashboards and reporting that show remediation progress, SLA compliance, risk reduction over time, and coverage — tailored for both operational teams and security leadership.
  • Continuously tune prioritization models and reduce alert fatigue so client teams focus effort on the findings that actually reduce risk.

Asset Management (Axonius) Configuration

  • Configure Axonius data connections (adapters) across security, IT, cloud, identity, endpoint, and network sources to build a comprehensive, real-time inventory of all assets — devices, users, cloud resources, SaaS, and software.
  • Tune the asset correlation and de-duplication engine so records from disparate sources merge into a single trusted asset model the entire team can rely on.
  • Configure coverage and gap analysis to automatically surface unmanaged, unknown, or non-compliant assets — e.g., devices missing EDR, endpoints missing an agent, or assets absent from the CMDB.
  • Build and maintain asset categorization, tagging, and business-context enrichment (owner, environment, criticality, data sensitivity, location) to power downstream prioritization and ownership.
  • Configure asset ownership assignment so every finding maps to an accountable owner, closing the “who owns this?” gap that stalls remediation.
  • Establish and maintain data hygiene — adapter scheduling, credential management, field mapping, and data freshness — to keep the inventory accurate and current.
  • Configure enforcement actions that keep the inventory and other systems in sync — e.g., push corrected/enriched asset data back into the CMDB, open tickets for coverage gaps, or trigger onboarding of missing agents.
  • Build saved queries, dashboards, and reports that give clients continuous visibility into asset inventory, coverage, and policy gaps (comparable to building a unified inventory of tens of thousands of assets).
  • Compile and reconcile asset inventories from disparate data sources, applying knowledge of network, cloud, and endpoint technologies commonly used in enterprise environments.
  • Partner with SIEM, automation, and security operations teams to leverage Axonius asset data for detections, automation, and exposure analysis.

CNAPP & Cloud Security Support

  • Assist with the operation and optimization of CNAPP platforms (e.g., Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)
  • Support cloud posture monitoring and exposure analysis
  • Assist with investigation of cloud misconfigurations, identity exposures, and attack paths
  • Work with senior engineers to onboard new cloud environments

Automation & Integrations

  • Develop scripts and automation to improve security workflows
  • Build integrations between security tools and ticketing systems
  • Automate reporting, vulnerability triage, and remediation tracking
  • Use APIs and automation frameworks to reduce manual operational effort
  • Use the Axonius Query Language, REST API, and Enforcement Center to automate asset queries, enrichment, ticketing, and remediation actions.

Client Engagement

  • Participate in regular operational cadence meetings with clients
  • Provide updates on platform findings and remediation progress
  • Assist senior engineers in troubleshooting security platform issues
  • Contribute to documentation and operational playbooks

Required Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering
  • Exposure management or risk-based vulnerability management experience
  • Hands-on experience with the Axonius Asset Cloud (or comparable CAASM / asset intelligence platform) — configuring adapters, correlation, queries, and enforcement actions.
  • Experience building and maintaining unified asset inventories from disparate security and IT data sources.
  • Experience configuring asset criticality, ownership, and business context to drive risk-based prioritization.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management, exposure management, or CNAPP platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, Axonius, or similar tools
  • Scripting experience (Python, PowerShell, or similar)
  • Experience working with APIs or automating workflows
  • Understanding of security fundamentals: vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, identity and access control, security monitoring
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with engineering teams
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with CNAPP platforms such as: Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca, Lacework
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Familiarity with container security and Kubernetes
  • Experience integrating security tools with ticketing platforms (Jira, ServiceNow)
  • Direct engineering experience with Axonius adapters, correlation tuning, and the Enforcement Center.
  • Experience with cyber asset management (CAASM), asset discovery, and network enumeration tooling.
  • Experience in Linux environments and API-based data retrieval from security/infrastructure tools (EDR, IdP, NGFW, cloud providers).
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools (LLMs, copilots, or agent frameworks) to accelerate scripting, analysis, and security operations workflows

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 10% travel

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security.   • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.

  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.

  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Accommodations

jobs.title: Demand and Capacity Planner - North Region
jobs.excerpt: We have two fantastic opportunities for experienced Demand and Capacity Planners to join our Team.
jobs.description:
We have two fantastic opportunities for experienced Demand and Capacity Planners to join our Team. These roles will be remote with national travel across the North region.

Help shape the future of patient transport planning at EMED Group. Supporting the services we deliver for the NHS, you will take ownership of forecasting demand across a group of contracts and translating that insight into clear plans for crews and vehicles. This is your opportunity to move planning beyond historic rosters and on-the-day responses, establishing a forward-looking approach that aligns capacity with anticipated demand. The contracts are yours — their numbers, their monthly meeting, and the argument when the plan and the work do not match.

Build it. Shape it. Own it. You will develop this planning capability from the ground up: creating the forecast, running the monthly planning cycle for your contracts and embedding the rigour that turns data into trusted, actionable insight.

It is worth knowing what the first six months look like. This is a build, and the build starts with data. Your first piece of work is not a forecast; it is establishing what the data can and cannot support, and saying so plainly. Forecasting starts once the baseline holds. If building the thing that makes forecasting possible is the part you enjoy, this is a good one.

If you are in commercial supply chain or contact centre resource planning and wondering whether this translates — it does. It is demand planning and S&OP, with vehicles and crew hours in place of stock.

Benefits for the role include

  • Salary - £50,000
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice
  • Life Assurance
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Build the demand picture for your contracts — journey history by contract, by month, by day of week and by half hour, split by journey type and vehicle type.
  • Bring forecasts to life through practical capacity plans, translating demand into the crew hours, concurrent vehicles and shift shapes the work actually needs, handed to the roster planner as a requirement rather than a roster.
  • Run the monthly demand and capacity meeting for your contracts, with the contract leads, control and the regional team in the room, ensuring stakeholders arrive with the right data and leave with decisions, owners and dates.
  • Challenge into the business where the evidence says the plan is wrong — capacity that does not match the work coming, a roster built around last year, an assumption nobody has examined since it was made — with data rather than volume, and expect to be challenged back.
  • Track your forecast accuracy month on month, distinguishing clearly between a forecast that was wrong and a plan that was not followed.
  • Own the data extraction and cleansing routines that everything else rests on, building them where they do not exist today and making them repeatable rather than heroic.
  • Support bid and contract modelling, so new and renewing work is priced from a real operational picture rather than assumptions.
  • Create a lasting planning capability, building clear, documented processes that others can confidently pick up and run.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Experience building demand or capacity planning processes from the ground up, with the drive to turn a blank canvas into a successful planning capability.
  • Proven experience owning or chairing a recurring planning forum, such as S&OP, IBP or an equivalent, bringing stakeholders together to make decisions and drive action—not simply review reports.
  • The confidence to constructively challenge experienced operational managers with clear evidence, influence decisions and build strong, lasting working relationships.
  • The ability to bring forecasts to life, translating demand into practical resource and capacity plans that support operational delivery.
  • Comfort starting from poor data, and the judgement to tell the difference between a number that is wrong and a number that is merely inconvenient.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, with advanced Excel proficiency as a minimum and a readiness to take ownership of your forecast accuracy.
  • Additional knowledge of workforce management tools, SQL or Power BI would be a welcome advantage—but is not essential.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK.

Salary: £50,000

  • Use Claude Code as a core engineering tool and set the patterns other teams follow when they do the same.
  • Own evaluation: build eval suites and golden datasets, measure accuracy, latency, cost, and tool-call correctness, and gate changes on results.
  • Implement AI guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, and PII handling, working with Platform Engineering on identity and network controls.
  • Ship through CI/CD with versioned prompts and agent definitions, plus tracing and token/cost observability on every path.
  • Support teams adopting shared AI services — review their designs, troubleshoot integrations, and document reusable patterns.
  • Establish KPIs for adoption, quality, and cost-per-outcome, and use them to drive improvement and make the team's impact visible.
  • Participate fully in the agile process — own your sprint tasks, log time worked, and keep details current.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 4–6 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building with large language models in production.
  • Hands-on experience shipping agentic systems: multi-step tool use, structured outputs, state and memory, error recovery — and the judgment to know when an agent isn't the right answer.
  • Working command of Claude or a comparable frontier model platform, including APIs, tool use, and agent SDKs.
  • Practical daily use of AI-assisted development tooling, Claude Code in particular.
  • Retrieval engineering: embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality on its own terms.
  • Evaluation and observability for non-deterministic systems — offline evals, human review loops, tracing, and cost instrumentation.

Software and Cloud

  • Strong Python, plus one of TypeScript, C#, or Java.
  • Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI — model deployment, endpoint configuration, and content safety controls.
  • Azure fundamentals: App Service or Function Apps, Key Vault, Storage, Entra ID managed identities, and Application Insights.
  • CI/CD with Azure DevOps — YAML pipelines, multi-stage deployments, and secret management.
  • REST and async API design, and integration with enterprise systems of record.
  • Databases (SQL and NoSQL) and vector stores; solid Git and code review practice.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Commercial Planning Lead to help Bask Health develop and improve the planning processes that support our commercial organization.

You'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Revenue Operations to translate business priorities into commercial plans, evaluate resource requirements, and establish measurable performance objectives.

This role combines strategic planning, financial analysis, and cross-functional coordination. You'll help leadership understand how merchant acquisition, account growth, team capacity, and commercial investments contribute to business performance.

You'll also develop planning models, compare growth scenarios, and identify opportunities to improve how commercial resources are allocated.

We're looking for someone who is analytical, organized, comfortable working with commercial leadership, and able to turn business objectives into practical plans supported by reliable data.

What You'll Do

  • Lead commercial planning initiatives supporting Bask's growth and business objectives.
  • Develop annual and quarterly commercial operating plans in partnership with relevant teams.
  • Translate commercial priorities into measurable objectives, planning assumptions, and resource requirements.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to understand merchant acquisition goals and commercial capacity needs.
  • Work with Customer Success to incorporate merchant retention and expansion assumptions into commercial plans.
  • Collaborate with Finance to align commercial planning with financial objectives and investment expectations.
  • Develop models that evaluate commercial resource allocation and expected business outcomes.
  • Analyze historical commercial performance to inform future planning assumptions.
  • Support planning for sales capacity, productivity, ramp periods, and commercial coverage.
  • Evaluate the impact of different staffing and investment scenarios on commercial objectives.
  • Develop frameworks for comparing commercial growth opportunities.
  • Analyze merchant segments to identify differences in growth potential and resource requirements.
  • Support planning for new commercial initiatives and market opportunities.
  • Evaluate the operational and financial implications of proposed commercial investments.
  • Help establish consistent planning metrics and performance targets.
  • Develop dashboards and reports that compare commercial plans with actual results.
  • Identify significant differences between planning assumptions and business performance.
  • Recommend adjustments to commercial plans based on performance trends.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to ensure planning models use accurate commercial data.
  • Coordinate cross-functional planning discussions involving Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.
  • Support the development of account coverage and resource allocation strategies.
  • Analyze commercial productivity and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency.
  • Evaluate how merchant acquisition trends affect future commercial capacity requirements.
  • Support planning for changes to commercial programs, processes, or team structures.
  • Develop scenario analyses that help leadership understand business trade-offs.
  • Prepare commercial planning materials and recommendations for leadership.
  • Document planning assumptions, methodologies, and decision frameworks.
  • Support recurring strategic planning and business performance reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve consistency across commercial planning processes.
  • Work with Sales Operations to incorporate operational insights without duplicating day-to-day pipeline management responsibilities.
  • Partner with Finance to evaluate expected returns from commercial investments.
  • Support planning for merchant expansion and account development initiatives.
  • Develop reusable templates for commercial planning, resource allocation, and scenario analysis.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to validate planning inputs and performance assumptions.
  • Monitor commercial trends that may affect longer-term plans.
  • Help leadership prioritize initiatives based on expected business value and resource requirements.
  • Support continuous improvements to Bask's commercial planning and decision-making processes.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Commercial Planning, GTM Strategy, Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, Strategic Finance, Business Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience developing strategic or operating plans for B2B commercial organizations.
  • Strong understanding of commercial performance metrics and business planning processes.
  • Experience developing capacity, productivity, or resource allocation models.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Experience evaluating commercial growth assumptions and investment trade-offs.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into measurable plans and performance targets.
  • Experience working with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, or Revenue Operations leadership.
  • Strong understanding of B2B sales and customer lifecycle processes.
  • Experience comparing planned performance against actual results.
  • Ability to identify risks or gaps in commercial planning assumptions.
  • Experience preparing strategic recommendations and planning materials for leadership.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple planning initiatives and competing priorities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to model accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate business trade-offs and planning recommendations clearly.
  • Experience documenting planning processes and analytical methodologies.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of strategic initiatives.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in commercial planning at a SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience supporting high-growth B2B sales organizations.
  • Familiarity with subscription, transaction-based, or usage-based revenue models.
  • Experience developing annual operating plans or long-term commercial strategies.
  • Experience with sales capacity, quota, and ramp planning.
  • Experience evaluating commercial investments and resource allocation decisions.
  • Familiarity with merchant acquisition and e-commerce platform business models.
  • Experience supporting customer retention and expansion planning.
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms.
  • Experience using SQL for commercial analysis.
  • Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience partnering with FP&A or Strategic Finance teams.
  • Experience developing account coverage or commercial segmentation strategies.
  • Familiarity with marketplace or platform business models.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional commercial planning processes.
  • Familiarity with telehealth or healthcare technology.
  • Experience building planning frameworks in a growing SaaS company.

jobs.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Client Services Manager

Compensation range: $1,200 AUD - $1,500 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: We help Australian service businesses unlock more revenue and reclaim valuable time through intelligent AI automation. By building tailored AI workforces that handle lead follow-ups, customer enquiries, appointment bookings and database reactivation. We help businesses capture opportunities that might otherwise be missed. Our approach combines practical technology with a clear understanding of business operations creating solutions that work seamlessly with existing systems rather than adding more complexity.

What sets us apart is that we don't simply build automation systems and leave businesses to manage them. We take an ongoing partnership approach, designing, implementing, monitoring and continuously improving each solution as the business grows. From responding to new enquiries within seconds to re-engaging dormant customers and streamlining sales processes. Our focus is on delivering measurable commercial outcomes giving business owners greater capacity to focus on growth rather than getting caught up in day-to-day administration.

Role Overview: The Client Services Manager will play a key role in managing client relationships and ensuring the successful delivery of AI automation solutions for Australian businesses. Acting as the primary point of contact for clients, this role will oversee the client journey from onboarding and implementation through to ongoing support ensuring each client understands how their AI workforce operates and receives maximum value from the solutions delivered. Responsibilities will include coordinating internal teams, managing project timelines, providing regular progress updates, addressing client concerns and ensuring automation systems are implemented smoothly and aligned with each client's business objectives.

Beyond day-to-day relationship management the role will focus on client retention, satisfaction and long-term growth. The successful candidate will proactively monitor client performance, identify opportunities to improve existing automations, recommend additional solutions and ensure clients continue to see measurable business results. This is an opportunity for a commercially minded highly organized professional who combines excellent relationship management with strong project coordination skills and an interest in AI, automation and technology. They should be comfortable managing multiple clients, communicating with business owners and translating technical solutions into clear business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building strong and lasting relationships.
  • Manage regular client communication, check-ins and account reviews.
  • Understand client business objectives, challenges and expectations.
  • Proactively address client concerns, manage expectations and resolve issues.
  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction, engagement and retention.

Client Onboarding & Implementation

  • Coordinate new client onboarding ensuring a smooth transition from sales to service delivery.
  • Gather client requirements, business processes and operational information.
  • Work with internal automation specialists to translate client needs into actionable project requirements.
  • Coordinate implementation timelines, milestones and deliverables.
  • Ensure clients understand how their AI automation solutions work and how to get the most value from them.

Project & Service Delivery Coordination

  • Oversee the progress of client projects and ongoing service delivery.
  • Coordinate with technical teams to ensure automations are implemented, tested and operating as expected.
  • Monitor project timelines, outstanding tasks and deliverables.
  • Follow up on technical issues, system improvements and client requests.
  • Keep clients informed of progress, changes and any potential delivery delays.

Account Growth & Client Retention

  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client accounts through additional AI automation solutions.
  • Proactively identify areas where clients could benefit from improved workflows and automation.
  • Monitor client engagement and identify potential retention risks.
  • Conduct regular account reviews to demonstrate value and discuss improvement opportunities.
  • Support upselling and cross-selling initiatives in collaboration with the sales team.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor the performance and effectiveness of client automation solutions.
  • Track client satisfaction, retention, project progress and service delivery metrics.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to investigate performance issues and improvement opportunities.
  • Prepare regular client updates and account performance reports.
  • Ensure clients can clearly understand the business value and results delivered by their AI solutions.

Requirements

  • At least 1.5 years of experience in Client Services, Account Management, Customer Success or Project Management.
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts preferably within an Australian or international business environment.
  • Strong relationship-building, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to be in 70+ WhatsApp groups and stay on top of comms to keep momentum with builds and delivery going.
  • Experience coordinating projects, onboarding clients and managing service delivery.
  • Commercial awareness with the ability to identify account growth and upselling opportunities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms, project management tools and reporting systems.
  • Comfortable working with technology, digital platforms and AI-powered solutions.

Desirable Experience

  • Previous experience in an AI, automation, SaaS or technology-based business.
  • Understanding of AI agents, workflow automation and business process improvement.
  • Experience working with tools such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Monday.com, ClickUp, Zapier or Make.
  • Experience managing client onboarding and ongoing subscription-based services.
  • Familiarity with Australian SMEs and their operational requirements.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Baufinanzierungsexperte (w/m/d) im Homeoffice

Das bieten wir dir

Worauf wartest du noch?

Wenn du ein echter Vertriebsprofi bist, der Abschlüsse liebt und bereit ist, durch Leistung sein Einkommen auf das nächste Level zu bringen, dann wartet bei smava deine Chance.

Bei Fragen erreichst du mich und dein Talent Acquisition Team jederzeit unter

Ich freue mich auf deine Bewerbung! ☺️

Fatin Hamedani

Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungs- und Entwicklungschancen ein, unabhängig vom Geschlecht oder der Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Hautfarbe, Beeinträchtigung, Kultur oder Herkunftsland.

jobs.excerpt: Great companies need great teams to propel their operations.
jobs.description:
Great companies need great teams to propel their operations. Join the group that solves business challenges and enhances the way we work and grow. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values your contributions and puts a premium on work flexibility, learning, and career development.

Summary

As a Provider Enrollment Analyst - Remote US at Gainwell Technologies, you will support provider enrollment and provider revalidation operations for Medicaid healthcare programs. This role plays an important part in ensuring provider data accuracy, regulatory compliance, and fraud prevention initiatives tied to evolving federal and state healthcare requirements.This is a great opportunity for candidates with experience in provider enrollment, healthcare administration, customer support, claims, data entry, or healthcare operations who are looking to grow their career in the healthcare industry. You’ll work with a collaborative team focused on protecting program integrity while supporting healthcare providers through the enrollment and revalidation process.

Your role in our mission

  • Review, process, and verify provider enrollment and provider revalidation applications for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with Medicaid and CMS guidelines.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve provider enrollment discrepancies by working with providers, internal departments, and external stakeholders while identifying potential fraud or inconsistent information.
  • Maintain accurate provider records within enrollment systems and perform quality audits, validation checks, and reporting activities to support operational accuracy and program integrity.
  • Interpret policies, procedures, and workflow requirements while supporting process improvements and updated standard operating procedures within a high-volume operational environment.
  • Handle confidential provider and healthcare information in accordance with HIPAA, company security standards, and regulatory compliance requirements while meeting productivity and quality expectations.

What we're looking for

  • High school diploma or GED required, along with at least 1 year of experience in provider enrollment, provider revalidation, healthcare operations, claims processing, healthcare customer service, or administrative support.
  • Familiarity with Medicaid, Medicare, provider data management, healthcare compliance, or healthcare insurance operations is preferred but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to review documentation, identify inconsistencies, and maintain accuracy in a production-driven environment.
  • Basic to intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel and Outlook, along with strong organizational, communication, and multitasking skills.
  • Harver Assessment Requirement: As part of the interview process, candidates must complete the Harver Assessment to evaluate communication, attention to detail, multitasking, and problem-solving capabilities relevant to the role.

What you should expect in this role

  • This is a fully remote position open to candidates located anywhere within the United States.
  • Employees must be available to work Monday through Friday during Eastern Time business hours, from 8:00 AM ET to 5:30 PM ET, regardless of their local time zone.
  • This role supports provider revalidation and healthcare compliance initiatives tied to evolving federal and state fraud prevention requirements.
  • Daily productivity, quality, attendance, and service level expectations will be monitored in this fast-paced operational environment.
  • Video cameras must be used during interviews and orientation, and employees must maintain a broadband internet connection with minimum speeds of 24 Mbps download and 8 Mbps upload for remote work effectiveness.
  • The deadline to submit applications for this posting is November 20, 2026.

The pay range for this position is $35,000.00 - $50,000.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

Gainwell Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer, where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition), age, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. NCC is a leader in providing award-winning software, credit and compliance solutions, and cutting-edge data to the automotive industry for over 30 years. Our solutions help dealerships streamline their operations, enhance their finance and insurance (F&I) processes, and drive profitability. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a high-growth environment.

Overview:
We're seeking an AI Software Engineer II to help build the next generation of AI-powered capabilities. In this role, you'll develop and deliver production-ready software that integrates large language models (LLMs), machine learning, and cloud-based AI services into customer-facing applications.

You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to rapidly prototype, build, and deploy intelligent features, applying strong software engineering fundamentals to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys solving real-world business problems with modern AI technologies.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features within our SaaS platform.
  • Integrate LLMs and cloud AI services into production applications.
  • Develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, and application integrations.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines that support AI workflows.
  • Contribute across the application stack, including backend services and frontend enhancements as needed.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver customer-centric solutions.
  • Rapidly prototype new AI capabilities and iterate on customer feedback.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code that follows software engineering best practices.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions.

What You’ll Have:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Experience developing applications with Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar object-oriented languages.
  • Experience with consuming or integrating LLMs and AI services via APIs.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs and backend application services.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with Git and modern software development practices.
  • Understanding of databases and data modeling (SQL and/or NoSQL).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Experience using vector databases and embeddings.
  • Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
  • Experience building data pipelines and AI workflows.
  • Experience deploying containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience developing customer-facing SaaS applications.

What Success Looks Like:
Within your first year, you'll contribute production-ready AI features, collaborate effectively across engineering teams, help accelerate AI adoption across our platform, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and reliability of our software solutions.

Description

Senior Systems Engineer – Federal (Department of Energy)

VAST Data is looking to hire a Senior Systems Engineer focused on the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) to join our growing team!

VAST Data is defining an entirely new category in enterprise infrastructure by building the world's first Operating System for AI.

For decades, organizations have relied on fragmented infrastructure stacks—separate systems for storage, databases, messaging, virtualization, and AI pipelines. VAST has fundamentally reimagined this model by unifying these capabilities into a single intelligent software platform purpose-built for the AI era.

As one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies in the world, VAST partners with the industry's leading organizations to power next-generation AI factories, autonomous agents, large-scale model training, and modern data platforms.

Joining VAST means becoming part of a team that isn't just building another infrastructure product—we're creating a new category and defining the foundation upon which the future of AI will run.

If you're excited by transformational technology, solving problems that have never been solved before, and helping customers build the future, we want to hear from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with Account Executives to drive the technical strategy across Department of Energy accounts, National Laboratories, and associated research institutions, from discovery through deployment planning.
  • Design and present architectures that leverage the VAST AI Operating System across on-premises, hybrid cloud, and high-performance computing (HPC) environments.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to DOE customers building AI, scientific computing, advanced analytics, and large-scale data platforms.
  • Lead technical workshops, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and architecture reviews with DOE stakeholders and federal technology partners.
  • Help customers modernize legacy infrastructure to support mission-critical scientific research, AI workloads, and data-intensive applications.
  • Advise customers on Kubernetes-based and containerized environments, ensuring VAST integrates seamlessly into modern application architectures.
  • Articulate VAST's differentiated approach to delivering enterprise storage, database, and data services for HPC, cloud-native applications, and S3-compatible workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering, bringing insights from DOE customer environments into the product roadmap.
  • Support customers building large-scale AI and analytics platforms across National Laboratories, research facilities, and federal data centers.
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies in AI infrastructure, HPC, databases, networking, and distributed systems to position VAST as a strategic technology partner.

Requirements

  • Experience supporting the U.S. Department of Energy, National Laboratories, or federal scientific research organizations.
  • Strong expertise with Linux operating systems and administration.
  • Deep understanding of networking fundamentals, protocols, and distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of database technologies and architectures, including SQL, NoSQL, distributed databases, and the infrastructure requirements of large-scale database workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, containers, and Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Experience designing or supporting cloud-native applications and architectures.
  • Understanding of hybrid cloud strategies, including integration between on-premises and public cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with S3-compatible object storage and modern data platform architectures.
  • Knowledge of enterprise infrastructure supporting AI, high-performance computing (HPC), scientific research, analytics, and large-scale data workloads.
  • Familiarity with HPC environments, parallel file systems, GPU infrastructure, and large-scale research computing architectures is highly desirable.
  • Ability to articulate technical concepts and architect solutions for audiences ranging from research scientists and infrastructure engineers to senior federal decision-makers.
  • Experience working with environments operating at petabyte scale or supporting mission-critical workloads is highly desirable.
  • A consultative mindset with the ability to understand complex federal research requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Passion for emerging technologies and the ability to stay current with evolving trends in AI, HPC, databases, cloud infrastructure, and distributed computing.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

About the Role

We're looking for a Merchant Economics Analyst to help Bask Health better understand the financial performance of the businesses operating on our platform.

You'll analyze merchant spending, revenue, transaction activity, product costs, and margins to identify opportunities to improve profitability and create more value for our merchants.

This is a hands-on analytical role where you'll build financial models, investigate changes in merchant performance, and help internal teams understand the economics of different merchant accounts and product offerings.

You'll work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to develop recommendations that support stronger commercial relationships and better business decisions.

We're looking for someone who enjoys digging into financial data, understanding what drives profitability, and turning detailed analysis into practical recommendations.

  • Analyze merchant-level revenue, spending, costs, and profitability.
  • Build and maintain financial models that evaluate merchant and storefront economics.
  • Monitor merchant margins and identify accounts with opportunities for improvement.
  • Analyze transaction volume, product mix, and spending patterns to understand financial performance.
  • Evaluate how pharmacy costs, platform fees, and other applicable expenses affect merchant economics.
  • Identify changes in merchant profitability and investigate underlying drivers.
  • Develop account-level financial summaries for internal stakeholders.
  • Compare merchant performance across relevant segments, products, and commercial arrangements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve margins through pricing or cost adjustments.
  • Work with Customer Success to understand merchant performance and commercial needs.

  • Analyze merchant growth trends and identify opportunities for commercial expansion.
  • Investigate accounts with declining margins or unexpected cost increases.

  • Collaborate with Pharmacy Operations to understand supplier costs affecting merchant margins.

  • Develop reports and dashboards that track merchant financial performance.

  • Track the results of implemented pricing or cost improvements.

  • Communicate findings clearly to Finance, Customer Success, and leadership.

Job Title: Executive Virtual Assistant – Medical Billing & Operations
Position Type: Part-Time (20 hours/week, with potential to transition to Full-Time)
Work Hours: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM Eastern Time

Salary: $6-$7 per hour, depending on experience
Workplace: Remote
Preferred Candidate Location: PH

About the Company

Our client is a growing digital healthcare organization dedicated to improving maternal health outcomes and supporting women throughout pregnancy, postpartum, and motherhood. Through technology-driven healthcare solutions, personalized support, and community-based programs, the organization helps mothers access essential healthcare services and resources.

The organization works with healthcare professionals, health plans, and community partners to make maternal healthcare more accessible, inclusive, and effective.

They are seeking a highly independent, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant with hands-on Tebra medical billing experience to support billing operations, executive administration, and sales coordination.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can take ownership of responsibilities, solve problems independently, and consistently deliver results without requiring close supervision.

This is a long-term remote opportunity with the potential to grow into a full-time role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Medical Billing & Tebra Management (Immediate Priority)

  • Take ownership of outstanding medical billing tasks and help clear the existing billing backlog.
  • Submit and process medical claims accurately using Tebra.
  • Review billing information for accuracy and completeness before claim submission.
  • Monitor claim statuses, identify potential billing issues, and troubleshoot rejected claims when they occur.
  • Coordinate billing activities between the organization's internal EHR platform and Tebra.
  • Maintain accurate billing records and track outstanding items through resolution.
  • Manage ongoing billing activities, initially estimated at approximately 10–20 items per month, with workload potentially increasing as the organization grows.
  • Ensure claims are processed promptly and billing tasks do not accumulate.

2. Executive Assistance & Sales Coordination (Core Responsibility)

  • Provide direct administrative and executive support to the founder.
  • Coordinate and schedule sales meetings with prospective clients, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, documents, and presentation materials for sales calls.
  • Create, edit, and update professional PowerPoint presentations using existing templates, with the ability to develop new presentations when needed.
  • Manage post-meeting follow-ups and track action items.
  • Follow established follow-up schedules, including 3-day and 7-day follow-ups, without repeated reminders.
  • Coordinate internal team meetings and maintain organized schedules.
  • Support the founder with administrative tasks to improve overall productivity and workflow efficiency.

3. Independent Task Management & Critical Thinking (Essential)

  • Work autonomously with minimal supervision and take full ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Proactively identify outstanding tasks, anticipate needs, and take action without waiting for instructions.
  • Follow documented SOPs, workflows, and templates while exercising sound judgment when unexpected situations arise.
  • Troubleshoot operational issues and recommend practical solutions.
  • Prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and consistently complete follow-ups without reminders.
  • Escalate complex or sensitive matters appropriately while independently resolving routine issues.
  • Maintain accountability and provide timely updates on task progress.

4. Communication & Administrative Support

  • Communicate and coordinate with internal team members through Slack.
  • Assist with phone handling using Nextiva and the organization's main platform phone line, as needed.
  • Organize documents, presentations, meeting notes, and administrative records.
  • Maintain clear communication with the founder and internal stakeholders.
  • Support additional healthcare administrative and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

  • Required: Direct, hands-on medical billing experience using Tebra, including claim submission, billing follow-ups, and troubleshooting claim issues. General scheduling or administrative experience in Tebra alone is not sufficient.
  • Required: Previous healthcare industry experience, preferably in healthcare administration, medical billing, or healthcare operations.
  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Healthcare Administrative Assistant, with the ability to provide meaningful executive-level support.
  • Strong understanding of medical billing workflows, claim submission, and handling rejected claims.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, including editing existing templates and creating professional presentations when needed.
  • Experience coordinating meetings, preparing materials, and managing follow-up activities.
  • Familiarity with Slack, Nextiva, or similar business communication tools is an advantage.
  • Experience supporting executives, founders, or business owners is highly preferred.
  • A medical degree or professional healthcare license is not required.

Essential Skills & Qualities

  • Independent & Self-Starter: Able to work with minimal supervision, take initiative, and complete responsibilities without repeated instructions.
  • Critical Thinker: Can assess situations, identify problems, and determine appropriate solutions independently.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Anticipates issues, takes action, and knows when escalation is necessary.
  • Highly Organized: Effectively manages billing responsibilities, meetings, presentations, and deadlines.
  • Detail-Oriented: Maintains accuracy in medical claims, documentation, and administrative tasks.
  • Accountable & Reliable: Consistently follows through on commitments and completes tasks on time.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable following SOPs while exercising independent judgment when circumstances change.
  • Strong Communicator: Communicates professionally and provides updates without needing to be prompted.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant healthcare experience and hands-on Tebra medical billing expertise.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with the camera on when needed.
  • Must be available to work Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Must be comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Must maintain confidentiality of sensitive business and healthcare information.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

At Ora, we are building the future of ophthalmic clinical research. Ora’s Senior Clinical Project Managers (Sr. CPM) are critical in driving clinical ophthalmic projects forward utilizing best practices in order to ensure budgets, timelines, and clinical trial requirements are being met on behalf of the sponsor. This role will work independently to manage cross functional project teams as well as overseeing other projects they are not directly managing, as a senior member of the clinical operations team, to provide support to more junior team members. Sr. CPM’s have active involvement in each assigned project in order to meet milestones, resolve issues and/ or conflicts in addition to frequent interactions with the study team including but not limited to clinical trial associates, monitoring, clinical research coordinators, investigators and senior management. They are responsible for creating project plans and provide weekly budget and progress reviews for each study in addition to preparing high-quality reports.

What You’ll Do:

  • May manage department Clinical Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Clinical Trial Associates and other supporting staff.
  • Manages cross functional project teams derived from the groups within clinical development to deliver a high-quality clinical trial(s) in compliance with all regulations and SOPs.
  • Works with functional areas on initiating, planning, executing, controlling, closing and resourcing clinical trial projects. The CPM acts as an operational nexus or focal point for interdepartmental and intradepartmental groups (e.g. stats, data management, safety, manufacturing, regulatory, vendors), coordinating these different groups in a matrix environment to drive and complete clinical programs.
  • Reviews protocol, source documents and CRFs and tracks them to completion.

  • Responsible for creating Project Plans (Roles and Responsibility Tables and Communication Plans) and weekly project budget and progress reviews for each study.

  • Prepares high-quality reports (financial, project, etc.) for management on program status and issues.
  • Ensures review of clinical electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) for completeness.
  • Manages and coordinates all vendors involved in the clinical trials (e.g. central labs, IVRS, reading centers).
  • May represent Ora at professional meetings or seminars.
  • Participates in preparing new study budgets, proposal documents and participating in bid defenses.
  • Active role in department and company-wide process improvement initiatives.
  • Travel of up to 15% is required (mainly domestic, overnight).
  • Adhere to all aspects of Ora’s quality system.

  • Clear and sustained demonstration of Ora’s values -- prioritizing kindness, operational excellence, cultivating joy and scientific rigor – as well as their linked behaviors.
  • Responsibilities may differ from the above based on the specific needs of the business.

What We Look For:

  • Experience needed for the Role:
    • Bachelors’ degree in Life Science with at least 7 years of clinical trial experience. Years of experience may be considered in lieu of education
    • Minimum of 3 years of clinical project management experience.
  • Additional Skills & Attributes:
    • Ophthalmology experience preferred.
    • Understanding of multi-center drug and/or device trials.
    • Experience with Veeva TMF and CTMS systems.
    • Ability to establish and maintain effective professional relationships with co-workers, managers and clients.
    • Highly effective organizational and communication skills.
    • Ability to plan, identify risks, anticipate issues and outcomes and respond strategically, tactically and operationally while balancing short-term and long-term company objectives.
    • Demonstrated expertise of applicable regulatory requirements and GCP.
    • Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to multitask and to solve problems proactively.
    • Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint and vendor management.
    • Multi-lingual communication is a plus
  • Competencies and Personal Traits:
    • What We Do:
      • Execution Excellence: Ability to set goals, create structure and maintain a focused and collaborative approach to the delivery of timely and high-quality work.
    • How We Do It:
      • IQ, EQ and SQ: Agile and positive thinker, communicator and collaborator who uses a growth mindset to work and lead with authenticity, transparency, resilience, and empathy. Scientific, intellectual, and emotional/social curiosity creates the willingness and ability to innovate, make mistakes, learn and try again.
      • Clear and Direct Communication, Feedback and Conflict Resolution: Practice radical candor in your communication and participate in active Giving and receiving feedback frequently, with an open heart and mind creates psychological safety and promotes faster, individual, team and company growth.
    • Why We Do It:
      • Seek Meaning and Purpose and a Desire to be Part of Something Bigger than Yourself: Crave being part of a team that works together under shared values to achieve significant positive impact in the wider world. At Ora, we are creating vision beyond what we see.

What We Offer:

  • Well Being: Offering comprehensive healthcare options in Medical, Dental and Vision beginning day 1.
  • Flexible PTO & Unlimited Sick Time: Providing you the freedom to unwind and recharge when you need to in addition to 14 company paid holidays.
  • Financial: Competitive salaries along with a 401K plan through Fidelity with company match.
  • Family Support Care: Adoption and fertility assistance provided along with offering 16 weeks paid Parental Leave.
  • Company Paid Life & Disability Insurance: Offering peace of mind to help you and your family feel secure.
  • Remote & Wellness Reimbursement: We'll reimburse you to support your remote workspace and wellness purchases.
  • Employee Assistance Program: No matter what issues you're facing, New Directions is here to help you and your family.
  • Career Development Opportunities:Continued opportunities to grow and develop your career journey.
  • Global Team: Opportunities to work with colleagues across the globe.
  • Impact: A chance to research new ophthalmic therapies that will impact patients across the globe.

Benefit Eligibility: Full-time employees of Ora working a minimum of 30 hours per week. Our per diem workforce is eligible for Medical and Dental coverage once they have hit 6 months of service and work an average of 30 hours per week.

Our mission is to weave together people, processes, and technology to support innovation in ophthalmology around the world. We believe our business should be a force for good — to improve, heal, and change how we see. As a global company, our vibrant community and culture are nurtured by our core values: Prioritizing kindness, cultivating joy, operational excellence, and scientific rigor.
