ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The S2C Operations Advocate provides day-to-day support for an assigned portfolio within Upstream Source-to-Contract functions, including supplier record setup and maintenance, compliance program support, and third-party credentialing coordination. This role maintains supplier attributes across property accounting systems, supports training and troubleshooting for assigned properties, and partners with the Manager, S2C – Operations to ensure consistent, compliant supplier support.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Supplier Record & Compliance Support

  • Assist assigned portfolio with the supplier compliance program, third-party credentialing processes, and e-procurement system, including ongoing training on these systems.
  • Maintain supplier record setup and attributes across property accounting systems, ensuring accuracy and compliance with owner requirements.
  • Maintain working knowledge of supplier requirements and order/invoice processing procedures to ensure consistent process adherence.
  • Assist third-party suppliers with onboarding, registration, and general inquiries related to compliance and credentialing requirements.
  • Serve as an escalation point for bank account validation exceptions, conducting additional supplier outreach when automated validation checks fail.

Help Desk & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Provide ongoing support by maintaining the Help Desk queue and responding to tickets and emails within established timeframes.
  • Interact with accounting, operations, and other departments to ensure changes and processes are understood and followed.
  • Escalate complex or higher-priority issues to the Sr. S2C Operations Advocate or Manager, S2C (Upstream) – Operations, as needed.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Complete financial, administrative, and other reports and analyses as assigned.
  • Participate in ongoing process improvement through review and feedback on assigned portfolio processes.
  • Maintain relationships with team members and property-level stakeholders to support consistent execution.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Fluency in French required; proficiency in Canadian French preferred.

  • Proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, property management, and database management tools.
  • Basic mathematical skills necessary to complete financial records, budgets, and other fiscal reporting information.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through on assigned portfolio tasks.
  • Comfortable managing a Help Desk queue and responding to routine tickets within SLA.
  • Effective, clear communicator with property-level and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Eager to learn supplier compliance processes and systems; open to coaching from senior team members.
  • Organized, with the ability to manage multiple ongoing requests across an assigned portfolio.

The hourly range for this position is $24.00 - $26.44.

Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.

jobs.description:
Executive Assistant

Programs

Remote/Washington, DC Preferred

Bargaining Unit Position: No

Our Organization

The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent nonprofit that puts rigorous, independent science into action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future. We envision a peaceful, healthy, and just world where science serves people and the planet by guiding policy decisions, reducing risks, and improving lives.

For over five decades, we have been working as scientists, engineers, economists, advocates, and everyday people to create and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems—from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting disinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war. Values informing our work include:

  • Science in the service of people and the planet. 
  • Justice and Equity for people of all races and incomes—now, and for future generations. 
  • Courage to take principled, science-based stands in the public arena. 
  • Integrity to always examine evidence critically, openly, and honestly. 
  • Democracy to promote a voice for all in government decisions. 
  • Action inspiring and mobilizing people to build a healthier, safer, and more just world. 

The Position

The Executive Assistant (EA) provides administrative and logistical support for the Executive Director and Programs Division’s senior leadership. This includes scheduling, proactively identifying and resolving schedule conflicts; ensuring materials are prepped and available for meetings; travel support; timely expense and invoice submissions. The EA works with the rest of the Executive support team to implement systems and processes to enable a high-functioning Executive office. They help draft and distribute organization-wide materials, help organize webinars and organization-wide meetings, and take on occasional project management responsibility. They must be able to maintain confidential information with discretion and maturity. They work collaboratively to ensure the effective operations of the Programs Division, center anti-racism and equity, and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment in internal and external interactions.

Responsibilities

Full scheduling support for the Executive Director

  • Schedule internal and external meetings and calls in a timely manner
  • Proactively identify and resolve scheduling conflicts
  • Provide timely, well-organized background information for calls and meetings

Provide high-quality administrative support for Program Division meetings

  • Call for agenda, coordinating agenda items with Executive Director, VP- Program Impact, Director- Programs, Policy and Advocacy (PPA), and Program Directors’
  • Take and distribute notes, and send and track follow-up action items
  • Support planning and administrative needs of the Programs Division, including the Program Learning & Impact team and strategic planning needs
  • Proactively and timely prompts for Executive Director and other Programs Division leadership team members on upcoming deadlines, commitments, and deliverables.
  • Manage, coordinate, and track progress on tasks for working groups and meetings, as assigned

Support Program Division events and in-person meetings

  • Make travel arrangements
  • Book flights, hotels, and ground transportation for Executive Director and meeting participants, as needed
  • Manage and track travel expenses and reimbursements
  • Plan and coordinate logistics for conferences and events, as assigned

Manage Program Division documents and information flows, and support Research Services

  • Support Knowledge and Research services for the organization, including staff access to subscription resources, management and renewals of subscription resources, training and communications support
  • Support document management for the Programs Division, including timely updates to Nucleus (intranet)
  • Ensure appropriate and timely follow-up on internal and external requests for information or action from Programs Division

Provide general Executive admin support, as assigned and appropriate

  • Calendar support for the Leadership Team (LT) Workdays and Meetings, especially related to Programs Division engagement (Executive Director, PPA, VP of Program Impact, and Program Directors)
  • Help with Board meetings and in-person logistical support twice a year, as needed
  • Aid in the planning and support of LT workdays and all-staff retreats.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

  • Proven ability to support senior-level executives with a high level of attention to detail and careful attention to the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information.
  • Adept at taking initiative, anticipating needs, working independently, and following through on and completing assignments in a timely manner. Able to work effectively as part of a team with a strong problem-solving orientation, with curiosity to understand the full context; proactively learns new tools and proposes solutions
  • Proven time management abilities to meet deadlines with self-motivation and attention to detail.
  • Ability to be responsive in a fast-paced executive environment, ensuring timely follow-up, clear communication, and proactive escalation of urgent or sensitive matters, as needed.
  • Skilled in organizing information and materials for meetings and events, including logistical details.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills with ability to interact with all levels of internal and external constituencies.
  • Demonstrable experience in office and administrative support procedures, and AV support for meetings.
  • Experience in supporting online and in-person meetings, including agenda development, taking notes, timely communication, and logistical planning and support.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe or other Project Management Tools

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time. 
  • Continuously operate a computer and must have the ability to control a mouse and keyboard.  
  • Communicate in verbal and written formats with internal staff and external constituents.  

Work Schedule

Regular office hours, with flexibility to manage East and West Coast time zones, including occasional nights and weekend hours for urgent events or critical deadlines.

Travel Requirements

Occasional travel to support in-person Executive and Leadership Team meetings, staff retreats, and Board meetings.

UCS is an equal opportunity employer actively seeking to diversify its staff. We’re dedicated to broadening opportunities for individuals from demographic groups that are historically underrepresented in the sciences and in environmental advocacy. We’re also committed to building an inclusive workplace culture where talented people of widely diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe the inclusion of culturally diverse perspectives will improve our work and produce better societal and environmental outcomes for all, including historically disenfranchised communities.

Benefits

Details

This is a full-time remote position with a preference for Washington, DC. For those who meet all position requirements, the salary is $78,846.86. UCS offers excellent benefits and a rewarding work environment. *CA Resident Only; we offer a 12% salary differential*

Information about the organization is available at .

Comparable training and/or experience can be substituted for degrees when appropriate.

More about the team

Our team is made up of a dedicated group of researchers, scientists, communicators, campaigners, and advocates from wide-ranging backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and a collaborative and supportive work environment where all staff can thrive. We continually strive to create an environment that is a welcoming place for the LGBTQ+ community, people of color, parents, empty-nesters, and people with a wide variety of interests and backgrounds.

To Apply: We know there are great candidates who won’t check all of these boxes, and we also know you might bring important skills that we haven’t considered. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. Please upload a cover letter and resume. In the cover letter, please confirm that the listed salary meets your expectations. Upload materials in Word or PDF format only. No phone calls, please.

This position is NOT in the bargaining unit.

COVID Mandate for New Hires

For in-office roles, UCS employees must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. Employees are considered fully vaccinated as defined by the CDC. All new hires who will be reporting to an office location must provide notice of their vaccination status and vaccination documentation on or before their first day of work. For all others, UCS strongly encourages full vaccinations among its employees, up to and including booster shots, even if working remotely.

All new employees must comply with the mandatory vaccination requirements outlined in UCS policies as soon as practicable. Union of Concerned Scientists will notify candidates for employment of the requirements of this policy before the start of employment.

jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

jobs.excerpt: About UsTameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

Job Summary

Emerse, a dynamic Sales Consulting business, is searching for the next Sales Super Coach. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced sales leader or coach to join us as a Certified Sales Coach.

We are seeking a seasoned professional with proven sales experience and results, looking to transition into a coaching/consulting role, or an existing coach interested in helping business owners across the US, UK, and Europe smash their sales targets. On average, our coaches earn approximately $150,000 - $250,000 (variable and uncapped).

This role is a primarily remote role from anywhere in the US (with primarily eastern time work hours). Your purpose: embed lasting sales performance by applying proven strategies, building accountability, and delivering exceptional coaching experiences.

This is not your typical consultancy gig; it’s a chance to make a measurable difference every day.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Deliver high-impact coaching engagements using Emerse IP and methodology

  • Facilitate team bootcamps, strategy workshops, and performance reviews

  • Build and roll out client-specific sales playbooks

  • Support sales hiring and onboarding with clear standards and structure

  • Track performance and drive growth through diagnostics and KPIs

  • 10+ years in B2B sales and leadership roles.

  • Proven coaching or mentoring expertise.

  • A passion for elevating sales talent and client success.

  • Experience in sales, hiring, and team development.

  • Confidence working independently in a flexible, remote setup.

If you're currently self-employed or building a portfolio career, this could be the ideal next step with a values-led business.

How It Works

You will complete a 90-day certification and onboarding programme, equipping you with Emerse tools, training, and client frameworks. You’ll work on an outcome-based model—measured by results, not hours. You’ll earn a share of gross profit for each client engagement, plus sales commission for bringing in new business.

What You’ll Get

  • Uncapped earnings potential.

  • Remote, flexible working.

  • Travel expenses for in-person sessions covered.

Our Mission - Bringing Excellence to the Profession of Sales

At Emerse, we believe sales should be a respected, well-practised profession, not just a job. Based in London and Miami, we partner with ambitious B2B companies to drive revenue growth through rigorous evaluation, strategic playbook design, world-class coaching, and exceptional sales hiring.

Our Core Values

  • надання інформації про продукти / послуги;

  • вирішення проблем та співпраця з профільними командами за необхідності;

  • документування взаємодії з користувачами;

  • моніторинг і дотримання визначених особистих кількісних та якісних показників;

  • фіксація та передача фідбеку клієнтів.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • володіння англійською на рівніUpper-Intermediate та вище;

  • комунікативні навички: відмінне вміння спілкуватися з різними типами клієнтів, включаючи незадоволених або роздратованих;

  • емпатія: здатність поставити себе на місце клієнта, розуміти його потреби та почуття;

  • уважність: вміння уважно сприймати інформацію та ставити відповідні запитання для чіткого розуміння проблеми або запиту клієнта;

  • стресостійкість: здатність зберігати спокій в складних або конфліктних ситуаціях;

  • організованість та пунктуальність: вміння пріоритезувати завдання для своєчасної відповіді на запити клієнтів;

  • командність: здатність ефективно співпрацювати з колегами та іншими відділами компанії для розв'язування питань клієнтів;

  • відкритість: не боїшся нових викликів, показати себе, працювати над покращеннями;

  • вміння ефективно користуватися комп'ютером та програмним забезпеченням: володієш навичками роботи з електронною поштою, чатами та іншими базовими програмами.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • володіння німецькою;

  • досвід роботи в підтримці;

  • володіння навичками роботи в CRM-системах, омніканальних платформах;

  • досвід роботи в iGaming.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business:

As a Lead Platform Engineer (Consultant) in Kainos, you’ll be responsible for leading teams to design, automate, build, manage and optimise modern digital service platforms. It’s a fast-paced environment and you’ll be trusted to make sound, reasoned decisions. You’ll do this whilst learning about new technologies and approaches, with colleagues that will help you to learn, develop and grow. As the technical leader in the team, you will also interact with customers, share knowledge and mentor those around you.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Working as part of a team - You’ll work alongside colleagues in engineering, testing, consulting, product management and security capabilities to build, test and deploy software of the highest quality; including the operation and continuous improvement of underlying platform services.

  • Using technology for positive impact – You’ll ensure the latest technologies are employed appropriately and aligned with industry best practices for maximum user and business benefit.

  • Share your knowledge – As a respected technologist within Kainos, you’ll begin broadcasting your opinions. You’ll be supported to actively share knowledge both internally through communities of practice and more widely in industry.

  • Becoming a Role Model – You’ll support your colleagues and foster a DevOps culture in all that you do by embodying the Kainos values. You’ll be a person your colleagues look up to – people trust your decisions because they are transparent and justified. You’ll be passionate and committed to ensuring Kainos projects are successful.

  • Pushing the boundaries – Through exposure to technology you may develop specialisms and choose to pivot your career in a certain direction.

  • Providing Technical Leadership – You’ll provide direction and leadership for your team as you solve challenging problems together on delivery and support projects.

  • Putting people first & developing others – You’ll manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on managing employee performance and assisting in their career development.

Minimum (essential) requirements

  • Strong verbal and written communications skills, with the ability to simply and clearly communicate technical design (or significant portions thereof) in conversation, documentation and presentation to a technical and non-technical audience.

  • We all work in teams here in Kainos – You’ll need a proven experience of team leadership and supporting a DevOps culture in delivering and/or supporting complex projects.

  • The role requires SC Clearance.

Significant expertise in:

  • Designing, building, testing, automating, monitoring and/or operating, enhancing and improving reliability of modern digital service platform in production environments.

  • Using the latest Continuous Delivery and automation techniques for releasing operationally ready software to production, including platform orchestration through the use of multiple configuration management tools

Demonstrableexperiencein:

  • Building and/or supporting modern digital service platforms to include architecture, design, estimation, planning and iteration on MVP using a modern agile approach.

  • Championing best practice use of Site Reliability Engineering tooling, techniques and processes to manage and improve existing platform services. E.g. monitoring, platform modernisation and cost optimisation.

  • Use of AWS including SaaS or PaaS offerings to solve business problems.

Desirable

  • Obtained certification with a public cloud provider (AWS).

  • Obtained certification relating to a particular area of specialisation e.g. Kubernetes CKAD.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About the Internet Society The Internet Society (ISOC) supports and promotes the development of the Internet as a global technical infrastructure, a resource to enrich people’s lives, and a force for good in society.
jobs.description:
About the Internet Society

The Internet Society (ISOC) supports and promotes the development of the Internet as a global technical infrastructure, a resource to enrich people’s lives, and a force for good in society. Our work aligns with our goals for the Internet to be open, globally connected, secure, and trustworthy. We seek collaboration with all who share these goals.

Together, we focus on building and supporting the communities that make the Internet work; advancing the development and application of Internet infrastructure, technologies, and open standards; and advocating for policy that is consistent with our view of the Internet.

About the Position

The Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, operating, and optimizing the Internet Society’s modern data platform, with a primary focus on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related database technologies. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data & Analytics, this role develops scalable data pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse solutions, semantic models, integrations, and trusted datasets that support reporting, analytics, governance, and AI-ready decision-making across the organization.

Location

Remote - from home location

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate data engineering solutions in Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, SQL analytics endpoints, semantic models, Direct Lake, and deployment pipelines.
  • Develop and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and publish data from enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, APIs, files, and relational databases.
  • Implement lakehouse, data warehouse, medallion architecture, and dimensional modelling patterns that enable trusted reporting, analytics, and AI-ready data products.
  • Build and optimize Power BI semantic models, datasets, measures, dataflows, and reports in partnership with analysts and business stakeholders.
  • Develop, tune, and maintain database solutions using related technologies including Azure SQL Database, SQL Server, Fabric Warehouse, PostgreSQL, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, T-SQL, KQL, and other fit-for-purpose relational, lakehouse, and analytical data stores.
  • Apply data quality, observability, testing, reconciliation, lineage, and monitoring practices to ensure data products are accurate, reliable, secure, and supportable.
  • Contribute hands-on technical expertise to the development of the Internet Society’s data governance, management, integration, and analytics strategy.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to understand data needs, translate requirements into technical designs, and deliver reusable data assets that improve transparency and decision-making.
  • Automate manual reporting and data delivery processes using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Automate, PowerShell, Python, SQL, and platform-native scheduling and orchestration capabilities.
  • Support secure platform operations by following established standards for access controls, workspace management, source control, deployment, documentation, and change management.
  • Remain current on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, database, analytics, and AI-related data platform capabilities and recommend practical improvements to the organization’s data engineering practices.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Qualifications

  • The ideal candidate will have 5-7 years of progressive hands-on data engineering experience, including strong proficiency in the following areas:
  • Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Factory, notebooks, Spark, SQL analytics endpoints, Direct Lake, semantic models, deployment pipelines, and workspace administration basics.
  • Power BI, including data modelling, semantic model design, DAX, Power Query, dataflows, report development, performance optimization, and governance of shared datasets.
  • Database and query technologies including Azure SQL Database, SQL Server, Fabric Warehouse, PostgreSQL, Spark SQL, T-SQL, Delta Lake, and relational/data warehouse design patterns.
  • Python 3.x for data engineering, including common libraries such as Pandas, Requests, SQLAlchemy, Pytest, and related tools for API integration, automation, testing, and data transformation.
  • ETL/ELT design, orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and troubleshooting across batch, incremental, API-based, file-based, relational, and analytical data sources.
  • Modern data architecture concepts including lakehouse, data lake, data warehouse, medallion architecture, dimensional modelling, star schema, 3NF, semantic layers, and reusable data products.
  • Data quality, testing, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, documentation, observability, and operational monitoring practices.
  • Microsoft Purview and related governance capabilities, including cataloguing, classification, lineage, access control concepts, compliance support, and data protection practices.
  • Version control and release management using Git, GitHub or GitLab, deployment pipelines, code review, documentation, and environment promotion practices.
  • Automation using PowerShell, Power Automate, Python, SQL, and platform-native scheduling or orchestration tools.
  • Cloud and infrastructure fundamentals, including Azure data services, object storage, Linux-based environments, Docker, and secure integration patterns.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and work effectively with a globally distributed organization.
  • Ability to travel as needed.

What You'll Love About Us

  • Make an Impact. We have an exciting vision and mission to bring the internet to everyone!
  • Great Company Culture. We are a global team and live our values of collaboration, inclusion, respect, people and passion in all of our HR programs including our new recognition program!
  • Holiday/Vacation. Generous paid time off and paid public holidays.
  • Benefits. Based on local in-country guidelines.
  • Give back. Get paid to volunteer in your community!
  • Professional Development and Educational Benefits. Annual company contribution towards professional development or higher education.
  • Flexible Work Models. Flexible work-from-home.

Compensation and benefits for this position will be paid in local currency and based on the country and geographic location’s local salary and benefits market data for the position. Exact pay will be based on factors including but not limited to relevant qualifications, experience, geographic location, education, business and organizational needs.

The Internet Society is an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to sex, race, age, disability, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, color or any other protected class. Compensation and benefit package for this position will be competitively commensurate with the successful applicant’s qualifications. Applications will be evaluated until the position has been filled. The list of applicants will not be posted publicly and will be reviewed in confidence by members of the evaluation committee.

Important Notice to Applicants:

The Internet Society will never request payment or fees from candidates at any stage of the hiring process. All official communications will originate directly from the Internet Society. Any use of third-party recruiters or partners will be clearly indicated in the job posting. If you receive unsolicited or suspicious outreach claiming to represent the Internet Society, please treat it with caution.

Our headquarters are in Tel Aviv, and we have offices in Argentina, Spain, the UK, the US, and India.

During the maternity leave period, you’ll lead the network’s operations team while staying deeply involved in the day-to-day work yourself, and you’ll own relationships with our hospitality suppliers. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term, not just fill a gap.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the network operations team day to day: set priorities, distribute work, and make sure tasks and escalations are handled on time and to a high standard.

Why join us?
You’ll join a dynamic, close-knit team where your work has a real and visible impact. This role offers hands-on leadership experience alongside broad exposure to both operations and supplier account management in travel tech. We value ownership, initiative, and people who care about doing things right.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in an operations or account management role in the travel or tourism industry (must).
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team, ideally as a hands-on team lead or senior team member.
  • Comfort shifting between leading the team and being an individual contributor.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage supplier relationships in a commercial and professional manner.

Advantages

Start: Immediately | Level: Team Lead | Location: Hamburg, remote | Working hours: Full-time (40 hours/week)

At The Quality Group, we are pioneers in our field, driving innovation and setting standards in the fitness nutrition industry. Being part of our team means working in a high-performance company with a shared passion for our products and our collective mission.

Become a vital member of the Order Management team, the engine room of our commerce business. Every order, D2C and B2B alike, runs through our central order bus: from our brands More Nutrition and ESN, from TikTok Shop and other sales channels, to the downstream systems that matter, such as fulfillment and logistics. We run an event-driven microservices architecture with a strong backend focus, where scale, resilience and data integrity are what count. You will work closely with Product, Operations and our brand teams to keep orders flowing smoothly, even at peak times.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who leads with empathy and clarity, fosters a collaborative, high-ownership environment and aligns delivery with our strategic goals. You will not only lead your team, but also help shape how we work in engineering: we value your ideas and give you the space to drive improvements across the department.

Your mission

The Engineering Manager will lead a dynamic team of engineers that owns our order management platform and the order bus connecting our sales channels with downstream systems. You will drive people development, delivery excellence, and architectural evolution towards scalable, secure, and maintainable systems, in close partnership with Product Owners and Business stakeholders. This role requires a proactive, hands-on leader who enjoys stepping into a complex environment and turning it into a well-structured, efficient and motivated team. Key responsibilities will be:

  • Team Development: Inspire and foster a positive, collaborative culture within the engineering team, providing necessary support and motivation
  • Performance & Delivery: Establish clear goals/metrics, regularly evaluate team performance, provide constructive feedback and recognize exceptional efforts and balance short-term outcomes with technical health
  • Architecture & Technical Direction: Guide our order management ecosystem towards modern, event-driven, cloud-native patterns on AWS
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Work closely with other departments to ensure engineering efforts are in harmony with company goals
  • Innovation and Risk Management: Lead initiatives that push for continuous improvement and innovation while managing risks effectively and plan for team scalability to meet the growing needs of the organization
  • Technology and Quality Assurance: Align technology strategies with business objectives and collaborate with Platform, Security and QA teams to uphold high-quality standards
  • Continuous Improvement & Risk Management: Lead modernization initiatives, manage tech debt and risks, and scale processes as the business grows

Your experience & skills

  • Proven experience in engineering management (3+ years) leading software teams in an agile, product-driven environment
  • Strong background in software engineering (ideally PHP/Symfony) and familiarity with cloud-native/event-driven architectures on AWS
  • Strong knowledge and practical experience in Agile methodologies, with a track record of successfully managing complex engineering projects and optimizing team performance through data-driven metrics
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills; ability to align diverse stakeholders and enable senior engineers
  • Fluency in English
  • Problem-Solving Mindset
  • Genuine interest in order management, system integrations and process automation in commerce

Why choose us?

Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,600 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.

You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Germany (Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf) as well as international offices in London, Amsterdam, and Zug, Switzerland, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • Attractive employee discounts
  • Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass
  • Workation
  • Corporate benefits
  • 28 days vacation/year
  • and much more

About Us

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021.

ESN has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, More Nutrition focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.

TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.

This is us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!
We look forward to your application! Regardless of gender, age, background, or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring to the table. Join our team and grow with us!

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.

In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. Your new role We are looking for a Finance Business Partner to join our Group FP&A team. The other 60% sits at the center of Group FP&A, where you will coordinate month-end, budget, forecast and ARR review activity across Finance, deliver group and statutory reporting, and build the shared tools the team relies on.
You’ll work closely with the VP, FP&A & Finance Business Partnering and senior business leaders. If you are organized, curious and comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, this is a chance to shape how Finance works across a global research technology business.

Please note - due to business need, we can only accept applications from candidates who reside in the UK, where we have an established legal entity.
If you apply from outside of this area, your application will not be considered.

Please be aware that we may close this position early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly.

What you’ll be doing

Finance Partnering (40%)
  • Month End and Monthly Reporting
    • Review monthly accounts in detail, identifying material corrections and explaining key variances
    • Provide commentary with business context, highlighting actions needed
    • Produce monthly reporting for business areas and review it with them, holding them accountable for delivering actions
  • Planning & Forecasting
    • Lead cost and headcount forecasting and budgeting for the business areas, on time and within guidelines
    • Challenge assumptions (e.g. cost growth, hiring timing) to drive a robust forecast that does not require material rework
    • Present movements clearly using charts, tables and waterfalls
    • Provide a monthly view of landing positions, raising early warnings where needed
    • Ensure allocations to segments are accurate and explainable
  • Decision Support
    • Support business cases, trends, accounting treatment and other business questions with robust analysis and flexible financial models
Group FP&A Operations (60%)
  • Process Coordination
    • Coordinate month-end, budget and rolling forecast timetables across the Finance team
    • Manage the BRM schedule and review submissions for completeness, accuracy and rigor
    • Manage the Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) review and validation process
  • Group Reporting
    • Deliver ad hoc, weekly and recurring group reporting, including Opex Engine, ERG, HBK and statutory submissions (ONS)
  • Tools, Process and Projects
    • Develop and maintain centralised tools and templates that reduce manual effort and version-control risk
    • Drive continuous improvement and identify where systems can be used more for control and automation
    • Lead and support group projects, including systems implementation and Salesforce initiatives

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Multi-year finance business partnering experience in cost areas
  • Forecasting and budgeting experience, delivering budgets for specific business areas to a timetable and target outcome, including challenging stakeholders
  • Ability to build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge them
  • Ability to drive and influence outcomes and change across the wider team
  • Self-starter who is organized, structured and able to work independently
  • Driven, inquisitive and collaborative, with initiative and ownership to achieve required outcomes
  • Professional finance qualification (CIMA, ACCA, ACA or CPA), or 5+ years of relevant FP&A experience
Desirable
  • Experience in a SaaS business
  • Experience with NetSuite and Anaplan
  • Experience supporting the delivery of budget and forecast processes
Who You’ll Work With
  • VP, FP&A & Finance Business Partnering
  • Senior Finance Business Partner (Team Lead)
  • Finance Business Partners (peers)
  • Wider Finance team, including Business Unit Finance Partners
  • Business leaders and external stakeholders.

Living our Values

We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective.
The talent we secure is fundamental to us achieving our vision and our growth plans. The values we live by are:
We are brave in the pursuit of better
We are collaborative and inclusive
We are always open-minded
We are from and for the community

At Digital Science, our vision is to see research flow seamlessly – trusted, collaborative, and accessible – fueling breakthroughs that push humanity forward. This ambitious mission is one we achieve together, by enabling open, collaborative, inclusive research.

We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. A rich mix of voices drives quality insights, fosters enhanced collaboration, and ultimately pushes knowledge forward more effectively.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building and nurturing a workplace where every individual feels valued and belongs. Internal Job Title: DevOps Specialist

Job Type: Permanent, Full-time

Job Location: Canada

Work Model: Remote

Position Summary

As a DevOps Specialist II at BUMP, you will serve in a senior, hands-on technical role responsible for building and supporting the internally developed infrastructure management platform and automation used to manage the cloud and on-premises infrastructure behind our Electronic Raffle System and other products and services. Working with teams and stakeholders across the organization, you will help advance software delivery, platform reliability, infrastructure standardization, and operational resilience.

Responsibilities

  • Shape solution architecture for the platform and related DevOps-supported systems by evaluating trade-offs, recommending technologies, selecting implementation patterns, and maintaining clear current-state and target-state diagrams
  • Translate technical direction and agreed approaches into production-ready platform capabilities, integrations, automation, software, and tools
  • Design, implement, and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and release automation for cloud and on-premises systems
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code, configuration management, and orchestration practices to provision, standardize, and manage production environments
  • Develop, maintain, optimize, and support the platform, cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, container technologies, and related operational services
  • Collaborate with teams and stakeholders across the organization to improve platform and system reliability, deployment quality, automation standards, security practices, and operational processes
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical standards, and contribute to disaster recovery procedures and practices
  • Monitor platform, system, and service performance, troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement improvements that strengthen production reliability and operational resilience

Relevant Technologies

The following technologies are representative of the role. Candidates are not expected to have experience with every product listed.

  • Cloud: AWS, Microsoft Azure
  • Software Development: Python, Bash, Node.js, React, Grafana plugins
  • Architecture Modelling and Diagramming: ArchiMate, draw.io
  • Source Control and CI/CD: Git, GitHub, Forgejo, Azure DevOps
  • Workflow Orchestration and Automation: Argo Suite, Rundeck, GitHub Actions, Forgejo Actions, and hosted and self-hosted runners
  • Infrastructure Automation: Terraform, Atmos, Helm, Ansible, Packer
  • Containers and Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS
  • Identity, Access, and Secrets: AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS SSM Parameter Store, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, Vault/OpenBao
  • Hosting and Networking: VPNs, NGINX, Squid, DNS, load balancing, and TLS certificate management
  • Systems Operations and Management: AWS Systems Manager, Azure Arc
  • Data Storage and Caching: Amazon S3, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
  • Monitoring and Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Amazon CloudWatch

Mandatory Requirements

  • Legally eligible to work in Canada
  • Fluency in English (speak, read, write)
  • Ability to travel approx. 1-2 weeks per year
  • Ability to work outside standard business hours when required for deployments, incidents, or emergencies

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and additional relevant professional experience
  • 8+ years of progressive technical experience across several of the following areas: software development, internal platform engineering, Linux systems administration, cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, systems operations, and monitoring and observability

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or a comparable cloud certification
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical trade-offs, influence solution architecture and technical direction, and design scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions

About the Role

As Solutions Product Manager, Pharma, you’ll design TailorMed’s solutions for pharmaceutical manufacturers and represent them in the sales process. This is an individual contributor role.

You’ll work with Sales and Partnerships to understand what manufacturers need across patient access, affordability, and adherence. Then you’ll turn those goals into solutions that work across hubs, specialty pharmacies, copay and patient assistance vendors, and provider sites of care. You’ll lead discovery, design solutions and integrations, write proposals and SOWs, respond to RFPs, and own pharma sales analysis with the Data team.   • Sales Support: Work with Sales on pharma opportunities from first conversation through contract. Shape deal strategy, qualify fit, and give technical and commercial guidance.

  • RFP Responses: Write clear, complete RFP responses that address technical and business requirements and make the case for TailorMed.
  • Customer Relationships: Build strong relationships with customers and act as a trusted advisor throughout their decision.

jobs.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence.

Team Description

Reddit is poised to rapidly innovate and grow like no other time in its history. We’re currently hiring across multiple teams, some of these teams include:

Ads ML Serving Team
The Ads ML Serving team is part of Reddit’s Ads ML Platform, which builds the infrastructure and tools that power machine learning across Ads. This team focuses on creating a highly reliable, scalable, and efficient ML serving stack. Their work includes evolving long-term serving architecture, integrating closely with the ads serving stack, optimizing CPU/GPU performance, and building model velocity tools like observability libraries and model quality gating.

Attribution & Identity Team
The Attribution & Identity team builds products that help advertisers understand and measure the impact of their campaigns. They focus on attribution systems, identity solutions, and advertiser experimentation tools that improve performance insights and usability. Their goal is to make Reddit’s advertising platform more effective, transparent, and data-driven.

Ads Growth TeamThe Ads Growth team drives initiatives to expand Reddit’s advertiser base, with a focus on Small to Medium Businesses (SMBs). We build and scale the technical foundation for key product pillars that enable SMB advertisers to succeed on Reddit. Our work spans collaboration with product, design, marketing, data science, UX, and sales teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
We prioritize iterative development, rapid shipping, rigorous testing, and building capabilities that create step-change growth. Our goal is to multiply the number of monthly active advertisers by delivering impactful tools, features, and experiences tailored to the needs of SMBs.

Business Manager
The Business Manager team stands out for its genuinely inclusive and collaborative culture, where not only is open feedback central, but every opinion and idea is truly valued and given space to shape our direction. Here, diverse perspectives are seen as a core strength, fostering a team dynamic where everyone feels empowered to contribute and innovate. On a day-to-day basis, engineers tackle complex, high-stakes challenges at the core of Reddit’s ads platform which include innovating on permissions systems, building Agency and Large Enterprise solutions, and driving adoption among Reddit's largest advertisers. From ideation to delivery, our engineers are trusted with end-to-end ownership of their projects, working closely in cross-functional collaboration with PMs, UX, and partner teams. This hands-on approach means every team member plays a direct and visible role in delivering high-impact, user-focused solutions for some of Reddit’s most strategic advertisers.

Role Description:

This is a generalist mid-level backend position within the Ads Organization. Ads is the fuel that powers Reddit’s mission. As a backend engineer on the team, candidates might work on:

  • Microservices and APIs that power our advertiser-facing product, ads.reddit.com
  • Distributed systems that ensure the right ad gets shown to the right user at the right time
  • Backends that power interactive user experiences on our ads like Polls and Games
  • Real time, data intensive systems that measure the performance of our ad campaigns
  • Infrastructure that supports all of the above

Technologies used on the team include:

  • Languages: Go, Python, Scala
  • Frameworks: Spark, Thrift, Baseplate, Kafka
  • Datastores: Postgres, BigQuery, Redis, Druid
  • Tools: Kubernetes, Argo, Docker

Mid-level engineers are expected to absorb best practices and learn exceptionally quickly while being effective core contributors. Engineers at this level must be able to code independently, but may work with senior engineers on the design of complex solutions. The most important skills an engineer at this level must possess are 1) coachability and an eagerness to grow, 2) deep passion for coding, and 3) excellent independent learning skills, all while operating as a fully functioning member of an engineering team.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with product managers to design and implement Ads products.
  • Collaborate closely with the platform and data teams while building new features.
  • Lead the processes needed to improve operational stability, including improving code quality, delivering dashboards and data visualizations.
  • Build extensible components that would align with the product objectives.
  • Support day to day project management tasks including communicating project updates, managing project timelines and overseeing project execution.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience in one or more general purpose programming languages (Java, Scala, Go, C++, Python).
  • Able to take complete ownership of a feature or project.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working in the Ads domain
  • Experience or interest in the advertising business and understanding customer needs

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Comprehensive Medical Benefits & Health Care Spending Account
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan with matching contributions
  • Income Replacement Programs

jobs.excerpt: Wir sind Skandinaviens erfolgreichste Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 1700 Berater:innen, einer einzigartigen Unternehmenskultur und einer expandierenden Basis in Deutschland.
jobs.description:
Wir sind Skandinaviens erfolgreichste Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 1700 Berater:innen, einer einzigartigen Unternehmenskultur und einer expandierenden Basis in Deutschland. Nach anhaltend starkem Wachstum in Dänemark, Schweden, Norwegen und der Schweiz bauen wir unsere Präsenz in Deutschland weiter aus.

Wir helfen Menschen und Organisationen, sich den Herausforderungen der Zukunft zu stellen, und begleiten sie bei ihren Veränderungsprozessen. Zum Erreichen der bestmöglichen Ergebnisse kombinieren wir analytisches Denken und intuitives Verständnis. Wir verknüpfen die neuesten Theorien mit Sensibilität für Menschen und Organisationsdynamik. Nicht zuletzt beziehen wir aktiv die Menschen mit ein, die in die Veränderungsprozesse involviert sind – wir nennen das „Collaborative Consulting“. Seit 25 Jahren schaffen wir mit unserem Ansatz positive Veränderungen.

Unsere Projekte sind breit gefächert und decken die komplette Wertschöpfungskette in den Bereichen Life Sciences/Health Care, Retail/FMCG, Industrials sowie im Service-Sektor ab.

Für unser S/4HANA-Team suchen wir einen erfahrenen Partner (m/w/d), der gemeinsam mit uns unsere Kunden fit für die Zukunft macht.

Was dich in deiner Aufgabe unter anderem erwartet:

  • Du stärkst zusammen mit dem S/4-Team unsere Präsenz am deutschen Markt.
  • Du entwickelst S/4HANA Berater:innen, bringst innovative Themen voran, z. B. mit Fokus auf Digitalisierung, und unterstützt damit den Ausbau unserer Fachexpertise.
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Netzwerk mit Kolleg:innen aus dem SAP-Umfeld, aber auch bereichs- und themenübergreifend mit weiteren Implement-Teams.
  • Du entwickelst im Team einen Go-to-Market-Ansatz in Deutschland für Serviceangebote im Bereich S/4HANA, von der Roadmap bis hin zur Begleitung der Implementierung.
  • Du treibst Business Development-Aktivitäten voran und nutzt dafür dein breites Netzwerk, erschließt neue Marktpotenziale und rückst unser Angebot damit in den Fokus neuer Kunden, vor allem in der DACH-Region.
  • Du leitest die genannten Business Development-Aktivitäten entlang des gesamten Sales-Zyklus, repräsentierst unser Angebotsportfolio und erstellst Angebote.
  • Du leitest große Kundenprojekte und nimmst damit eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Lösung strategischer Herausforderungen rund um die Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von S/4HANA-Lösungen bei Kunden ein.
  • Du begleitest Kunden von der Strategiekonzeption bis hin zur Umsetzung und kommunizierst dabei auf C-Level-Ebene. Du agierst dabei als Client Advisor und arbeitest auch mit Systemintegratoren zusammen.

Wir sind auf der Suche nach Menschen, die

  • einen Diplom-/Master-Abschluss haben, zum Beispiel in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft und/oder Ingenieurswesen
  • Experten für S/4HANA sind und ihr Wissen mit Leidenschaft in Kundenlösungen übersetzen
  • in ihrer mehrjährigen Beratungserfahrung erfolgreich und nachhaltig komplexe Transformationsprojekte geleitet haben
  • sich durch exzellente Analysefähigkeiten auszeichnen und hervorragende Prozess- und Projektmanager:innen sind
  • für Business Development brennen und Marktpotenziale erkennen und nutzen
  • über ein starkes Netzwerk sowohl auf der Markt-, aber auch auf der SAP- und der Beraterseite verfügen und dieses auch nachweislich bespielen können
  • authentisch sind und es verstehen, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen und auf Augenhöhe respektvoll auf allen Hierarchieebenen zu kommunizieren
  • wahre People Leader sind und ein engagiertes, leidenschaftliches Team coachen und weiterentwickeln
  • überzeugend und sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Das bieten wir dir:
Die Implement Consulting Group bietet einen hohen Grad an Gestaltungsfreiheit mit gegenseitiger Verantwortung und Unterstützung zur kontinuierlichen Entwicklung unserer Fähigkeiten. Mit diesen erzielen wir herausragende Ergebnisse bei unseren Kunden. Wir sind stolz auf unsere einzigartige Unternehmenskultur, unser Netzwerk von hochqualifizierten, leistungs- und hilfsbereiten Kollegen. Gemeinsam haben wir das Ziel, durch „Change with Impact“ die Welt der Beratung zu verändern.

Wir bieten attraktive, leistungsbezogene Gehaltspakete und exzellente Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt, dann sende uns Deinen CV auf Englisch oder auf Deutsch zu.

We want to be the best place for the best people within Management Consultancy by being a powerhouse of expertise and energy.
