jobs.excerpt: The pioneer in forensic utility bill auditing.  Since 1991 we've recovered $700M+ for 16,000+ commercial buildings, on pure contingency.
jobs.description:
The pioneer in forensic utility bill auditing. Since 1991 we've recovered $700M+ for 16,000+ commercial buildings, on pure contingency. No recovery, no fee. Our in-house software is the engine behind that recovery.

What excites you?

UtiliSave is becoming a modern, AI-enabled company, and this role helps drive that change. You will own your work from start to finish, with no one else picking it up to finish it for you.

This probably won't suit you if you only work inside an existing playbook. We are building the standards, the tools and a modern way of developing software as we go, and we need people who help write them.

If you're curious, you look past the obvious answer, and a hard problem makes you more interested instead of less, UtiliSave could be the right place for you.

What you will be building

We build our CRM and portals ourselves, on Microsoft Dataverse and the Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Pages and Power Automate, with Dynamics 365 where it earns its place. This is not an out-of-the-box CRM. It is heavily customized to fit how our auditors and clients work. Some of it is live, some of it is in build, and all of it has to be reliable enough that auditors and clients depend on it daily. You will help take it from working to production-grade, and you will build the automation that removes manual work across departments.

Responsibilities

  • Own configuration, customization and integration work on the CRM, from discovery through post-go-live support.
  • Build and support Power Automate flows, Power Apps and Power Pages portals that cut manual work.
  • Work from solutions, source control, pull requests and test environments. Schema changes go through review, not straight into production.
  • Use AI-assisted tools (Claude Code or Cowork preferred) as a normal part of implementation, testing and documentation, and help others on the team do it well.
  • Sit with business stakeholders, turn what they need into platform changes, and tell them plainly when something is a bad idea.
  • Write and maintain documentation as part of delivery.
  • Work as a peer on CRM architecture decisions and help mentor as the team grows.
  • Track all work in Jira, with estimates and task breakdown before development begins.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional software development.
  • Hands-on Dataverse and Power Platform work: tables, relationships, security roles, Power Automate and Power Apps. Power Pages is a strong plus.
  • Dynamics 365 experience: configuration, plugins, workflows, third-party integrations.
  • C# and/or JavaScript for platform customization. Comfort with SQL Server.
  • Real use of AI-assisted development tools on production work with a team, including code review and release practices. Claude Code or Cowork preferred; Copilot or Cursor accepted.
  • Clear writing and speaking. You will be in the room with the business.
  • You work well independently on a small, fully remote team.

Nice to have

  • Utility, energy or another data-heavy services business.

- Power BI or SSRS report building.

- Experience mentoring other developers.

Schedule and eligibility

Fully remote, 9:00 to 6:00 Eastern. Must be based in a US state within one hour of Eastern time. Must be authorized to work permanently in the US. We do not sponsor visas.

Benefits

$95,000 to $105,000 base plus annual performance bonus. 401(k) with company match, health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, paid time off and 11 paid holidays.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Developer with strong expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio to design, develop, and deploy advanced AI solutions focused on agentic AI, conversational AI, and autonomous agents.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Developer with strong expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio to design, develop, and deploy advanced AI solutions focused on agentic AI, conversational AI, and autonomous agents.

In this role, you will work on innovative AI-driven automation initiatives, building intelligent and self-sufficient agents capable of integrating with enterprise systems and supporting complex business processes.

You will be involved throughout the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and optimization. You will also collaborate closely with technical and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where agentic AI can improve workflows, decision-making, operational efficiency, and overall business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy advanced agentic AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
  • Build intelligent and autonomous AI agents capable of integrating with different enterprise systems and business applications.
  • Lead the architectural design and implementation of complex conversational AI and autonomous agent workflows.
  • Collaborate with product managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Integrate AI agents with Microsoft and Azure services, APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Implement robust testing strategies, including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing, to ensure reliability and high performance.
  • Optimize AI models, prompts, and agent logic to improve efficiency, scalability, responsiveness, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to AI agent behavior, performance, and integrations.
  • Apply prompt engineering, NLP, and machine learning principles to enhance agent capabilities.
  • Contribute to AI development standards, best practices, and MLOps processes.
  • Mentor junior developers and support knowledge sharing across technical teams.
  • Stay up to date with developments in Agentic AI, Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI, and related technologies, proactively identifying opportunities for innovation.
  • 8 + years of professional experience in AI/ML development, ideally with significant exposure to conversational AI, Generative AI, and/or autonomous agents.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio (formerly Power Virtual Agents).
  • Proven experience designing and implementing conversational AI or agentic AI solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of the Microsoft AI ecosystem, particularly Azure AI and Azure Cognitive Services.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, C#, or JavaScript.
  • Solid understanding of Natural Language Processing (NLP), machine learning concepts, and prompt engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with the Microsoft Azure cloud platform.
  • Experience working with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Experience integrating AI solutions with APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and cloud services.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, secure, maintainable, and production-ready AI solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex AI and integration issues.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional and technical teams.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing multi-agent or autonomous agent architectures.
  • Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Experience with AI governance, security, responsible AI, or enterprise AI architecture.
  • Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD, monitoring, and lifecycle management for AI solutions.
  • Experience mentoring developers or contributing to technical standards and AI development best practices.

What do we offer you?

  • B2B contract.
  • Working Hours: The role requires a shifted working schedule to ensure 3–4 hours of overlap with US Central Time.
  • Remote work.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

jobs.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a Computational Designer, you will contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, a generative design tool focused on site viability and masterplanning. The role combines computational design, geometry development and software engineering, with a predominantly back-end focus.

You will work directly with a product team member and may collaborate with an AI research and development specialist on initiatives involving AI agents and machine learning-based optimisation. The precise balance of responsibilities will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as product priorities change.

You will contribute to a standalone product that does not depend on third-party computational design tools. The role requires independent ownership of sub-projects, thoughtful problem-solving and an understanding of how individual technical decisions contribute to the wider product.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain computational geometry algorithms for a standalone generative design product.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, supporting site viability analysis and masterplanning.
  • Design, implement and refine computational optimisation solutions.
  • Build and maintain internal tools supporting product development.
  • Contribute to cloud infrastructure and back-end development.
  • Work across front-end and back-end development, with a predominant focus on back-end functionality.
  • Undertake primarily C# development, which accounts for approximately 99% of the role.
  • Develop code that interacts with the product's 3D engine as its interface transitions from Unity to Unreal, with dedicated Unreal specialists leading the rendering work.
  • Collaborate with product team members on computational design and software development.
  • Potentially contribute to AI-focused research and development, including connecting SiteSolve to AI agents and exploring machine learning-based optimisation approaches.
  • Independently take ownership of assigned sub-projects.
  • Apply a detail-oriented approach while considering the wider context in which the code operates.
  • Demonstrate flexibility, problem-solving ability and thoroughness in technical development.

Requirements

  • C# – 3+ years: Expert or advanced proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience developing software applications. C# is the primary language used throughout the product, and no substitute programming language is accepted.
  • AEC Computational Design / Geometry – 3+ years: Solid understanding and practical experience in AEC computational design or geometry. Relevant computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains, including manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games, is also acceptable.
  • Rhino / Grasshopper – 3+ years: Working knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper or equivalent 3D CAD and parametric design tools.
  • Computational Optimisation – 2–3 years: Applied experience in computational optimisation. A strong applied mathematics or algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience is also acceptable.
  • Ability to independently own and deliver assigned sub-projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a thorough and detail-oriented approach to development.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.excerpt: Dispel builds network isolation and access infrastructure for critical industries, where a breach is an operational failure with real-world consequences.
jobs.description:
Dispel builds network isolation and access infrastructure for critical industries, where a breach is an operational failure with real-world consequences. Our customers include critical infrastructure operators, defense contractors, and industrial enterprises that hold their software vendors to an exceptionally high bar. The Senior Engineering Manager is accountable for making that standard real.

This is a people-first, delivery-focused leadership role. You will manage 6–12 engineers across one or two teams, owning the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, and the hard conversations that come with it. You will co-own how engineering works at Dispel, participating in decisions about org structure, engineering-wide practices, and multi-quarter delivery strategy. Technical judgment is non-negotiable. You will read pull requests, join architecture discussions, and flag technical risk. You must understand what your teams are building to fully enable them.

Engineering at Dispel is a collaborative effort and those that show up trying to get things done and help others will receive support from the team. Dispel has high aspirations and we are growing quickly. We have noticed that people that have been in such environments before tend to adapt better. If you have not been in an environment like this before you would do well to try and convince us that you can handle it during your interviews.

Requirements

Execution

  • Own delivery health across all active work: track project status, identify blockers early, remove obstacles, and escalate risks to the VP of Engineering with context and a proposed path forward.
  • Run effective team rituals (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups, reviews) calibrated to what your teams actually need, not a fixed process template.
  • Conduct regular, substantive 1:1s with every direct report. Maintain a clear picture of each engineer's performance, goals, and career trajectory.
  • Own performance management end to end: develop high performers, address underperformance directly, and document both with the specificity needed to make decisions.
  • Participate in hiring loops: source candidates, conduct interviews, calibrate against the hiring bar, and contribute to offer decisions with a defensible rationale.
  • Contribute to quarterly and multi-quarter planning by translating roadmap intentions into realistic capacity models, surfacing dependencies, and flagging sequencing risks.
  • Maintain sufficient technical context to evaluate your teams' work. This includes reading pull requests for signal, joining architecture discussions, and escalating technical concerns.
  • Drive accountability for quality standards: code review practices, test coverage, documentation discipline, and incident response follow-through.
  • Partner with product and project managers to align on priorities, negotiate scope, and represent your teams' capacity honestly.

Enabling Others

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support system reliability, including responding to incidents and performing after-hours troubleshooting as needed.
  • Partner with other Engineering managers and VP of Engineering on team structure, headcount planning, career leveling consistency, and the definition of what good looks like at each IC level.
  • Identify patterns across your teams (recurring process failures, tooling friction, onboarding gaps) and drive improvements that benefit engineering beyond your teams.
  • Refine Dispel's hiring practices: help define the hiring bar, improve interview formats, and calibrate debriefs so decisions are consistent and defensible.
  • Advocate for investments your teams need: better release pipelines, CI/CD improvements, developer tooling. Make the case to the VP with specifics about impact and cost.
  • Represent engineering credibly to non-engineering stakeholders. Translate technical constraints into language that informs business decisions without oversimplifying.
  • Model the culture you want to see: intellectual honesty, directness, follow-through, and genuine care for your people.

Qualifications

  • 4 or more years managing software engineering teams of 5+ ICs in a product engineering environment.
  • A prior career as a software engineer with enough depth to understand what good engineering looks like. You do not need to write code in this role, but you need to have written it professionally and to have strong intuitions about quality, complexity, and technical risk.
  • Comfortable using coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) as part of your daily workflow. Addy Osmani's article Agentic Engineering roughly describes Dispel's stance on AI usage by engineers.
  • Demonstrated track record of growing engineers' careers. You can point to specific people you have leveled up, describe how you identified their gaps, and explain what you did to close them.
  • Experience with multi-quarter planning: you have owned delivery commitments spanning multiple sprint cycles and know how to track them, communicate about them, and recover when plans diverge from reality.
  • Strong technical judgment: comfortable in architecture reviews, able to evaluate proposals critically, and able to spot when a technical decision is being made for the wrong reasons.
  • Experience managing engineers on security-critical, reliability-critical, or infrastructure-adjacent software. The stakes are different when the thing you ship cannot go down.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate remote-first. You have managed distributed teams and understand what remote management requires that in-person does not.
  • Strong written communication. In a fully remote company, writing is your primary leadership surface: 1:1 notes, status updates, feedback, and engineering-wide contributions all need to be clear, specific, and worth reading.
  • US work authorization required. Dispel requires comprehensive background checks for all employees.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a company with a security-first product or customers in regulated industries (critical infrastructure, defense, industrial control systems, financial services, healthcare).
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, FedRAMP, or IEC 62443. Not as a practitioner, but as a manager who understands what compliance costs a team and how to resource it.
  • Exposure to Dispel's core technology areas: cloud-native infrastructure on AWS or Azure, Terraform, backend services in Python, TypeScript, or Go, and React/TypeScript frontends.
  • Experience driving improvements to release infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, or developer tooling. You got the build time cut in half or got automated testing enforced as a gate, and you know what that takes organizationally.
  • Prior experience working alongside a Technical Program Manager or equivalent. You understand how program management and engineering management divide responsibilities.
  • Familiarity with structured hiring and leveling practices: rubrics, evaluation frameworks, or calibration processes that make hiring and promotion decisions more consistent.
  • A willingness to accept failure and feedback, learn and try again.
  • A passion for learning new disciplines and gaining a deep understanding of how others on the team do their work.
  • An ability to communicate clearly and succinctly both in-person and over team chat.

Benefits

Why Dispel/Benefits

At Dispel you’ll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

  • Base salary: $165,000-189,000
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off and holidays
  • Performance bonus and equity eligible
  • Remote work
  • Medical, vision, dental insurance

jobs.title: SENIOR / PRINCIPAL OFFENSIVE SECURITY ENGINEER
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT BREACHLOCKBreachLock is a penetration testing provider that pairs skilled human testers with a delivery platform, giving clients offensive security testing at the depth of a bespoke engagement and the speed of a product.
jobs.description:
ABOUT BREACHLOCK

BreachLock is a penetration testing provider that pairs skilled human testers with a delivery platform, giving clients offensive security testing at the depth of a bespoke engagement and the speed of a product. This role sits on the team that owns the custom, difficult engagements that define the high end of that work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

BreachLock is hiring a Senior or Principal Offensive Security Engineer to join the team that handles our hardest, most custom engagements. This is hands-on testing work. You will spend your weeks inside client networks, applications, and the places where the two meet, finding the paths a real attacker would take and writing them up so a client can act. You will also help set the technical bar for the people around you.

We run the engagements that do not fit a template: the bespoke, high-touch, non-standard work where off-the-shelf methodology runs out quickly. If you want a seat where the interesting problems land on your desk and your judgment is the product, this is it.

The level we hire you at, Senior or Principal, follows your depth and track record. Both are senior individual-contributor roles with room to grow into technical leadership.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead external and internal network penetration tests, web application assessments, and mobile application assessments from scoping through final report.
  • Own Active Directory attack paths end to end: enumeration, credential access, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and the walk back to domain compromise, with a clear account of how each step was possible and how to close it.
  • Test web applications against real business logic, authentication and authorization flaws, injection, and the chained issues that a scanner will never find.
  • Assess mobile applications on iOS and Android, including the API surface behind them.
  • Write findings that a client can use. Clear severity, honest scope, reproducible steps, and remediation that fits the environment they actually run.
  • Partner directly with clients during testing and debriefs, explain exposure in plain terms, and walk technical teams through how to fix what you found.
  • Contribute to the team's shared toolkit and methodology.
  • Mentor less experienced testers and raise the quality of the work around you.

Requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Several years of hands-on offensive security experience in a consulting or in-house red team setting.
  • At least one of OSCP or CRTO. Equivalent proven experience will be considered, but we expect you to demonstrate the skills these certifications represent.
  • Strong, demonstrated proficiency with Active Directory attack vectors.
  • Strong web application testing skills across the common and the uncommon classes of vulnerability.
  • Working mobile application testing experience on iOS, Android, or both.
  • The ability to explain a complex attack path clearly in writing and out loud, to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A tester's integrity. You report what the evidence supports, you name the limits of your coverage, and you never pad a finding.

A strong plus (any of these move you up the stack):

  • Red team and adversary emulation experience.
  • Purple team work, building detections alongside a client's blue team.
  • Social engineering: phishing, vishing, and pretext-based access.
  • Physical security assessments.
  • Wireless (WiFi) testing.
  • Cloud penetration testing across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Tool and exploit development, and comfort reading and modifying code.
  • Further certifications such as OSEP, OSWE, CRTP, CRTE, PNPT, or GIAC offensive tracks.

Benefits

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through this posting with a resume and a short note on the offensive work you are proudest of. If you have public research, write-ups, CVEs, or a lab profile you want us to see, include them. We read them.

BreachLock is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on any basis protected by law.

A Note On How To Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:

Threat Detection & Monitoring

  • Monitor security signals and alerts in Cloud SIEM and related tools across our SaaS platforms; triage, prioritize, and escalate as needed
  • Help onboard and maintain log sources (e.g., AWS CloudTrail, Azure activity logs, identity provider logs) to ensure detection coverage

Alert Triage & Investigation

  • Investigate alerts by correlating logs, metrics, and traces to determine scope, impact, and whether activity is malicious or benign
  • Document investigation findings clearly and hand off or escalate cases following established procedures

Detection Engineering & Automation

  • Help build and tune detection rules, suppressions, and thresholds to improve signal quality and reduce false positives
  • Build and maintain Datadog dashboards and monitors that give visibility into security posture and detection health
  • Use scripting and AI-assisted workflows to enrich alerts and automate repetitive triage tasks

Threat Hunting & Intelligence

  • Participate in threat hunts across cloud and application telemetry, guided by hypotheses and the MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Track relevant threat intelligence and vulnerabilities, and help translate them into new or improved detections
  • Help identify and investigate AI-related threats — such as prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, data leakage through AI features, and misuse of LLM integrations — and support detections and response for our AI-powered features and tools

Incident Response

  • Support the response to security incidents — performing initial triage, collecting evidence, and assisting with containment under the guidance of senior team members
  • Contribute to IR playbooks, runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post-incident reviews
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 1–3 years of experience in security operations, a SOC, IT, or a related role (or equivalent internships, coursework, or hands-on lab experience)
  • Foundational understanding of cloud security on AWS and Azure (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender, etc.)
  • Hands-on exposure to a SIEM or observability platform —e.g., Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalents also valued)
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows/Linux logs, and common attack techniques; familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK
  • Basic understanding of AI/LLM security risks (e.g., prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, insecure output handling) and familiarity with frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell, and comfort writing log search queries
  • Curiosity, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn; comfortable working with engineering, DevOps, and IT teams
  • Clear written and verbal communication — able to document investigations and explain findings to technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to Have: Security certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+, BTL1), experience with EDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender), Workflow Automation, detection-as-code, or participation in CTFs and home labs

Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Solutions Engineer who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

As a Solutions Engineer at Claroty, you will serve as a strategic technical advisor and trusted partner throughout the sales lifecycle. You will bridge business needs with deep technical expertise, supporting enterprise customers across industrial, healthcare, energy, and critical infrastructure sectors.

In this high-impact, customer-facing role, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to design and deliver tailored cybersecurity solutions that protect complex OT/ICS environments. This role is ideal for a technically strong, business-savvy professional who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys translating complex challenges into practical solutions.

Responsibilities

As a Solutions Engineer, your impact will be:

  • Technical Sales Expertise: Serve as the primary technical resource for the sales team and prospective customers, providing subject matter expertise on OT/ICS cybersecurity and Claroty’s platform.
  • Customer Engagement: Lead detailed technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, operational challenges, and cybersecurity maturity. Translate customer pain points into solution strategies aligned with both technical requirements and business objectives.
  • Product Demonstrations: Deliver compelling, customized product demonstrations and technical presentations to diverse audiences, including security engineers, architects, plant managers, CISOs, and executive stakeholders.
  • Proof of Concepts (PoCs): Plan, manage, and execute successful Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and technical evaluations. Document findings and present results that clearly demonstrate technical value, risk reduction, and ROI.
  • Solution Design: Architect and propose scalable Claroty solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing IT and security infrastructure, including SIEM, firewalls, asset management platforms, virtualization systems, and cloud environments.
  • RFP/RFI Management: Own and contribute to technical responses for RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, ensuring competitive positioning and technical accuracy.
  • Support Sales and Channel Directors to develop account plans and strategies for targeted partners, work closely with the partner's go-to market teams to help set product/gtm strategy and its delivery
  • Market Intelligence: Stay current with trends in industrial control systems (ICS), evolving cyber threats, regulatory frameworks, and competitive technologies. Provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering teams.
  • Thought Leadership: Represent Claroty at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events. Lead webinars and contribute to technical content, strengthening Claroty’s reputation as a leader in OT cybersecurity.

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

Experience & Background

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role, preferably within cybersecurity, industrial automation, networking, or enterprise SaaS
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and partnering closely with Account Executives
  • Willingness to travel (approximately 30–40%), including occasional overnight stays, depending on territory and business needs
  • Full proficiency in English and Arabic

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of networking protocols and architectures (TCP/IP, UDP, routing, switching, segmentation)
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity technologies and principles, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, vulnerability management, and threat detection
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V)
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure) – a plus
  • Practical experience in one or more cybersecurity domains:
  • Security & Risk Management
  • Asset Security
  • Security Architecture & Engineering
  • Communication & Network Security
  • Security Assessment & Testing

OT / Industrial Knowledge

  • Proficiency with industrial protocols such as Modbus, IEC 61850, DNP3, Ethernet/IP, Profinet
  • Familiarity with industrial control systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA)
  • Experience working with vendors such as Siemens, Rockwell, Emerson, GE
  • Understanding of IT/OT convergence and network segmentation strategies

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field (preferred)
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GICSP, CCNA, or similar – a strong plus

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently and cross-functionally
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit claroty.com.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite in The Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 multiple consecutive years.

Claroty is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of ALL diverse backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases.

jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer, Java & Kubernetes Focus

Who We Are

Recruitics is the talent acquisition platform for organizations where hiring never stops. The platform unifies predictive labor market intelligence, programmatic reach across every channel candidates trust, and AI-ready job application workflows to optimize every stage of the pre-apply journey, from market signal to qualified hire. More than 400 enterprise organizations across healthcare, logistics, retail, and beyond trust Recruitics to reach and convert talent across 100+ countries. For more information, visit
.

What We’re Looking For

Recruitics is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep Kubernetes and platform expertise to join our team.You’ll be one of two engineers who own AdaptiveApply. That means the code, the infrastructure, the integrations, and a lot of the decisions. There’s no separate platform team to hand things off to. If you want real ownership of a product that lives with customers, this is it. AdaptiveApply is our newest product: an application layer that sits upstream of the ATS and verifies identity, intent, and qualifications before a candidate ever reaches the employer’s system. We launched with ID.me as our first verification partner, and more partners are on the way.

Our tech stack includes React and TypeScript on the frontend; Kotlin and Spring Boot on the backend; Airflow, DBT, Looker, AWS Redshift, DynamoDB, and MongoDB across our data layer; Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS at the heart of our infrastructure; and a rapidly evolving AI/ML layer built on LLM APIs, embeddings, and vector search. We value autonomy and ownership: you'll have the freedom to innovate and the responsibility to implement solutions independently (with plenty of support from your team).

What You’ll Do

In this role you'll work across the full stack, with Kubernetes and data engineering as recurring throughlines. You will:

  • Build and run AdaptiveApply end to end: backend services in Kotlin and Spring Boot, event flows on Kafka, and the apply experience candidates actually see.
  • Deploy your own work. You’ll write the Helm charts, set resource limits and autoscaling, ship through CI/CD, and debug in-cluster when something breaks. Everything runs on Kubernetes on AWS (EKS).
  • Integrate verification partners (identity, credentials, assessments) and push clean, verified candidate data into employer ATS platforms.
  • Take ambiguous problems from customer conversations and turn them into shipped features, working directly with product and go-to-market.
  • Own reliability for what you ship. When a bot submits 500 applications overnight, you’re the one who makes sure the system holds up.
  • Use AI coding agents as a normal part of how you work, and help shape where AI belongs inside the product.

What You’ll Bring

We're looking for a well-rounded engineer who can build complete products and is genuinely strong with Kubernetes and data. The ideal candidate has:

  • 5+ years of software engineering with real senior-level ownership. You’ve designed systems, made the tradeoffs, and lived with the results in production.
  • Strong Java and JVM experience. Kotlin is our primary backend language, so production Kotlin is a big plus. Spring Boot is expected.
  • Hands-on Kafka: topic design, producers and consumers, and handling failures and replays in event-driven systems.
  • Production Kubernetes experience deploying and operating your own workloads, not just consuming a platform someone else built. Helm, ingress, autoscaling, RBAC, secrets, and debugging a failing pod should all feel familiar. EKS and Terraform are a plus.
  • High agency. You don’t wait for a perfectly scoped ticket. You find the problem, propose a path, ship it, and tell people what you did.
  • Fluency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar).
  • Clear communication with non-engineers. You’ll work closely with product, sales, and sometimes customers.

You May Also Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience is absolutely welcome.
  • React/TypeScript for when a feature needs frontend work
  • ATS integrations (Workday, Greenhouse, iCIMS) or HR tech experience
  • Identity verification, fraud detection, or bot mitigation work
  • Data pipelines (Airflow, DBT, Redshift)

Why Join Us

At Recruitics, you’ll have the opportunity to help us make hiring better for everyone. Help us connect intelligence, talent acquisition, and candidate conversion to help companies find the people their business needs more efficiently, while continuously evolving with how talent discovers work and how hiring gets done. You’ll be joining a creative and collaborative environment where your work will directly impact our clients’ success and you will have opportunities for career growth, professional development, and continuous learning.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salaries with growth incentives
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • #AnywhereAugust - We support remote work experiences to expand perspectives and personal growth
  • 15 Vacation Days, 5 Flex Days, 5 Sick Days, and remote work options year-round
  • Fully paid parental leave for both parents
  • Summer Fridays from Memorial Day to Labor Day
  • Winter Recess between Christmas and New Years
  • Commuter and Parking Benefits through Wage Works
  • Eligible to contribute to your 401(K) Retirement Plan after six (6) months of employment.
  • Employee Assistance Programs to support your day to day

Location

Remote based out of the United States

Compensation

  • Comp Range: $140K - $200K + 10% Yearly Bonus

Equal Opportunity And Accessible Workplace

Recruitics is an equal-opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our workforce and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, civil partnership, status as a covered veteran, status in the Uniformed Services of the United States, citizenship and any other characteristic protected by State and Federal law.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible process for all individuals. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know. We will work with you to ensure your needs are met in a timely and respectful manner.

Applicants must be at least 18 years old to apply.

At Recruitics, protecting our talent community—candidates, clients, and partners—is always a top priority. As you navigate your application journey, please keep these tips in mind to stay safe:

  • We'll never ask you to pay for anything. That includes applications, interviews, background checks, or equipment.
  • We only communicate via official email addresses ending in @ — never from Gmail or suspicious lookalikes.
  • We do not request personal financial information such as bank details, credit card numbers, or wire transfers.
  • If something feels off or doesn’t seem right, pause and contact us directly at .

We’re thrilled you’re interested in working with us. Just make sure it’s really us you’re talking to. Stay sharp and stay safe!

About Entrupy

Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.
Entrupy’s solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy’s solutions in market:
● Entrupy Apparel Authentication
● Entrupy Bags & Leather Goods Authentication
● Entrupy Sneaker Authentication
● Entrupy Fingerprinting

As we continue to build...

We’re seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we’d love to have you apply.

About the Role

Entrupy is seeking a Senior Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team. You will work alongside other infrastructure engineers, under our Platform Lead, to keep our AWS platform secure, compliant and reliable. Nearly all of our platform and data services are written in Python, and this role sits right where that code meets the infrastructure under it. You will be a strong Python engineer who prefers to spend their time on infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and production operations.

The team has two main goals. The first is security and compliance across our AWS environment, including our SOC 2 program: keeping our infrastructure secure by default, meeting our controls continuously, and having audit evidence ready at all times. The second is a major infrastructure modernization. We are moving our services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, defining our infrastructure in Terraform / OpenTofu, and making every service build and deploy through automated CI/CD pipelines. Together, we make sure security and compliance are built into that new platform from day one, not bolted on afterwards.

Some of the systems you will work with:

  • Multi-account AWS infrastructure: networking, IAM, ECS, backups, audit logging and compliance controls
  • CI/CD, deploy tooling, secrets management, logging, monitoring and alerting
  • Python backend APIs for our mobile apps, SDKs and dashboards
  • Public-facing APIs and webhooks used by partners and enterprise customers
  • Data pipelines and ingestors that feed analytics, search and reporting
  • Databases, caches, search and object stores (PostgreSQL/RDS, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, S3)

The Platform team works closely with the backend, mobile, machine learning and BI teams, and builds the secure, paved road those teams use to ship and run their services.
Employment Type: Remote
Reports to: Platform Lead
Location: Fully remote (US), working East Coast hours

What you’ll do:

Security and compliance

  • Help run the technical side of our SOC 2 program with the rest of the Platform team. Implement and maintain infrastructure controls, collect and automate audit evidence, fix control failures, and support each audit cycle.
  • Help enforce least-privilege access across our AWS accounts: IAM roles and policies, AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO), cross-account access, GitHub OIDC for CI, and regular access reviews.
  • Help make sure data is encrypted at rest and in transit across RDS, DynamoDB, S3, EBS and Redis, and help manage certificates, KMS keys and secrets (SOPS, Secrets Manager, SSM).
  • Contribute to audit logging, threat detection (CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub or similar) and vulnerability management for container images, dependencies and hosts.
  • Write security and compliance checks into Terraform / OpenTofu and CI, so that new infrastructure is compliant by default and drift is caught automatically.
  • Take part in security incident response and postmortems, and help keep runbooks and policies current.

Infrastructure and CI/CD

  • Work with the team to migrate our Python services off Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, managed with Terraform / OpenTofu. Plan and run cutovers with zero or minimal downtime, and decommission the legacy environments.
  • Build and maintain reusable Terraform / OpenTofu modules for ECS services, networking, IAM, databases and observability. Contribute to the team's state management, environment separation (dev / staging / prod) and a safe, peer-reviewed plan/apply workflow.
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) that test, build, scan, version and deploy every service. Help standardize Docker image builds, ECR storage and promotion between environments.
  • Help replace hand-run and script-based deploys with repeatable, automated, auditable workflows

Operations and reliability

  • Share responsibility for production operations and on-call: RDS/PostgreSQL upgrades, Redis and DynamoDB capacity, runtime and OS end-of-life upgrades, backups and restore testing, cost hygiene and incident response.
  • Help maintain observability: metrics, logs, dashboards and alerting (CloudWatch, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Make sure alerts are actionable, routed correctly and automatically created for new infrastructure.
  • Write and review Python. This covers infrastructure automation, deploy tooling, Lambdas and internal tooling, plus contributions to our backend and data services when needed.
  • Review your teammates' infrastructure and code changes, and share knowledge across the team.
  • Write clear runbooks and architecture docs, and help other engineering teams provision and deploy services on their own, securely.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, security or platform engineering, with a strong focus on AWS.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SOC 2 (or ISO 27001, HIPAA or similar) controls in a cloud environment, including producing audit evidence and working with auditors.
  • Strong AWS security fundamentals: IAM, SSO, KMS, VPC network security, CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty / Security Hub.
  • Strong, production-grade Python. You write maintainable, tested Python services and tooling, not just glue scripts.
  • Deep hands-on Terraform or OpenTofu experience: writing and structuring modules, managing remote state, importing existing resources, and running IaC safely across multiple environments and accounts.
  • Production experience running containerized services on Amazon ECS (Fargate and/or EC2 launch types) with ECR, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling and service discovery.
  • Broad AWS experience: VPC, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, CloudFront.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including security scanning and OIDC-based deploy credentials.
  • Experience migrating production workloads from one platform to another (e.g. PaaS to ECS) without disrupting customers.
  • Experience running production systems: on-call, incident response, postmortems and database upgrades.
  • A collaborative working style. You are comfortable sharing ownership, reviewing and being reviewed, and splitting work across a team.
  • Clear written communication. You document your work and can explain security and infrastructure trade-offs to engineers, auditors and leadership.
  • Comfortable working fully remote and asynchronously with a distributed team, during East Coast hours.

Preferred experience

  • Experience moving services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk (or Heroku or a similar PaaS).
  • Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, Secureframe).
  • Multi-account AWS setups: AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies, centralized logging.
  • Policy-as-code and IaC security scanning (e.g., Checkov, tfsec / Trivy, OPA / Conftest).
  • PostgreSQL administration, including blue/green upgrades, connection pooling (RDS Proxy / PgBouncer) and access management.
  • Familiarity with GDPR and data privacy requirements.
  • Experience with search systems (OpenSearch / Elasticsearch) and event-driven pipelines (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, DynamoDB Streams).
  • Python web frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and Poetry-based dependency management.
  • Fluency with AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) for infrastructure and code work.
  • Previous work on a small platform or infrastructure team in a startup-like environment.

What we offer

  • Market competitive and pay equity-focused compensation structure
  • Generous time away including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Rich medical benefits and insurance coverage
  • Safe Harbor 401k match
  • Dedicated mental health support for employees and eligible dependents

We have had an incredible run so far and are laying the foundation for a culture that is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and rooted in passion, kindness, and positivity. We live by these values – we hire by them, promote them, and celebrate them every day.

Please apply if you want to be a part of a collaborative and dynamic team with a passion for working with high-end luxury brands and cutting-edge technology, and want to be at the forefront of AI innovation.

The starting salary for this role is between $160,000 - $185,000, depending on skills and experience. We have competitive pay bands for all other countries based on market standards. Individual compensation decisions are based on several factors, including experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. Based on these factors, we expect most of the candidates offered roles at our company to fall within the range. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than the requirements stated in this job description, as posted. If so, the updated salary range will be communicated to you as a candidate.

Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

Pay: $80–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. BSc, MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python or other coding languages.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit)

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Strategic Market Making (HFT), Credit and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026

Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge


The role
About Credit Desk

In our Credit & On-Chain Liquidity team, we design strategies and deploy capital across decentralized lending protocols, managed vaults, and credit facilities. Operating at the intersection of quantitative finance and smart contract technolgy, the Credit Desk is responsible for optimizing yield, evaluating counterparty and protocol risk, and deploying programmatic credit solutions across digital asset markets. As a Credit Desk DeFi Quant Trader Intern, you will work directly with quant traders and credit strategists to build quantitative risk models, automate yield harvesting, analyze on-chain liquidity pools, and evaluate DeFi protocol mechanics.

Key Responsibilities of a DeFi Quant Trader intern in this unit

  • On-Chain Risk & Credit Modeling: Develop and refine quantitative risk models to assess protocol health, collateralization ratios, liquidation risks, and smart contract vulnerability exposure across DeFi credit platforms.

  • Yield Optimization & Execution: Build Python-based tools and algorithmic models to analyze real-time yield curves, liquidity pool depth, and funding rate arbitrage across lending and borrowing protocols.

  • Data Analytics & Monitoring: Query on-chain data, EVM event logs, and lending protocol data using SQL, Subgraphs, and Python to generate actionable insights for credit positioning and risk allocation.

  • Protocol Due Diligence & Forensics: Perform quantitative forensics and stress testing on emerging lending primitives, liquid staking protocols, and structured credit products prior to capital deployment.

Who You Are/Key Requirements

  • Technical & Quantitative Skills: Strong code-first foundation in Python, familiarity with Rust with Solidity as a plus. Understanding of smart contract mechanics and DeFi primitive mathemtaics (including propAMMs, lending pool utilization curves, liquidation thresholds).

  • Quantitative & Trading Mindset: Rigorous background in a quantitative field (Math, Physics, CS, Finance, or Engineering) with a systematic/trading mindset. Ability to model yield dynamics, credit risk, backtesting strategies, and protocol insolvency scenarios.

  • DeFi “Skin in the Game”: Hands-on experience interacting with decentralized lending protocols (e.g., Aave, Morpho, Compound, Maker/Endgame), yield aggregators, or credit markets.

  • Nice-to-Haves: Familiarity with Rust, Solidity, Foundry, or specialized credit risk models and backtesting frameworks.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewWorld Travel Holdings is seeking a Quality Engineering Supervisor to coordinate day-to-day testing activities, support a blended Quality Engineering team, and contribute hands-on to reliable test automation.
jobs.description:
Overview

World Travel Holdings is seeking a Quality Engineering Supervisor to coordinate day-to-day testing activities, support a blended Quality Engineering team, and contribute hands-on to reliable test automation. The supervisor translates the manager’s quality strategy into practical team execution, coaches team members, and partners with delivery teams to improve test coverage, feedback, and release readiness. This role supports approved AI-assisted testing capabilities with appropriate human review and helps manual QA team members build automation and AI-assisted testing skills through hands-on coaching, guided practice, and achievable learning milestones, while preserving exploratory, risk-based, and customer-focused testing. A core objective of this role is to progressively evolve the team from manual-heavy testing toward an automation-first Quality Engineering model, while preserving the exploratory and business-domain testing that protects customers and the business.

About the Company

World Travel Holdings, headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, is the nation’s largest cruise agency and an award‑winning leisure travel company with nearly 40 travel brands. Through owned brands and private‑label partnerships, we sell cruises, villas, resort day passes, and luxury travel services. With a top-rated franchise, a UK cruise division, and a strong commitment to employee engagement and remote work, World Travel Holdings offers a people-focused culture. Learn more: WorldTravelHoldings.com

Responsibilities

Team Supervision and Daily Delivery

  • Coordinate assignments, testing priorities, and team capacity within the manager’s delivery plan; escalate staffing conflicts and competing demands.
  • Coach team members in manual, exploratory, regression, API and automated testing; support onboarding, knowledge sharing, and consistent use of team practices.
  • Monitor testing progress, remove routine blockers, and communicate risks, dependencies, and support needs to the manager and delivery partners.
  • Provide timely feedback and contribute to development planning under the manager’s direction.

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

  • Support approved AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and coverage analysis, validating outputs before they are used in delivery decisions.
  • Help team members adopt AI tools responsibly, following established data protection, security, and engineering review standards.
  • Participate in manager-led pilots of AI-assisted or agentic workflows; document results, limitations, and improvement opportunities.

Manual QA Upskilling in Automation and AI

  • Lead the progressive shift of the team from manual-heavy testing to an automation-first QE model, increasing automation ownership over time while explicitly preserving exploratory, risk-based, and business-domain testing.
  • Partner with the manager to establish practical learning paths that help manual QA team members build automation and AI-assisted testing skills through guided practice and achievable milestones.
  • Provide hands-on coaching, pairing, and code reviews to develop foundational scripting, version control, API testing, and automated test maintenance skills within approved frameworks.
  • Help team members turn suitable manual regression scenarios into reliable automated tests, progressing from supported contributions to independent ownership as skills develop.
  • Teach responsible use of approved AI tools for test design, script creation, and troubleshooting, emphasizing critical review, data protection, and validation of generated outputs.
  • Coordinate learning time within delivery priorities, share reusable examples, and review skill-development progress with the manager while preserving exploratory testing and business-domain expertise.

Delivery Integration and Shift-Left Quality

  • Work with Product Management, Business Analysts, and engineers during refinement to clarify acceptance criteria, identify testability concerns, and surface business risks.
  • Coordinate risk-based test planning and execution across functional, regression, API, integration, accessibility, and performance needs.
  • Support automated test execution and established quality gates in CI/CD pipelines with Engineering and DevOps.
  • Shorten developer feedback cycles by running fast, reliable automated checks early in the pipeline, and reduce downstream rework by catching defects and requirement gaps sooner.
  • Provide clear testing status, defect information, and readiness recommendations to designated release decision-makers; escalate unresolved risks rather than independently approving exceptions.

Quality Reporting and Continuous Improvement

  • Review defect patterns and test failures with the team to identify practical improvements in coverage, test data, and workflows.
  • Support modernization initiatives by implementing assigned test improvements and identifying coverage gaps.
  • Share progress and improvement recommendations with the manager, including opportunities to reduce repetitive manual effort and shorten release cycles.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in software testing, Quality Engineering, or test automation, including experience coordinating testing work or serving as a team lead.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated tests in an established framework, with proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a similar language.
  • Practical experience with functional, regression, API, and integration testing, defect management, and risk-based test planning.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD test execution, version control, code review, and troubleshooting automated test failures.
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery, acceptance criteria, testability, and early collaboration with business and engineering partners.
  • Strong communication, organization, and coaching skills, with the ability to coordinate daily delivery and escalate risks appropriately.
  • Ability to review AI-generated testing outputs critically and follow established security, data protection, and quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior supervisory experience with a blended manual and automation testing team.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools for test creation, maintenance, or coverage analysis.
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments, containerization, and testing within modernization initiatives.
  • Experience with accessibility or performance testing, SQL and database validation, API mocking, or test management platforms such as TestRail or Zephyr.
  • Travel industry experience.

Compensation & Benefits

Estimated Pay Range: $105,000 - $115,000/year

Benefits Overview:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with discretionary company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Travel discounts and employee perks
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Professional development and learning opportunities

EEO Statement

World Travel Holdings is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any status protected by applicable law.
